key.name: What brings you here?
If we could only find something...
We must locate their traces.
Ah, $MyPCName$. I've been waiting for you.
This place is cold... desolate.
What brings you here?
What brings you here?
What brings you here?
What brings you here?
It's nice to meet you!
It's not easy, getting used to this cold.
What kind of secrets are hidden in the ice?
Nice to meet you, $MyPCName$!
Why did you come here?
What does the supply crew do around here?
I came here with the supply crew, of course. We're here to keep the guards out here from turning into popsicles. But me... I'm here for another reason.
So, why are you REALLY here?

We keep the guards fed and clothed so they don't freeze or complain too much. Veterans like me handle supplies since we've learned what kind of gear we'll need. Honestly though, there's another reason I'm here.
So, why are you REALLY here?

I'm here to study a kingdom that once stood in this snowfield. It was a peaceful kingdom, but no one knows why it vanished into history. The survivors scattered, and none of them will talk to me, so I came here myself.
Welcome, welcome.
Hmm, I must say, I think I've seen you before.
Yeah, we met back in Tria.
Ah! Now I remember you, $MyPCName$! It's been awhile, hasn't it? Good to see you again, very good.
My kingdom... Ahhh, it was so very beautiful. You may hear stories about it, but I tell you the truth.
Our king... I told him to be strong... <font color="#909090">(He does his best to hide his despair, but it runs too deep.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(A chilling wind blows through the gap in the ice wall behind the frozen tree.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(Something must be hidden behind this tree.)</font>
What... are you?
What do you want?
You must conserve your energy in the cold. That's why I don't talk much. Just so you know.
What... are you?
Ugh...
$MyPCName$, I'll always remember you.
I was told humans were selfish, foul creatures... but in the end, a human saved me.
How do you feel?
I'll live, thanks to you. We snowcubs are strong. That's all.
Your Majesty...
Your Majesty...
There are a great many things left to do. We should leave, for our next destination will be challenging.
Stand back.
What... are you?
Heh, heh.
Ugh...
Ugh...
Stand back.
Stand back.
Ugh...
Non-stop service to $map:02020041$ in Kritias will be departing soon.
Non-stop service to $map:02020041$ in Kritias will be departing soon.
Kritias is no place for pushovers. You know that, right? Well, if you're sure, hop aboard and I'll get you to $map:02020041$.
Take me to $map:02020041$!
All right. Away we go!
If you need a lift back to $map:02000001$, I'm your gal!
If you need a lift back to $map:02000001$, I'm your gal!
We're heading out straight away. If you miss this place, you can always use the Lumiwind to come back. Are you ready to return to $map:02000001$?
Take me to $map:02000001$!
All right. Away we go!
Beeep... Beeep...
Initiating greeting protocol! The weather is nice today, is it not?
How's your work coming?
Initiating reassurance protocol! We soldierettos are doing our best. You can count upon us.
Initiating gratitude protocol! We are grateful to the humans who gave us new purpose.
Initiating brusque farewell protocol! This time has been very pleasant, but I have over one hundred tasks remaining for today. Please excuse me.
I'll leave you to it, then.
Scanning records on aetherine air brake experiment... Scan complete.
Beeep... Beeep...
Mathematical query: why was six afraid of seven?
Answer: because seven ate nine. Ha! Ha! Ha! Ha!
Beeep... Beeep...
You appear malnourished.
Feel free to refuel at our aetherine station.
Beeep... Beeep...
Beep... Beep... Beep...
Beep... Beep... Beeep! Bee...
Beeep... Beeep...
Oh?!
Ah... Hello there.
How's the research going?
V-very well. As you can see, I'm burning the midnight oil. Eheheh...
If you could see our results, why, they'd knock your socks off!
S-so you go and tell $npcName:11004438[gender:0]$ that we're working hard, okay?
It doesn't look like you're working that hard.
I-I am, and I have the overtime sheets to show it! L-later. I'll have them later. You'll see...
This is the life!
Working with $npcName:11004527[gender:0]$ is the best.
I see you there.
Can I help you?
I'm just checking in on things.
$npcName:11004437[gender:0]$ sent you, then. As you can see, nothing's changed.
We're still getting shot at by wild robots. We're still dealing with these ridiculous dust clouds. And we're still getting motion sickness when that machine over there sends out tremors...
I miss the forest.
When you get back to the outpost, let them know we need reinforcements to help with the killer machines here.
Will do.
Thanks. You're a life saver!
Ouch...
That's gonna leave a scar. I just know it...
Ugh...
I think I'm gonna be sick.
Huff, huff!
Gotta get in shape if I'm gonna fight bad guys!
Huh? Who're you?
Huh? Who're you?
Why're you dressed like that? You look like a big dummy with a side of dummy sauce.
You practicing for a marathon, kid?
This is cutting-edge fashion where I'm from!
I'm training so I can join the resistance! I'm gonna beat up those Tairen doody-heads good.
But Humanitas only lets the strongest people ever join them. That's why I gotta run so much.
You look pretty strong, though. How do you do it?
Just keep training.
I was afraid you were gonna say that. Hey... If you see my ma and pa, could you rescue them from the bad guys?
Absolutely.
Wow, really? Okay! Then I gotta keep training so I can help you!
And where are you from? A butt?
Amazing...
Is Kritias inhabited solely by monsters?
I've never seen such a place... Huh? Where'd you come from?
I've never seen such a place... Huh? Where'd you come from?
Who are you?
Oh, you kidder. You know me. We boarded Sky Fortress together!
I'm pretty sure I've never met you before.
Of course! I'd never forget a face like yours.
You scatterbrain! I was the facility manager at the $map:52010059$. I can't believe you forgot about me...
Anyway, Bastet picked up this structure during a routine scan. I thought I'd check it out, but this place is thick with monsters...
Who's Bastet?
Why are you here, anyway?
Of course you didn't forget me! I'm unforgettable, as my mother always said.
Anyway, Bastet picked up this structure during a routine scan. I thought I'd check it out, but this place is thick with monsters...
I've never seen such a building. The architecture is breathtaking...
Oh... Maybe this isn't the time for such chatter. I'd better get out of here while I still can.
Not who, but what. Bastet is our cutting-edge surveillance satellite! There's nothing she can't spot. I think.
She's technically still a prototype. When Kritias showed up from out of nowhere, it seemed like a good chance to put her through her paces.
She can count your nose hairs from orbit!
Impressive! Who came up with that?
Who do you think? $npcName:11004437[gender:0]$, of course! At Captain $npcName:11004434[gender:0]$ command, of course.
The captain even came up with the name "Bastet," you see. I wonder what it means...?
I'm here to research structures and facilities here on Kritias, of course. Unfortunately, the going hasn't exactly been easy.
But it's definitely worth it! Look at this beauty of a building right here.
Oh... Maybe this isn't the time for such chatter. I'd better get out of here while I still can.
Beeep... Beeep...
Initiating excitement protocols! Oh, I have uncovered records about Vanheim. Archiving now.
Aaaah.
Isn't this place lovely? I get to enjoy this wonderful nature while I work.
I see the "enjoy" part, but what about the "work" part?
I can't help it if I have resting "relaxed" face. Trust me when I say that we're working hard over here.
I can't stand the noise here...
The dust here is unreal... I should have brought a face mask.
I'm going to get a lung disease from my time in this place. Hopefully it's all just in my head...
Hm...
Yes, yes. I'm sure I've seen your face somewhere before. I'm really much too busy just now, though, so...
What are you up to?
An amateur academic. Of course. I suppose I can spare a minute of my time to explain.
I am one of the premier mechanical engineers of Victoria Island! I snuck aboard—I mean, I legitimately boarded Sky Fortress in order to study the machines of Kritias.
And look! I have discovered the most wonderful drills!
At least, it looks like a drill. Technically speaking, that's not quite right.
The structure of this drill defies all known convention—it's no twist drill, nor straight shank drill, nor step drill, and so forth.
And this material! They've somehow found something better than cemented carbide. I can't even— I mean, it's just not—
GASP! Sorry... I got so excited, I forgot to breathe.
Anyway, it's all clear now, is it not?
Not in the slightest.
You jest. I explained it clearly enough for a five-year-old to understand.
Then I must be four.
You tire me. Shoo.
But what is this drill for...?
Would it kill them to let up...?
I'm sick of fighting! Is there no end to them?! Oh...! Hello, $male:Sir,female:Ma'am$! I didn't see you there!
I'm sick of fighting! Is there no end to them?! Oh...! Hello, $male:Sir,female:Ma'am$! I didn't see you there!
This is the biggest road to and from $map:02020041$. Maybe that's why the enemy keeps hammering us here.
Ahh, I want to go home.
Don't worry. I've got my eye on the enemy movements.
Don't worry. I've got my eye on the enemy movements.
There are no signs of an enemy attack, but that can change in an instant. That's why we can't slack off on our patrols!
All's well!
We're doing our best to defend $map:02020041$!
We're doing our best to defend $map:02020041$!
Send me to where the fighting's thickest! I'll crush any enemy in my path!
Umm... Would you mind taking a few of them out while you're here? N-not that I can't take them myself, of course!
Yawn! I need a nap!
Zzz zzz...
Zzz zzz...
Wha? Huh? I'm defendin'... I'm defendin' the base!

Here I figured I'd spend my last years of my service in the capital, then retire and spend the rest of my days on a little farm out by Evansville. But nooo, they had to ship me out to this light-forsaken place...
Who goes there? A bad guy?!
Ah! You startled me!
Ah! You startled me!
You better watch out who you sneak up on. I was two seconds away from tombstoning you!
If you have time to chat, you have time to fight!
I'll speed you along your way.
Want to get there quickly?
Keep your eyes open. I don't like this.
Give me a moment, I'll open up a portal for you to take.
Let me open up a portal so you can get there quickly.
Your pure energy is forming a new portal!
Give me a moment for me to open a portal for you.
I'll help you get there quick.
Let me open up a portal you can take if you want.
You must move quickly. I shall open a portal for you.
Do you know how the hawkers could move so quickly? It's because of this!
Hold on, I'll open up a portal for you.
I'll open up a portal so you can head right over.
Why are you still bothering me? Here, take this portal and go!
Give me a moment. I'll open up a portal so you can be on your way.
You're not going to walk all the way there, are you?
Ah, let me do something nice for you. I'll open a portal.
I'll help you get around quick!
I saw some other people open up a portal... like this. I hope this works!
I'll open up a portal so you can get going.
Ugh... I'm feeling awful but still I have to work...
I'll let you head wherever you want right away. Just give me a moment.
Hold on, you can't just walk there. Time is valuable, you know.
Here, use this portal to go where you want.
Here, take this portal.
Wait! It's going to be a long journey. Use this instead.
Err? Err? What's this? Ouch!
L-let me stand first... Ugh... Your portal is ready.
Let me get up... I'll make a temporary portal...
Stop bothering me. Leave.
Give me a moment, and I'll send you on your way.
Let me help you get going.
I hope this portal won't disrupt local space-time.
This will help you move quickly.
One, two, three! There, a temporary portal for you!
I can no longer use it, but...
Please move as quickly as you can.
Hold on! I'll summon a portal for you.
Wait... Ugh...! Use this portal to get there right away.
Cooking requires focus. Understand?
Ugh...
What?
$MyPCName$, what brings you to me?
Please defend the light...
I hope the power of the Lumarigons remains...
This $map:52010007$ has opened by the power of the Lumenstone in the Sanctuary of Light, somewhere in Nazkar Temple.
What should I do now?
There's only one thing to do. You must retrieve the Lumenstone before its chaotic light is consumed by darkness.
Do you have something to say to me?
I'm glad we've retrieved the Lumenstone, but the war with the Kargons is far from over.
What?
Light and darkness... The war between the Lumarigons and the Kargons isn't over yet. All hope lies on $npcName:11001472[gender:1]$ recovering soon. She alone can save the Lumarigons.
Ugh...
When $npcName:23000068[gender:0]$ returns... Aww... $npcName:11001472[gender:1]$ has to get better soon...
Ugh...
Aww... The Lumenstone... What do we do?
Guys... I-I'm sorry...

W-what do I do now? We finally got the Lumenstone back, but I dropped it into a pool of water. $npcName:11001292[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11001218[gender:1]$ are looking for it... but I can't swim... I feel useless.
You should calm down.
If $npcName:23000068[gender:0]$ finds out we lost the Lumenstone, he'll come after us. Could you hold off $npcName:23000068[gender:0]$ until we get the Lumenstone back?
What brings you here?
I'm scared...
Ah, by the way... what is that?
Ooh... This temple creeps me out. I can't find anyone in this gloomy place...
D-do you see the door over there? I think something awful happened on the other side... I'm scared...
I want to cancel my wedding reservation.
I want to cancel my wedding reservation.
I want to cancel my wedding reservation.
So, how can I help you?
There's so much to study when it comes to demons.
Demons or humans... That's the problem.
So... what do you think about demons?
They must be vanquished!
I hadn't really thought about them.
Indeed? That's what most people think about demons. I don't believe vanquishing them is the best solution. At the very least, we should learn more about their abilities first.
What kinds of abilities do they have?

Oh, many kinds indeed. Most involve temptations used to trick mortals into doing their bidding. The problem is the way those abilities are used, not the demons themselves. There are ways to use demonic abilities for good.
How can you do that?
Well... I can't really say yet. There's so much left unexplained about demons. And even if I found ways to use their powers, I'm not sure I could use them without dire consequences.
What a shame! I can tell by your aura that you're strong enough to handle demons. But if you're not interested, it hardly matters. Remember, there are always demons around us.
These crates are full of supplies sold by the Allicari Merchant Society.
Initiating industriousness protocol! Whistle while you work.
Five out of four humans admit that they're bad at fractions!
I am a library knight, and this is my page!
I may be made of metal, but I never steel.
Bee bee beeeep...
Initiating procrastination protocol! Must this task be done today?
Initiating glib observation protocol! Even machines need time to be oiled.
Beep. Beep. B-beep? Beep...
This is the soldieretto lab. Are you a robot researcher?
This is the soldieretto lab. Are you a robot researcher?
If you do not have any particular business with us, leave. Humans who come here tend to give us more work.
I am giving it my all today. As always.
The life of a soldieretto is not easy.
Non-stop service for Kritias, departing soon!
Tickets to Kritias are free for qualifying heroes!
All aboard the airship for $map:02000001$!
Don't miss your flight back to $map:02000001$!
We stand for peace in Kritias.
Captain $npcName:11004312[gender:1]$ told me she was sending reinforcements. I didn't realize she had meant you.
How are you? Things are going smoothly, I trust?
Not exactly, but I'm getting by. There's a lot that needs doing these days.
Ah... Well, I'm afraid that my request isn't going to make things any easier...
What is it?

There are resources nearby—resources Humanitas desperately needs. We'd been battling the Tairen for control of the area and making good ground, but then they received reinforcements from the capital...
Were there many casualties?
We've only had some injuries, thank goodness. I'm more concerned about the ground we've lost; We need those supplies. Your mission is to secure $map:02020004$. Can I count on you?
Sigh...
$npcName:11004324[gender:0]$ is sweet, but sometimes I just need to be by myself.
I'm worried...
How can I get $npcName:11004323[gender:1]$ to change her mind? We should be in Victoria Island, not here!
I don't know about this...
Our first steps in a new world. I should be excited, but all I feel is nervous...
Our first steps in a new world. I should be excited, but all I feel is nervous...
Can I help you?
Everything is going just as I envisioned it!
Things are going just as I planned.
You're here for work? Great! Let's get started.
What's this new business of yours?
What should I be doing?
What are the job requirements?
Hehe. It really is a novel business model, isn't it? I guess I can tell you, if you're going to be working here.
Maple World's a pretty big place, but as we've developed newer, faster ways to travel, our systems of trade haven't really kept up.
People want things they can't get locally. Some people in $map:02000023$ might be starved for electronics from $map:02000100$, or others in $map:02010002$ might want handicrafts from Nerman artists.
The thing is, not everybody can afford to trot around the globe shopping for things they want. That's where my shop comes in.
Customers place their orders online for an item, and I acquire it for them. Then all they have to do is come in and pick up their merchandise. No muss, no fuss!

I've spent a long time building this business, and I've pretty much cornered the market. To do what I do, you need all kinds of connections and a shrewd business acumen. Luckily, I've got that in spades!
You will be working as a team with your three friends. One of you will work the cash register, the rest of you will work in the warehouse.
Customers come to the store to pick up their orders. All you have to do is find their items in the warehouse and ring them up at the counter. Easy, right?
When a customer comes to the counter, the cashier must greet them. The customer will tell you which item they've come to pick up, and the cashier relays that information to the warehouse workers.
The warehouse workers will need to find and bring the item to the cashier. Cathy Mart prides itself in its service, so the faster the better.
Also, keep in mind that the store has an automatic cleaning system to keep the place nice and tidy.
That means that any item from the warehouse you leave lying around will be removed very soon after. That's why it's crucial you give the item to the customer directly.

Do you have two or more grasping appendages? Can you lift things? You're hired! I don't care about your age, job, level, or any of that nonsense. All I need you to do is work together to fulfill customers' orders with blinding speed.
The four of you must work together from the moment the store opens until it closes. No quitting, and no breaks!
Wait, what happens if someone quits?
For your own sake, let's hope that doesn't happen.
The air is calm and the water is clear. It's a perfect day to fish!
The key to fishing is to listen to the sounds they make.
If you try hard enough, you can even hear them talk!
My relief should be here soon...
This is $npcName:11004401[gender:1]$'s office. I don't know what your business is, but you watch yourself around $npcName:11004401[gender:1]$.
This is $npcName:11004401[gender:1]$'s office. I don't know what your business is, but you watch yourself around $npcName:11004401[gender:1]$.
Ah, I need to get off my feet...
You! Outlander! You better not be here to bother $npcName:11004401[gender:1]$.
You! Outlander! You better not be here to bother $npcName:11004401[gender:1]$.
We stand for peace in Kritias.
Have you tried the sobfish? They're salty.
My chassis may be bronze, but I'm actually well-read!
Initiating shushing protocol! Please be quiet.
Ugh... I hate deadlines...
Ugh... I hate deadlines...
Here to gawk at the soldierettos? Get a good look and then be on your way. I can't concentrate with all you... all you tourists hanging about!
I can't believe my luck...
I can't believe my luck...
This place is amazing! Just this morning alone, I discovered three new molecules and a new kind of superconductor!
Can't you see I'm on edge? Leave me alone!
Hey, I'm on your side.
<font color="#909090">(The rafflesia is highly toxic. This one seems to be slumbering. Try not to wake it up.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(The rafflesia is highly toxic. This one seems to be slumbering. Try not to wake it up.)</font>
Puny humans...
Puny humans...
Well, good luck!
Thank you!
I'll definitely pay you a visit.
Cool.
Good for you!
Thanks! I appreciate your support.
That seems like a conversation you should have with her.
I've tried! Maybe you can talk some sense into her?
I look forward to hearing all about it.
Indeed!
Same old Orde.
Hey, you know them don't you? Do you think you could introduce me? Please? Hey, where are you going?!
You too. Take care of yourself.
Oh, you don't have to worry about me.
What is it?
Let's get to business.
What is it?
Those slimeballs...
Ahhh, I want to get better soon so I can go on adventures again!
I want to get better soon so I can go on adventures again!
Cough, cough! Aww, my legs...
How soon until I can sail again? Cough, cough! I want to be well so I can set off to find the wonders of the world.
$MyPCName$, thank you for telling me about your adventures! I hope I can get better so I can have my own adventures, too.
<font color="#909090">(You see a wooden cabin weathered by wind and sea.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(Is someone inside this cabin? You can hear voices.)</font>
Sniff, sniff... Chorrie is scared... Too many evil people out there.
Sniff, sniff...
I hate pirates... I hate them!
No, no. Don't. I don't know anything. I really don't.
Aww, it's okay. Take it easy.
Sob... No one knows how I feel. Why can't I be left alone? Sob...
Can I help you?
$MyPCName$, I'm sorry you came all the way here for nothing.
Can I help you?
Hello, little friend!
I hate humans...
Hello, how may I help you?
If you want to know about playing music in $map:02000064$, I'm here to help.
If you want to know how to perform, I can help.
Hello, how may I help you?
How can I play music in $map:02000064$?
How can I get to the stage?
How can I cheer during a performance?
All you have to do to perform in $map:02000064$ is apply! Just press the request button. If someone else has already applied, you'll need to wait 10 minutes and then apply again when they're done.
How can I play as a group?
For ensemble performances, form a party with someone who has applied to perform. After that you can all take the stage together.
It's super easy to perform in a group! So, is there anything else you want to know?
How can I get to the stage?
How can I cheer during a performance?
No, I think I'm good.
We'll let you up on stage if you're going to perform. Just hit the apply button and we'll let you know when it's time.
If you want to leave the stage, just hit the same button you used to get up there. That was an easy one. Anything else?
How can I play music in $map:02000064$?
How can I cheer during a performance?
No, I think I'm good.
Everyone in $map:02000064$ can hear performances from the stage. Show your appreciation by lighting firecrackers, waving glowsticks, or just clapping!
Cheers and applause encourage the performers, so let 'em have it! Anything else you want to know?
How can I play music in $map:02000064$?
How can I get to the stage?
No, I think I'm good.
Great! Come on back if you have any more questions about performing in $map:02000064$.
$MyPCName$, what brings you to me?
Descendant... of Light...
It was no small task to recover the power of light. I pray it will never be overshadowed by darkness.
What... is it?
I can sense... the power in this light...
What... is it?
I can sense... the power in this light...
Amazing.
Of course it is. Why, it's astonishing, even!
I hope you figure it out.
So do I, my friend. So do I.
Okay.
I leave it to you!
Beats me.
I'm sure it means something. The captain isn't the sort to name things all willy-nilly.
Good luck with that.
Thank you!
I'm sure it'll happen.
I just want to lose myself in my research!
Amazing!
There's no shortage of amazing things in Kritias. That's why I'm so busy with research!
That would be incredible.
And that's why we've got to learn everything we can about aetherine.
That's pretty handy.
Well, it's just a theory.
I'm a bit curious, too.
It's worth researching. This could revolutionize building techniques all over the empire.
Incredible!
Astonishing, too!
Okay.
I need to learn more about this facility.
That's bad news.
We need to stop them before they spread any further.
Ah, yes. Fascinating.
Is there some connection between aetherine and life energy? I'll have to do more science to know for sure.
Let's get to business.
...Finally, the time has come.
Can I help you?
There's work to be done.
All systems are operational!
How may I help you today, $male:Sir,female:Ma'am$?
What is it?
Those slimeballs...
<font color="#909090">(There's an odd grouping of large claw marks here.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(There's an odd grouping of large claw marks here.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(This must have been left by a $npcName:11003781[gender:0]$.)</font>
(Take a picture.)
<font color="#909090">(This might be a clue. You take a picture of the markings to show them to $npcName:11003536[gender:0]$.)</font>
Hey, do you need a Valentine chocolate box and some sprinkles? I've got some that I can give you. If you keep making chocolate every day, you'll get a special gift!
Hey, do you need a Valentine chocolate box and some sprinkles? I've got some that I can give you. If you keep making chocolate every day, you'll get a special gift!
Give me a $item:30001287$ and $item:30001288$!
Here you go! I hope you save some chocolate for me!
Oh! Your bag is full. Try again after you make some space in your bag.

The best chocolate tastes like a little nugget of love! You've still got some ingredients, so you're good to make more on your own for now. I'll give you more if you need them, of course, but keep in mind that you can only make 3 chocolates a day.
I have no missions for you right now.
Sorry, but I don't have any missions just yet.
Return to me when the time is right.
It's really you! $MyPCName$, in the flesh!
It's an honor to meet you!
You know me?
You're the hero of the Siege of $map:02000001$. Of course I know you! You're a hero to all of us here.
I was just doing my duty.
You're so humble. Wow! Listen, if there's anything I can do to help you, just say the word.
I'm looking into rumors about hot places. Like, super hot.
Hot places, huh? Like unseasonably hot places?
That's one example.
Now that you mention it, I did hear a rumor from one of the merchants with the Barrota Trading Company. You heard about their new air trade routes, didn't you?
I may have heard a thing or two.
Well, a few of their routes pass over the ruins of Orbis. They say that the airships passing through the area get so hot, you can fry an egg on their decks.
Interesting, right?
Fascinating.

I don't think anyone hates flowers, right? Everyone has to have a favorite flower or two.
Can I help you?
I didn't come to look at these flowers because they're pretty.
If you love flowers so much, then go pick them yourself. These aren't for you.
What is it?
I can make supplements and scented candles with these. Amazing!
I don't like pretty things. I like USEFUL things.
Everyone likes flowers because they're pretty. I don't care about that, because I use them to make supplements, scented candles, and potions.
Oh my, it's impossible to enchant this gear any further. Don't look glum. It's already really strong!
I know you're the type who likes to rise to any challenge, but even you and your gear have limits. And sometimes, it's wiser to quit than to try to push things past their natural limit.
That piece of gear is beyond my ability to enchant. The $itemPlural:40100023$ required would become too instable during the process, you see. Even $npc:11000508[gender:1]$ agrees with me on that one.
Everyone has a piece of gear or two that they feel sentimental about. I have an entire closet full. But love isn't enough to allow you to enchant your gear an unlimited number of times.
I may look cute, but I'm a killer! Tee-hee!
For the honor of $map:02000051$!
I'm gonna break you like a +14 legendary!
Welcome to the $map:52000116$. I am $npcName:11003163[gender:0]$. If you have any questions regarding the caravans, feel free to ask.
Man, I never seem to have time to rest.
I wonder if Mother is doing well... I should visit her...

My job is to make sure $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ and the other members of the royal family have everything they desire. I'm always busy, but I take pride in my position and my service to $map:02000025$.
These matters are not normally my responsibility, of course, but $npcName:11003165[gender:0]$ asked for me personally due to the... sensitive nature.
Have you been to $map:02000076$? My mother lives there. I really should visit her, but I've been so busy that I haven't had the time since preparations began.
Once my work here is done, I'll go and visit her first thing! I've been sending her letters, it's just... she can't see. A disease took her eyesight. Sigh...
Whew! That was a close one.
I'm not so sure about this mission...
I'm so nervous! I need to use the bathroom!
You really pulled me out of the fire.
What are you talking about?
You're welcome, I guess?
You drove off that big, bad doggy! If it weren't for you... Jeez, I'd really be in a pickle.
You... do know how to fight, don't you?
Sure do! I even fought a rogue $npcName:21000001$ once! I mean, I lost, but I sure gave it my best!
Aw, jeez. I don't know about that look you're giving me...
You really know a thing or two about being a hero, don't you? Wow!
A hero...?
Yeah, a real, live hero! One day I'll be just like you. Just you wait!
How do you fare?
We were ambushed so close to the palace.
I never expected we'd be attacked there... did someone leak our information?
$npc:11001853[gender:0]$ says there's nothing wrong with you, but I need to be sure. How do you feel?
I'm fine.
I'm a bit sore...
Good.
Really? We should look into that. I'll have $npc:11001853[gender:0]$ schedule you for some exploratory surgery.
Th-that really isn't necessary!
It's no trouble. After all you did out on the field, this is the least we can do.
You were glowing when we found you. How did you do that?
I really don't remember.
I see. So it wasn't intentional.
All's well!
I'm pretty nervous about my first time in the field.
I'm lucky to work in such a beautiful place.
How may I help you?
Have you seen anyone in a mask go through here?
I sure did! Hard not to notice someone that odd. He ran off toward the Kerning Interchange.
What is it?
Doesn't dancing make you thirsty? Have some juice!
Doesn't playing games make you thirsty? Have some juice!
I'm too busy hosting the game right now. We'll talk later, okay?
Wassup, man?
Hey yo!
This is our moment!
Everybody shout, $npcName:11001527[gender:0]$!
Wassup, man? Whatcha need?
This place is lit, man!
The boogie to the boogety beat!
Show me what you got!
Wassup! Got questions?
How do you play Dance, Dance, Stop?
I got eliminated. It's not fair!
What are you doing here?
When the numbers appear on the floor panels, hop on them! If you match the number of dancers to the number, you go on to the next round. Otherwise... you're out!
How do you win?
I don't know how to dance.
Last 5 rounds, and you win. But the longer the game goes on, the less time you have to get on a panel. If you're a quick thinker and a fast runner, you can win... even if you're a terrible dancer!
Do you have any tips?
I'll win next time!

You know I do! Dancing isn't just fun—it's a great way to get experience. Once you're on a tile for 2 or more dancers, you can block others from joining you. This is a great way to lock down a tricky number and get a fabulous bonus.

Just press the action key to block others from joining your panel. You can't leave the tile while you're doing this, so when you're done be sure to press the action key again. But the most important tip I have... is to have fun!
I'll win next time!
That's the spirit! Keep it real, my friend. Keep it real.
Don't even sweat it. Just press the yellow light on the floor, and bam! It's dance time! Press the action key to boogie down with some random dance moves.
How do you win?
I'll win next time!
Don't let it get to you, my downtrodden dancer. Even if you're eliminated, there's a special dance floor where you can strut yourself. Just go to the yellow stage and press the action key!
What's the secret to winning the game?
I'll win next time!
My soul mate, $npcName:11001527[gender:0]$, has become a DJ. I'm here to support $npcName:11001527[gender:0]$ and rock it 'til the wheels fall off! Get on this, $MyPCName$!
Whoo! This place is bumpin'!
You want to know how to play?
Move to the beat!
Show me what you got!
Whoa there! Ask me questions if you got 'em!
How do you play Dance, Dance, Stop?
I got eliminated. It's not fair!

You feel that? That's music.

Move to the beat!

Dance and play! It's not hard if you're having fun.
I'll teach you how to play.
Feel the rhythm. Fantastic!
Dance on the lighted stage!
Dance and play! It's not hard if you're having fun.

The best way to know how someone really feels is to watch him dance. I learn so much about human emotion by studying the dancers here.
Are you here to see me?
Psst! Hey, you. I've got some good stuff here. Interested?
Just, uh... keep this to yourself, got it?
Oooh ooh ooh!
Oooh ooh ooh!
What do you want?
I call the shots here.
Unless this is extremely important, I'm in no mood to chat.
Did you see a guard get dragged away?
Now that you mention it, there was an especially pitiful-looking soldier... He was dragged off in the direction of $map:52000119$, to the northeast.
I don't have time for small potatoes.
How can I get anything done with these idiots?
It's been too long since Blackstar faced a real challenge. I'd better call a meeting...
I don't know you, so I'll warn you once: Don't cross me.
Looking for quality equipment? I've got stuff you can usually only get in dungeons. Take a look if you're interested.
What are you offering?
Where do you get all of this from?
Is it really good quality stuff?

I'm selling boxes with items from different dungeons. If you mainly explore dungeons to find good equipment, you'll definitely like what I sell. Buy from me, and you don't have to risk your neck exploring dungeons.
What exactly is in these boxes?
Beats me. They've got everything from highly valuable equipment to useless junk. What you get depends on your luck.
Oh, I nearly forgot the most important thing. Every time you open a box, your reward count for the corresponding dungeon decreases.

What a brazen way to ask for all of my trade secrets! Adventurers have all kinds of reasons to explore dungeons, like discovering the rare treasures they contain. I suppose you could call them treasure hunters, and they're good at what they do.
Naturally, some of them do business with merchants like me. Beyond that, all you need to know is that I have my own supply routes.

Good quality? What do you take me for, a cheat? I swear on my reputation as a businessman, I don't know what's inside these boxes any more than you do. If I did, you can bet I'd have priced each box according to its value.
But as you can see, I'm selling them at set low prices. It's not about my capacity for swindling. It's about your luck. So don't blame me if you do get junk from your box.
Sh! You'll give me away!
I didn't come all the way out here for nothing...
A lovely day for some exercise, don't you think? One-two, one-two!
One, two, three, four! Feel that stretch in your joints! Two, two! Three, four!
My back... Maybe I should take five.
The air is so bracing out here! Care to join me?
I, um... I like your hat.
Aren't you a darling? I hear this is the hottest design in $map:02010002$ nowadays! My brother, $npcName:11000167[gender:0]$, picked it up for me.
You're lucky to have such a great brother.
Don't I know it! He always looks out for me, even when he's off in the field. But lately, he hasn't been himself. Not since he had to give up hunting.
Why did $npcName:11000167[gender:0]$ give up hunting?
His wife hates it. She got sick of him coming home with all manner of wounds. Of course I worry about him, too, but this is his calling. A man can't be happy if he can't follow his calling.

Doesn't matter what I think, of course. $npcName:11000167[gender:0]$ agreed to stop hunting and go into business in $map:02000036$. He seems awful miserable to me, but what do I know? I'm just his sister.
Ah now, let me guess... You want to enchant your gear? Let's have a look, then!
How about we change some bonus attributes?
Tell me about your work.

That's not all! Aside from functioning as weaponry or armor, high-grade gear grants special abilities. But there's a catch: These abilities are completely random! If you would prefer gear that better suits your needs, I can help you modify it as you like.

This is a new service we blacksmiths provide, thanks to a breakthrough out of the research center in $map:02000270$. Those eggheads figured out how to refine meteoric ores into these $itemPlural:40100026$ that I can use to change the chemical properties in your gear.

Now, don't get your hopes all the way up. $itemPlural:40100026$ are tricky to work with, so I might not be able to get all the bonuses on your item to exactly what you want. I also need $itemPlural:40100001$, $itemPlural:40100002$, $itemPlural:40100003$, or $itemPlural:40100021$ to work with, and that's up to you to get.
Do you want to change the bonus attributes on your gear? Then pick an item to change! Just remember that it needs to be epic or better armor and accessories at level 50 and above.

So you want to change the bonus attributes on this gear, eh? Sounds good to me! Hey, why the anxious look on your face? If you don't like the new attributes, you can always keep the old ones, and then just try to change them again.
I understand you want to change the bonus attributes on your gear, but I can't help you if you don't have the materials, Silly! Come back when you've got the right stuff, yeah?

Okay, then! See if you like any of these new attributes. You can choose anything you like. If you don't choose anything, then the new attributes will automatically overwrite the old ones. Choose carefully!

How do you feel about the change of attributes? Overjoyed? Devastated? Ready to sue me? I hope not, ha ha! But seriously, if you're not happy, you can always try to change the attributes again. I'll be here. Just bring the materials!
Oh, wow. This gear is a little above my pay grade. Could I help you with anything less advanced?
How about we change some bonus attributes?
Tell me about your work.
Oh! One more thing! I'm sure you know that some high-grade gear grant random special abilities. If you're interested in modifying those abilities, I can help!

This is a brand new service blacksmiths can provide, thanks to a breakthrough at the $map:02000270$ research center. Hehe. They've refined meteoric ores into $itemPlural:40100026$ that can change the chemical properties in gear!

Of course, bonus attributes are hard to rely on since the results are so random. And in addition to $itemPlural:40100026$, you'll also need $itemPlural:40100001$, $itemPlural:40100002$, $itemPlural:40100003$, or $itemPlural:40100021$, depending on the work being done.
Oh! Of course! Just pick an item for me to work on. Remember, I only handle epic and legendary armor and accessories level 50 and above.
Is this the gear you want to change? Okay! Don't worry, if you don't like the new attributes, you can keep the old ones.
I would love to change your bonus attributes for you! I just need the necessary materials, hehe.
What do you think? Do you like the new attributes? Remember, if you don't choose anything, the new attributes will automatically be applied.
If you're not satisfied with the current attributes, you can always try again. Just bring the materials, hehe.
Oh, dear. This gear is a bit advanced for me. Could I help you with a different piece, perhaps?
If you've got scrap metal, we can do business. Otherwise, I got too much on my mind to waste talking to you. Those scoundrels are ruining the neighborhood...
How's business?
Well, let's see. Ralph's goons moved in, took over the yard, and ran off my best workers. What do you think?
My business is in sorry shape thanks to them.
You don't look like the usual beach bums we get around here. What do you want?
Did you remember your books?
Of course you didn't. I don't know what I expected.
How did you find me...?
What do I do now?
Why can't love be simple for once?
I cannot help but sigh... <font color="#909090">She sighs.</font>
Everyone knows I'm the best smith... on this street.

Great artisans are a dime-a-dozen in $map:2000076$. This is the place to be if you aim to make a living at crafting. It makes competition fierce, sure, but that only forces me to push myself harder. And it's kind of inspirational, being around all these people who live for their craft.

Anyway, if you want to strengthen your equipment, come to me. Just remember that you'll need to bring some special materials. You probably know which ones... the $itemPlural:40100001$, $itemPlural:40100023$, and $itemPlural:40100024$ that $map:2000051$ is so famous for.

You can get $itemPlural:40100023$ by dismantling gear that's level 20 or higher. Just use the Dismantle button in your inventory window. As for $itemPlural:40100024$, that comes at a much higher cost. It only comes from dismantling gear that is epic or better.
People compete for $itemPlural:40100023$ in the Personal Arena, so you could go there. If you think you can win, that is...

By the way, Elliana got ahold of yet another strange weapon, and she's been begging me to enchant it for her. I told her such flashy, impractical weapons like that can't be enchanted, but she doesn't listen. Why can't she just accept that only items marked as "Can be Enchanted" can, well, be enchanted?

That's not all! Aside from functioning as weaponry or armor, high-grade gear imparts special abilities. But there's a catch: these abilities are completely random! If you would prefer gear that better suits your needs, I can help you modify the gear.

Have you heard about $itemPlural:40100026$? They were invented by those eggheads in $map:02000270$. I hear they're made from real meteors! With a material like that, I can change the bonus attributes on a piece of gear.

It's not some magic bullet, of course. There's no telling what new attribute you'll wind up with. And don't forget, I also need $itemPlural:40100001$, $itemPlural:40100002$, $itemPlural:40100003$, or $itemPlural:40100021$ to go with the $itemPlural:40100026$.
Okay, let's see the gear you want to enchant. I'm warning you now, it has to be marked with "Can be Enchanted."
Hm. It is my expert opinion that this gear is not stable enough to be enchanted any further! You'll need to bring me different gear if you want me to help you.

You didn't forget that enchanting gear requires materials, did you? $itemPlural:40100001$ are available for purchase from gear merchants and supply merchants. You can get $itemPlural:40100023$ by dismantling gear that's level 20 or higher. Just use the Dismantle button in your inventory window. As for the $itemPlural:40100024$, that comes at a much higher cost. It only comes from dismantling gear that is epic or better.
Wow! This is legendary! Where did you get it? I see gear from all over the world every day, but nothing like this. This is something truly special.
Whoa, this is a legendary item. I can't compensate you for anything that happens to such a valuable piece, so you need to be willing to assume all risk.
This has never been enchanted, not even once. You'll be very happy when you see how much better I can make it.
You've never tried to enchant this gear? Just wait till you see what I can do with it!
Never-enchanted gear? That's great. It should be really easy to enchant this gear for the first time.

This gear... Have I really failed in enchanting it 100 times? Gee. This hurts my pride. But you know what a blacksmith with real grit would do? Not give up! So let's try it again, this time with more experience and wiser minds, yeah?

But you've already tried to enchant this gear 100 times, and it's been a failure each and every time. You're going to ask me to enchant it no matter what I say, aren't you? Wow, you're stubborner than I am. All right, no guarantees it'll work, but here goes!

Have you really tried and failed to enchant this gear 1,000 times? I can't believe it! I thought I was stubborn, but I have nothing on you. Maybe all of us craftspeople on this street should give you an award for Best Customer.
Hm. It is my expert opinion that this gear is not stable enough to be enchanted any further! You'll need to bring me different gear if you want me to help you.
Hm. It is my expert opinion that this gear is not stable enough to be enchanted any further! You'll need to bring me different gear if you want me to help you.
I can't enchant this. I could hone my enchanting skills for the next hundred years, and I still wouldn't be able to do it. This gear is just too strong. You should be satisfied with it as it is.
I know you're the type who likes to rise to any challenge, but even you and your gear have limits. And sometimes, it's wiser to quit than to try to push things past their natural limit.
I can't enchant this gear any further. It's so unstable that it could blow up the whole street if I fail. You'll need to find someone with more expertise.
I understand you want to make your gear stronger. But some things just can't be done. It's already at a level that would scare away most blacksmiths. Don't get greedy.

Yes, I remember how happy you were last time, totally ignoring all logic and tempting fate. It seemed insane, but I have to admit... it was an incredible day for me... But look, as glorious as that was, I can't enchant this item any further! By golly, I'd need another decade of practice, at the very least!
Put your mind at ease. Only another earthquake could make me fail at this simple of an enchantment.

Don't worry, I could do this with one hand tied behind my back. In fact, I could do a lot of smithing one-handed if I could just find someone to be my striker! Interested? Okay, okay, I can see you just want the enchantment... let's do this, then.
This enchantment will be so easy, it would actually be more difficult to fail than to succeed! You'd be foolish to pass up on those odds, I'd say.
There's very little chance of error when the enchantment is this simple. Want me to give it a try?
Enchanting this gear will be a little tricky, but certainly not impossible. It's up to you, but I'd say the risk is well worth the potential reward.
This will be a piece of cake. Just believe in me a little!
Let's see... This gear has only been enchanted a handful of times, so I shouldn't have too much trouble with it... as long as you don't distract me!
I should be able to enchant this gear safely, as long as you don't distract me with incessant chatting or stares, so find something to occupy yourself while I'm working.
Due to previous enchantments, there's some risk if you want me to enchant this gear. But still, there's a much greater chance that I will succeed. It's up to you.

Good news! Even though this item has been enchanted multiple times, it's still pretty stable. There's a chance that the new enchantment could go wrong, but that comes with the territory. It's your call.
There's an elevated chance of failure if I enchant this item, but it's not so high to really worry me. If it doesn't worry you either, go ahead and press the Enchant button.
I'm pretty confident about this. And don't worry; if it doesn't work, you can always try again!
I'm going to give it a go, now. And hey, if I mess up, you can always try again!
This is just too easy. Check it out!
To +7, huh? Shouldn't be too hard. Hand it over!
This gear is a little delicate, but I'll use some finesse, and it should be fine.
Everybody makes mistakes, but this one should be no problem!
You know, the chances of successful enchantment for this piece are lower than I'd like, but I'll do it if you want me to.

This gear is within my ability to enchant, sure. But the chance of failure is a bit high, and I'm telling you that when other blacksmiths won't, because they're not as honest. So, do what you will with that information.
Think carefully. Your chances at enchanting this gear are pretty low. I mean, sure, you can always try again in the event of failure, but that'll cost another batch of materials.
Anything under +9 is easy. There's nothing to worry about at those levels.
The truth about enchanting gear is that it requires both skill and luck.
Blacksmithing is tough, but fascinating. When I look into the flames, I feel like a god.
Sure, it'd be great if enchantments never failed. But then again, that would make us blacksmiths go broke! Ha ha!
It worked! Told you I'm the best blacksmith on this street.
See? No problem at all!
The enchantment was successful! Here you are... nice doing business with ya!
Your materials were excellent, and the enchantment worked! A great day's work for both of us.
I told you, this is nothing! Choose me again next time!
It worked! And you deserve a lot of the credit. Your persistence made this possible.
I've succeeded in a +10 enchantment! I'm glad we went for it!
I made it +11! I gotta tell everyone I know!
Huh? Did that enchantment really succeed just now? Yes! The gear's +12 now! I'm better than I thought!
This can't be true. Did I really make it +13? Oh my... I mean, part of it is luck, but still, I think I need to increase my prices!
+14... This is unbelievable! $MyPCName$, this is the greatest achievement of my life! Congratulations! Congratulations on owning such amazing gear!
+15...? P-plus fif-fifteen? I... <font color="#909090">(She's too shocked to speak.)</font>
Did you see that?! The item shook a little, but I kept control over it and the enchantment was successful! That was close, but what a reward! Here's your improved item!
It worked! My skill aside, the materials you brought were truly excellent. We work well together. I hope you choose me again next time!

Uh-oh. It seems the ratio of $itemPlural:40100023$ was off. That caused some destabilization, and it decreased your gear's enchantment level by one. I'm sorry; I misjudged the carbon content in your gear.
I knew the $itemPlural:40100023$ were too unstable. Your gear's enchantment level has decreased by one. I'm sorry, but I'm sure I warned you...
What...? This shouldn't have happened! I can't believe it, is it because I saw a black cat on my way to work today?
Oh, the enchantment failed. It's not our fault... Whoever made this gear didn't case-harden it enough, so it's random chance whether it can tolerate enchantments.
I thought it'd be easy. What did I do wrong? I'll practice more and get better.
This has never happened before... and when I said it was going to be so easy! It must have been something random, like my hand slipping...

Oh no! Your gear got damaged! I'm sorry, oh gosh, I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to! Look, I managed to save these $itemPlural:40100025$. Please, take them. At least if you collect enough of those, you could find some use for them.
I feared this would happen, and now my fears have come true. The gear can no longer be enchanted. Its enchantment level has been retained, but that's all the good news there is.

Who is $npc:11000074[gender:0]$?

Tell me about the War Chief.
Tell me about Vayar Mountain.

What could I possibly have to discuss with you? You and I have nothing in common. Are you looking for magical body-building tips or something? We of the arcane arts don't waste our time trying to enhance our physical forms, as we know that the font of our power lies within.

Ultimate potential? Suuuure, I can help. Unleash your "ultimate potential" with my patented brew of enchanted smoothies! They can be yours for the low, low price of 1,200 mesos! Pffft. You sound like you've been roped into some kind of scam.
Honestly, we don't care about politics or the empress's court... nor do we care who you are. Our interests lie in more scholarly pursuits.
What do you care about, then?
Do you know what caused the earthquake?
There's another subject I'd like to ask you about.
$MyPCName$, do you believe in... the Light?
I only believe in what I can see.
The Light shines on everyone, regardless of their belief or lack of belief.
What's the Light ever done for the poor of $map:02000100$?

I believe the ordeals we experience throughout life are ultimately blessings in disguise, arranged by the Light. Hardship happens for a reason. I shall pray for you and everyone else. May the Light's blessing be with you wherever you go.
Let's talk about something else.
I'm afraid you cannot join the priesthood, as you've already chosen your path. Nonetheless, I pray for your prosperity.
Did the earthquake cause a lot of damage?
Who is $npc:11000075[gender:1]$?
Let's change the subject.
$MyPCName$, you remind me of an arrow that's just been loosed from its bow.
How so?
Because... you seem like somebody that never looks back, someone who simply moves forward in spite of uncertainty.
It's too bad you've decided not to join the Green Hoods. Still, we'd greatly appreciate any assistance you're willing to offer punishment to those who bear ill will for the people of these lands.
Tell me about the Green Hoods.
Tell me about the criminals.
Let's talk about something else.

True warriors rely on more than their weapons.
You don't know what you're talking about. My cannon could blow you to pieces in a single second!

That's ridiculous! You know what, you're just no fun. Get lost.
Hm, you're not a Heavy Gunner, $MyPCName$. You know what that means? You don't know how to have fun!
Tell me about that weapon of yours.
What's there to do around here?
I want to ask you about something else.
Stop bothering me. The only people worth talking to are Thieves, and you're obviously not—wait! You... You're...
You know me?

You've got me mistaken for someone else.
Hm... You're a bad liar. Your eyes give you away. But still, it's interesting to know that major players like you have come out of hiding.
$MyPCName$, I can tell you how to get what you want. Oh, wait... I see now you're not a Thief. Well, then you wouldn't even know what freedom is. Just go along your merry way.
Okay, try me. What's freedom?
Oh yeah? How can I get anything I want?
I don't want to talk about this anymore.
You're the famed Gray Wolf. Look, let me give you some advice: watch your back.
Is that a threat?
Think of it as a professional courtesy. Your name has been off and on our hit list for some time now.
Are you going to come after me, then?
Not me, no. I'm not foolish enough to tangle with the Gray Wolf. By the way, I never thought you'd come out of the shadows. That's a fascinating development.
This place is making me uncomfortable. I mean, it's interesting, but it's not what I like.
What's making you so uncomfortable?
Is there something wrong?

Let's talk about something else.

+10 is decent. Do you really need to enchant this further? You're really gonna go for it, aren't you?

<font color="#909090">(The lava is eerily silent, but the heat is blistering. There's an inscription on this statue.)</font>
Fifteen hundred years ago, a great earthquake gave birth to this volcano. The nearby forests were destroyed, and in the hot springs gave rise to a new and exotic ecosystem.
The basaltic lava from the volcano influenced the weapons and ceramics used by the local population. But there's more to the lava than precious metals...
<font color="#909090">(There's a story about the birth of the $npcName:22000005$ that lives within the mountain further down in the inscription...)</font>
Long ago, there was a lava eye named Round Eye. It was the runt of its clutch, and all the other lava eyes teased it for its size.

One summer, it dived into the lava river under Hotottot Mountain to try to prove that it was strong, but it was swept away in the lava flow. Rather than help Round Eye out of the river, the other lava eyes mocked their stunted sibling.
Round Eye couldn't take it anymore. It closed its eye and let the lava flow carry it away. "Nobody will miss me," it told itself...
As it drifted away, it prayed that one day it would be reborn as a big, powerful lava eye someday...
Round Eye wasn't seen for a long time after that. Soon, the other lava eyes began to realize that it was gone for good, and there was much fiery weeping at the $map:02000039$.
Then, one day, a gout of lava gushed forth from the mountain, followed by an earth-shattering roar.
The $npcName:22000005$ emerged from the chasm, shocking the rest of the lava eyes. And yet, this monster seemed somehow familiar to them... It was Round Eye!
Overjoyed, the other lava eyes asked it how it had survived. Hahoi, the guardian spirit of the $map:02000039$, had heard Round Eyes' prayer and shown pity.
From that day forth, Round Eye and its fellow lava eyes lived happily on the $map:02000039$, working together to lift each other up.
<font color="#909090">(This fountain is built directly into the $map:02000046$. A steady supply of molten lava gushes from its basin.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(This fountain is built directly into the $map:02000046$. A steady supply of molten lava gushes from its basin.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(A field journal's been left next to the fountain. It has Silver Wolf's name on it.)
For generations, we believed $map:02000046$ was a natural formation. However, I'm beginning to think otherwise...
While scouting out the area, I noticed that the lava flows in a precise circular path. I scouted out the nearby cave systems, and I can find no source of the lava underground.
This must be the work of powerful magic. If that's the case, then whoever did this must be trying to protect something within the Hourglass.
I still don't know why the lava is circling the mountain, but whatever the reason, I'm sure it's important. And perhaps valuable...
There's a lost temple that was used as a tomb for the great chieftains in ages past. Could this actually be the site of that temple? And how does one get inside...?
<font color="#909090">(This big, beautiful sculpture spans the lake at $map:02000038$. There's a plaque bearing an inscription on top.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(This big, beautiful sculpture spans the lake at $map:02000038$. There's a plaque bearing an inscription on top.)</font>

The "Rainbow Bridge" is the final work of Mandy, the genius architect responsible for the design of numerous famous buildings. Its purpose, and the significance of its design may never be known, as construction didn't start until after her death.
The fact that the arch was constructed with such unusual materials—and that it is called a bridge despite functioning more as an obstacle than a pathway—are hallmarks of Mandy's famed eccentricity.
Local legends tell of a portal to a magical land on the shore below the bridge's construction site.
Whether you find this portal or not, we hope you enjoy the beautiful scenery here on the Rainbow Bridge.
Tch! Don't tell me I got caught... Your senses are sharp, I'll give you that.
Why are you hiding here?
This place, the $map:02000262$, was created by us, the luditionists. I'm taking a quick peek to ensure everything is running smoothly. And by smoothly, I mean with lots of exciting incidents.
A world without incidents is boring, hmm? We don't want a boring world.
What does a luditionist do?
Hush, now. Don't ask too many questions or you'll get hurt. Let's just say that we're trying to make things more fun.
<font color="#909090">(You see a message that appears to be written in chalk.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(You see a message that appears to be written in chalk.)</font>
(The writing is barely legible.) Ah, my love, my love! Your blue eyes and wavy golden hair haunt me! There's no way you could know my feelings, but my heart will explode if I don't write them down!
Are you an angel? I heard a tale that you were born from the goddess of light, but to me, you are the goddess of light!
Can you blame me if I despise F? He is the only one who can be near you. Although I'm just one of many guards right now, one day I will be at your side!

<font color="#909090">(The bubbling water behind this statue is just the right temperature. There's a plaque on the totem.)</font>
Dealing with aches? Pains? Fatigue? Skin blemishes? Then take a soak at these world-renown hot springs! A five minute soak in these naturally heated waters is all you need to feel like a new person!
It's breezy up here!
It's breezy up here!
Huh? What do you want?
$npcName:11000367$'s owner is worried...
That's too bad. $npcName:11000367$ and I were meant for each other. It was fate.
How'd you two meet, anyway?
How is that any of your business? Let's just say that Skittle saved me from a really tough situation.
You should just wish us happiness, okay?
<font color="#909090">(This statue marks the final resting place of a great warrior from Perion.)</font>
<font color="#909090">(This statue marks the final resting place of a great warrior from Perion.)</font>
Even on the darkest night, the great Guardian of Wolfclaw Canyon fought without a hint of fear in his heart.
Oh, brave warrior of Perion! Death is not the end. Though you are no longer in this world, your heart will be with the tribes always.
Woe is me, woe is me...
Woe is me, woe is me...
Oh... Hey! You! Help me!
What's going on?
Just hear me out, okay? I'm actually a noble from Tria! A mage cursed me to become a frog, until... Well, perhaps you could help me break the curse.
Don't tell me you want me to kiss you.
But it's the only way to break the curse!
Has anyone else tried breaking the curse yet?
Of course. Obviously, I haven't found the right human to break the curse...
Are you really cursed?
That's what my ma used to tell me when I wouldn't eat my flies. The old frog must've taken me in when I was really little.
Ah. Well, I'll pass. Thanks, though.
Don't be so picky. I'll shower you with riches when I'm back in my rightful form! I just know in my guts that you can break this curse.
You keep telling yourself that. I'm out of here.
Where, oh where will I find someone to break my curse? Woe is me!
Huh. I didn't know trees could scream.
Well obviously I'm not a tree! How did you even spot me? I'm here on a secret mission!
You one of Frey's men?
Did the empress send you?
Liar.
I'm trying to keep a low profile here. Can't you pretend you didn't see me and just move along?
You aren't worthy to even speak of her!
Stop blathering. I'm on duty. Get out of here now, before you regret it.

When our world was young, the goddess of light faded away. It became the responsibility of us fairfolk to carry what remained of her work into the future.

$map:02000001$ is the biggest city in all of Maple World and the seat of $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$'s power.
$map:02000025$ watches over the city from the north. It's off-limits to the public, I'm afraid. Her majesty's safety takes priority over the curiosity of tourists.

The $map:02000188$, the Banners of Glory, and a taxi stop are all conveniently located in the center of the city. For a reasonable fee, you can hire a taxi to take you to any other taxi stop you've visited, you know. Oh, and the job instructors from all over are gathered in the $map:02000188$.

The Banners of Glory in front of the palace mark the victories of certain powerful guilds and individuals. We update the banners all the time, so you can stop by whenever you like to see who has the most trophies and victories.

In the northern parts of the city, you'll find the royal office and library. $map:02000031$ is a must-see for any book lover, of course. It's not the biggest library in Maple World, but I like to think that it's the best. When I'm off-duty, I love to wander the stacks.
Behind the library is a shopping district where you can find special items, anything from home decor to mounts.

To the southwest, you'll find shops that sell equipment and other supplies. $npcName:11000004[gender:0]$ is one of the best smiths in the land, and $npcName:11000010[gender:1]$ sells all the latest herbs and potions. Never pick a fight without a stack of potions, I always say.

Head southeast and you'll find the residential district and hospital. Kick your feet up and relax after a long journey at $map:02000033$. Have your ailments treated by Tria's finest physician at $map:02000125$. And there's nothing $npcName:11000038[gender:0]$ can't cure.
And that's $map:02000001$ in a nutshell. A long, wordy nutshell. If I told you everything about the city, you'd be here all night. Is there anything else you want to know?

I know that you probably came from very far away to see the empress, but these things can't be helped. Thank you for understanding that we had to cancel the open court in the face of unexpected disaster.

$map:02000001$ is the political, economic, and cultural heart of Maple World, so it's always crowded. But in preparation for open court, there must have been ten times the normal number of people here.
Of course, when you have so many people in one place, problems are certain to crop up. Thieves, con artists, and the incident at the celebra—Oops. Maybe I shouldn't have said that.
Anyway, Captain $npcName:11000119[gender:0]$ is determined to keep the peace. Enjoy your stay here, and stay out of trouble. For your own sake.
If you're looking to take up a job, you should make a stop at the $map:02000188$ in the center of $map:02000001$. Job masters from all over the world are gathered there.
The timing is pretty lucky for you. If it weren't for the empress's court, they wouldn't be here. Of course, if you aren't at least level 10, they won't even talk to you.

You're a Green Hood, aren't you? That's great. We guard could use the support of people like you during these crazy times.
You're a Heavy Gunner, aren't you? I've always wanted to visit $map:2000270$.
We're watching you, Thief. You are a guest of the kingdom, but we won't abide any criminal activity.
Know this, Assassin. $map:02000001$ is a city of light.
They say Runeblades are masters of swordsmanship and magic. Being good at either one is hard enough... How did you manage to master both?

Hey, you're the Gray Wolf of $map:02000100$, aren't you? They say that you're a master martial artist and that you're taking the fight straight to the gangsters! A real champion of the people! You're my hero! Though... I thought you'd be taller.
You've mistaken me for someone else.
R-really? I'm sorry. I always wanted to meet $male:him,female:her$ in person. I guess I just got excited.

Everyone in Maple World dreams of having a home to call their own. The empress and her court work tirelessly to open up new plots of land, but there's only so much space, so not many people can have the luxury of owning a magnicifent villa.

If you don't have a house yet, you should consider $map:02000001$. Property in the city proper is expensive, but the outlying suburb of $map:02000002$ is partially subsidized by the empress. And there's always $map:02000119$... And $map:02000064$...

There are many advantages to owning a house, you know. These days, every home comes with a device that will let you teleport there at anytime from almost anywhere. Let me tell you, it's saved my butt plenty of times after a long day of patrolling $map:02000092$.

And the merchants in $map:02000036$, west of $map:02000023$, have all kinds of interesting furnishings for sale. Decorate your floors, walls, furniture, and yard to create a house that's unique to you. Some merchants will even sell buildings you can place on your lot! When you're ready to buy, go to $map:02000036$ to shop for your house.

If you already have a house, you could always hire an assistant or two to keep you company. $npcName:11000700[gender:1]$ in the northwestern district of $map:02000001$ hires them out. But first thing's first. You have to buy a house before you can get an assistant!

Let's talk about something else.
Yeah, what do you want to talk about?

Isn't it obvious? There's a reason I'm always picked for the best missions. The boss trusts me. I'll be an officer in no time, and then idiots like $npcName:11001686[gender:0]$ will have to do whatever I say.

Beats me. I never saw it before. This is a messed up thought, but could you imagine having 100 $npcNamePlural:11001688[gender:0]$ running around? Ugh, just having one of him is too much.
How are you doing?
That place before... You could feel the fighting spirit in the air! This place, on the other hand... Words don't do it justice.
What's your rank in Blackstar?
I'm a henchman, plain and simple. $npcName:11001678[gender:0]$ has big ideas about moving up in the organization, but I don't care what they call me as long as I get to bash heads in.

Boss. Lackey. It doesn't matter. All that matters is how strong you are. $npcName:11001678[gender:0]$ can try to rise as much as he wants, but he's got a glass jaw. A weakling like him just ain't officer material.

Is that what this place's called? I didn't know that. I don't care, neither. I just want to get back to base. I belong at $map:63000020$, watching over the fighters. This town doesn't hold a candle to the excitement of the ring.

I got no idea who you're talking about. Ask $npcName:11001674[gender:0]$. Now, the one I'm interested in... is you. They say you're the Gray Wolf. I don't buy it, 'cause why would the Gray Wolf work with the boss? Gray Wolf or not, you could fight your way to the top of Blackstar if you wanted.

Ah, Gray Wolf. You have business with me? If you're looking for the $map:2000216$, you've come to the right place.
What's the $map:02000216$?
I'm curious about Blackstar.
I'm not surprised you haven't heard of it. This is a place that services people with extraordinary taste. Our clientèle does not typically mix with rough-and-tumble fighter types.
I'll have to check what items I have that are suitable for your skills. Are you looking for something in particular? Or do you have a rare item that you'd like to sell?
I don't care either way. The products here are incomparable to those available in $map:2000100$. Heh.
Simply talk to the traders here to browse their wares or sell your items on the $map:2000216$. They'll do their best to help you. Probably.

Keep in mind that the only place to trade epic and better items is the $map:2000216$. And if you try to secretly trade such items without us, we'll know. You may be the famous Gray Wolf, but this is our field of expertise.
Now, if you'll excuse me...
I'm telling you this for your own good. A place like this draws a lot of attention. Even now, agents from many organizations are watching us.
Not many people recognize you as a threat. But if you keep asking questions like that, they'll start to take notice. You don't want that. Understand?

You may not be Blackstar's biggest fan, but not everything it does is bad. The $map:2000216$ has drawn adventurers and traders from all over Maple World. I'd say that it's single-handedly put $map:2000100$ and $map:2000135$ on the map.
The people of $map:2000100$ are thankful for what we've done for the community. So I suggest you keep your opinions about Blackstar to yourself while you're here.
You have something to say to me?
You have something to say to me?
Hah... I can barely breathe...

Tell me about $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$.
You've come to the right man. What do you wanna know?
Does $npcName:11001618[gender:0]$ get along with $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$?
Maybe you didn't know this, but $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ is the boss's son. Heir to the kingdom, though you wouldn't know it to talk to him. All the officers sure seem to like him, though.
And why is that?

You ever meet a boss's kid before? You know the type. Throws his daddy's weight around. Makes all the company goons do whatever he says. Well, $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ ain't like that. He doesn't care about power or money. So why wouldn't they like him?
And what does the rank-and-file think?
$npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ is our hero. His pop's the head honcho, but $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ didn't ever get nothing that he didn't earn with his own two fists. A real man's man, you know?
Let's talk about something else.
Tell me about $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$.
Yeah? What do you want to know?
I want to know about $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$'s fighting style.
What're you asking me for? You're the one who faced him in the ring! I told you he'd take you out with a single punch, didn't I? Ha!
How does $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ train?
Trying to figure out how he got so strong, eh? I think he was just born strong. I hear he never slacks off on his training, but no amount of training makes you as tough as he is.

He's got a 30-step routine he goes through every single day. Enough to give a normal man a heart attack, they say. Some of the other lunks in the organization tried it, and they all passed out foaming at the mouth.
What's the routine?
It's nothing special, really. 4,000 knuckle push-ups, 1,000 finger push-ups, 5,000 sit-ups, 5,000 squats, 200 laps around the track... That sort of thing.
He uses sandbags and chunks of meat as punching bags, and he lets others whale on him to toughen him up. There's no secret to his training. He's just that tough.
Let's talk about something else.
Tell me about $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$.
$npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ is truly a magnificent beast. It's not just that he's strong—he is completely and utterly fearless.
What does he have to fear? His dad is the boss!

Of course you would assume that $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ gets special treatment because of his father. But, in truth, it's $npcName:11001618[gender:0]$ who is lucky to have $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ for a son.

When Blackstar was first started, it had many enemies. Hardly a day passed when someone didn't try to take the boss's life. But $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ watched over $map:02000100$ like a hawk, keeping his father safe and eliminating our enemies one at a time.
He won't take credit for it, but there would be no Blackstar without him. And yet, some people still grumble that he acts too cocky for a brat who merely happened to be adopted by the boss.
Wait, $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ was adopted?
I don't know the details. All I know is that the boss brought home this ten-year-old boy one day and treated him as a son. He couldn't possibly be the boss's real child.

Whatever their story is, $npcName:11001547[gender:0]$ doesn't seem to care about his birth or his position in Blackstar. Most of us respect and admire him, and those who don't are too cowardly to speak up.
Let's talk about something else.

Heh, I told them there was only person who could handle this cannon, and that person was standing right in front of them! Heh, heh. It was me, get it? Hey, I asked you a question! Are you even listening?
Hey, what's going on? You look pale. And you're sweating like crazy. Ha, ha, is touching my cannon that exciting?
Hey. What's happening to you? <font color="#909090">(Her cannon brings up images from the nightmare you used to have when you slept in Halo Mountain. You'd better leave.)</font>
I want to leave.

Oh. Well, fine. I was going to show you the awesome things my cannon does, but I guess not. What's wrong with you, anyway? Been traumatized by cannons or something? Wouldn't surprise me, since they're so powerful. They should only be handled by the fearless, anyway.

Talk to $npcName:11000046[gender:1]$ about a different subject.
Blah, blah, blah. You're more talkative than you look. Why are you babbling on like this? Curious about something?

What? No. How would I know that? You some sort of celebrity? No, I didn't think so. The only way I could know who you are is if you were from $map:02000100$. Trust me, I know everyone from that place.
How do you know everyone from there?
Clearly, you should be asking who I am. I'm all over the back alleys of $map:02000100$. I know everything that happens there.
Well, let's hear what you know, then!

Right now, the talk of the town is the Gray Wolf, who decided to leave the shadows of society and duke it out with the Blackstars. Word is that the Gray Wolf singlehandedly razed the Blackstar stronghold.

But that's not even the most interesting part. What's really amazing is the Gray Wolf took on the champion of $map:63000020$! Everyone knows the Champ can't be beaten, but the Gray Wolf went for it anyway! Dumb decision, really. The Warrior wiped the floor with them. There's a reason he's called the Monster, you know.
Is the Champ really that tough?

Wow, you really don't know? He's a champion who successfully defended his title 47 times out of 48 matches. And the one time he didn't win, it was a tie. For the 47 victories, he brought them all down with a single blow, if you can believe it.
What happened with the tie?

Oh, it was amazing! The Warrior couldn't land a blow, no matter how hard he tried, and neither could his opponent. They just kept trying until both were exhausted, and it was really tense to watch. Finally, at the end, they were both heaving with fatigue, barely able to stand. Without a word, the challenger turned and stumbled away.
Tell me about the challenger.

I don't know. No one does! See, as if it weren't dramatic enough, nobody could find out anything, except that the challenger was a were-eagle known to some people in $map:63000020$, who of course would admit nothing.
And why would they? That would be admitting that the Champ isn't invincible.
Change the subject.

$MyPCName$, I can tell you <font color="#ffd200">how to get what you want</font>. Oh, wait... I see now you're not a Thief. Well, then you wouldn't even know what <font color="#ffd200">freedom</font> is. Just go along your merry way.
What is freedom?
Oh yeah? How can I get anything I want?
Talk to $npcName:11000050[gender:0]$ about a different subject.
What, do you want to hire me?
Can I hire you?
That depends. There are many things I need to consider, such as how much money you can afford.
You can't hire me for just any sum. Whom do you want me to take care of, anyway? What's the <font color="#ffd200">name</font>?
$npcName:11001559[gender:0]$.
...I'm going to pretend that I didn't hear that. He's one of the greats.

Is there something wrong?
