It is all well and good to forget one's troubles in a cheerful place such as this, but we cannot lose sight of what's real. A dark storm gathers over Maple World. Now more than ever, we need heroes. Will you answer the call?
What is it?
Sometimes I wish I wasn't so amazing at everything...
What is it?
I wish he wore glasses. He's so intelligent and sensitive... It would be perfect...
Wow!
My favorite game is hide-and-seek!
Hahaha!
$npcName:11001167[gender:0]$ likes to frighten us with scary stories, but now that I know better, I don't believe a word he says!
Wanna split a nice glass of milk?
Hey $male:mister,female:lady$, want to play hide-and-seek?
Wait!
An all-expenses paid trip to Mushtopia? Count me in! I feel like dancing!
Mm? Are you here to see little old me?
Hello! It's another beautiful day in Royale Park, wouldn't you say?
What do you want?
This place is gonna make me rich! I've just gotta figure out how, first...
How may I help you?
Ever since we were little, it's always been me, $npcName:11004149$ and the sea, hehe!
Hm hm hmmm, hm! Those marching songs always get stuck in my head.

I've loved $npcName:11000444[gender:0]$'s books and the sea ever since I was a boy—probably a side-effect of growing up by the ocean. And now I'm on a voyage of my own, alongside my childhood friends.
What is it?
Are you here to participate in Mushking Royale too? I'm afraid we've already got a squad of four. I'll see you on the battlefield!
How may I help you?
$npcName:11004150$, $npcName:11004148$, $npcName:11004149$, and I are here in $map:02000499$ on vacation! Since we all grew up together, we've got some real synergy on the battlefield.
Can I help you?
The scenery here is breathtaking, but if you want the best view in $map:02000499$, you should try hanging from $npcName:11004165$.
What seems to be the problem?
There are chests hidden all over Maple World, but the ones in $map:02000499$ are... different. Hehe, you'll see!
Hello.
Wow, just look at that ocean! This place is so different from $map:02000051$. It really is nice to get out and explore the world once in a while.
Ugh!
Ugh! I'm all stiff from standing around all day. I can't wait to get off work.
Wahhh...
Yawn... Boooring. I think I liked working in $map:82000000$ better, even with the occasional beatings.
Meow!
Nom nom nom nom! <font color="#909090">(He flops his ears joyfully.)</font>
It's so close, but I can't reach it. It comes to me in the night and vanishes at dawn.
Many things shine, not all of them valuable.
Is there something I can help you with?
The Royal Guard protects the Empress and all of $map:02000001$. That is why we must never allow our skills to dull. So long as there are threats to peace in this world, we will not rest.
Ah... What should I do?
Ohh gee, oh man... I don't know about this royale thing.

Guarding the armory is important work, but I'm glad Captain $npcName:11000119$ asked me to tag along.
Are you on duty?
Actually, I'm on leave at the moment. The captain asked me to be in his squad for Mushking Royale!

It's been too long since we've been together like this. Time to warm up!
Order now or get a face full of burning oil. Your choice.
Don't get the wrong idea. I'm not here selling churros because my restaurant is doing poorly, I'm just here to enjoy myself.

Huh? Because I like to cook, obviously.
Well... If I'm being honest, we all trekked all the way here to $map:02000499$ to take a vacation, but we ran out of money to pay for lodging.
They're not done yet. Come back later.
Ugh...
Blam, blam! Oh, hey. I'm just practicing my aim. I don't want to let my squad down.
Mm?
Sorry, I've already got a squad. See? There's the guy selling churros, the girl strutting around over there, and that guy shooting finger-guns. I couldn't ask for better teammates.
You don't have to look twice. I'm who you think I am.
You're lucky to have run into me. I'm not sticking around, I've just popped in for a photo shoot. I can't really have a relaxing vacation with so many frenzied fans around.
Today is the best day of my life!!
Eek! It's $npcName:11004174[gender:0]$! It's really $npcName:11004174[gender:0]$!! I can't believe it, I think I'm gonna die.

When things get dicey, it's good to have somebody who's got your back.

If we want to win the next match, the two of you need to be more pragmatic.

My greatest joy is seeing my daughter smile. I would have visited this place sooner if I had known it would make $npcName:11004180[gender:1]$ so happy.

Hahahaha!

$MyPCName$, what brings you to me?

Our yearly pilgrimage through the Vayar Mountains has made the warriors of Murpagoth mighty. Perhaps you will join us on our next journey? That is of course, after we have proven ourselves on the fields of Mushtopia.

I'm delighted to be visiting $map:02000499$ with my mother. Of course, I won't be engaging in the tourney myself. Mother and I will be quite happy to cheer the contestants on from the sidelines.

My son is always thinking of me, and it makes me so very happy. He's such a good boy! I don't know how I'd get along without him.
Hello.
Out of the way, buddy, you're in my shot.
Hello.

It's a pleasure.
It's a bit hot out here, but spectating is such fun!

Are you looking for friends, too?

The mush before you is merely a facsimile of his mushyness. The real $npc:11004213[gender:1]$ is actually luxuriating inside the castle.

Fake. A fraud. A phony. See the way he bounces around? It's really just an inflatable balloon rigged up to make noises.
That's a pretty lifelike balloon.
I know, right? You can touch him, if you want. Just don't pop him. These things are expensive.
What is it?

Hmm? Is that really the $npc:11004213[gender:0]$, you ask? Yep! Except this one is bigger. Otherwise, they're identical in every way! The real $npc:11004213[gender:0]$ is full of hot air, too, heh heh heh!
Yaaaaaawn...
You want to try out some high-caliber mushsplosives? Just pick up a bomb and throw it.

You don't know? Just stand next to a bomb and the words "Pick Up" will pop up in the air as if by magic. Just press the corresponding button and you're ready to unleash the cleansing power of fire!

Yaaaawn!
Yaaawn...
♬I wanna be where the mushfolk are. I wanna see—wanna see 'em mushin'. Bouncin' around on those stalks!♬
Yaaawn!

The world beyond this park is full of wonders. You should see it for yourself.
Welcome to $map:02000499$.
Have a great day!
Welcome!

Let's warm up!
I'm feeling a bit under the weather, so I'm warming up with a little cardio.

Sigh... Fame is a burden.
I guess I'm too handsome for my own good.
Eeeeeeee! He's so handsome!
The three of us are more than enough!
Hahahaha!
I like soft things.
I'm so FLUFFY!

I came to see the prof—erm, I mean, to recruit heroes!

Heehee... This place is going to make me a lot of money.
Go away, you bother me.

Adventure ho!

A true guardsman never stops training.
What? Here?

At your command!

To ride $npcName:11004165$, you'll have to watch for your chance and grab on quick!
You're almost at the top, don't quit now!
You can fly around on $npcName:11004165$ if you climb to the top of the overlook behind me.

But it's all just a facade.
Stop and chat awhile.
Feel the heat!
When I post these pics online, my friends will be so jealous!
Now this is one classy theme park!
It's so hot...
If you want to train for Mushking Royale, do it here!
Yaaaawn... this is the practice area...
Great work out there today!
I've got just what you need to continue the search.
Do you have business with me?
Haha, let's get this party started! Pew pew! That's the sound of me blowing everyone away with the power of my cannon!
If you want to be happy, there's one rule to live by: figure out what you wanna do, and do it! In my case, that's listening my cannon purr as it pumps out hundreds of rounds a minute.
Bada-dada-da-da-da!
They're so lucky I can't use my cannon in the royale.
What's up?
This world is ruled by competition. Only the best win.
If you wanna survive, you've got to win, and there's no right or wrong when it comes to winning. Somebody's got to go, you or them.
If you want to win, you've got to be ready to do ANYTHING.
Was there something you needed?
There is power in anger, but you must never lose yourself in the heat of battle. When all that's left is devastation, there are no winners.
Powerful, decisive action is the key to victory.
Can't talk. Important mission.
Sorry, I don't have time for games... I'm here on a special mission. My partner said to meet him at the tables on the dock over by the balloons, but he's nowhere in sight.

Can't talk, secret mission. I told $npc:11004220[gender:0]$ to meet right here by the balloons. Where is he? You don't think they got to him first, do you...?
Where is that $npc:11004220[gender:0]$?

In my line of work, discretion and poise are vital. That makes this dapper fellow a very hot commodity...
Ohohoho!
<font color="#909090">(He glares at you, then down at the clarinet in his mouth, then back at you.)</font>

Hey, thanks for listening! We're Riot at the Danceclub. We all met during an audition and decided to form a band, kindred spirits and all that. We picked stage names to riff off the band name.

When I think back on that audition at $map:52000061$, I can't help but smile. That day changed my life.
Meow.
Meoow!
Hello.

Bored, bored, boooored...
Hmm...
I despise the noise and brutishness that permeates society. On this topic, it seems that I and this vision of elegance are of one mind.

<font color='#909090'>(The fox tilts its head inquisitively.)</font>

The $npc:11004215$, as we've taken to calling it, can convert all kinds of energy. As soon as she found it, $npcName:11000601[gender:1]$ set herself to researching the device.

To her surprise, the chest was even able to take the $item:30001187$ taken from monsters and turn it into gem dust. We agreed that it would be in everyone's best interest to make this device freely available to adventurer's like you!

Welcome! Pay me 5 $itemPlural:30000875$ and I'll let you spin the $npc:11003511$! How about it? Feeling lucky?

I knew you would succeed.
I knew you would succeed.
I know you are powerful, but you still need to look after yourself.
You've protected the lady from harm once again. I'm in your debt.
You've protected the lady from harm once again. I'm in your debt.
The lady's happiness is my happiness. Please accept my thanks on her behalf.
You're really amazing, you know that?
You're really amazing, you know that?
I hate tedious matters, but I suppose I can help if you're the one asking.
But if you happen to find anything interesting, you'd better bring it to me instead of $npcName:11004103[gender:1]$! Promise.
I cannot fathom how much more powerful you'll grow.
I cannot fathom how much more powerful you'll grow.
It's an honor to be working by your side once more, friend.
Amazing work, $MyPCName$.
Amazing work, $MyPCName$.
I wish everybody was more like you.
Good work, $MyPCName$.
Good work, $MyPCName$. I'd better head back to $map:02000001$ now.
I haven't seen his face in some time.
Hmph.
Hmph.
I'm sorry I wasn't of more help...
Is this goodbye?
Is this goodbye?
You did a great job!
I wish $npcName:11004238[gender:0]$ felt more like celebrating. I guess he's embarrassed about missing all the action.
Next time, Guidance will be there to help! Just say the word.
I still feel out of sorts.
I still feel out of sorts.
I am truly in your debt. Thank you. I'm sorry about everything.
I'm ashamed of myself.
I'm ashamed of myself.
What you saw back there, that wasn't me.
You better not tell anyone else about this! Especially not $npcName:11004054[gender:1]$!
How can I help you?
I feel like I'm still in a dream.
I'm so confused. My memories are all jumbled. I think I need some time.
Huh?
I am sorry for misleading you. But surely you must see that I had no choice.
Hmm...
Hmmm... This is turning out to be pretty interesting.

The Green Lapenta... The flow of life... All these memories...

I want to be best friends with all kinds of monsters. That's what Team Mushroom is all about, right?

$npcName:11003501[gender:1]$ and I wanna be bigshots in Team Mushroom someday. But it'd be cool to work for Dryad Co., too... What should we do?
The Team Mushroom is a huge organization, you know!
What is it?
The Team Mushroom has people all over the world. You'll find them wherever you find monsters!

Team Mushroom and Dryad Co. don't have much in common. Dryad sells the tools of the pet-taming trade. Team Mushroom is working to protect the world from devastation, and unite all peoples across the nation!
I work alone, but I'll be in need of a partner in the future.
What is it?
You the man, Ducky. Well... You the duck.
Slime, you're mine.
There are lots of hungry $itemPlural:61000002$ here. I'm here to capture one as a pet.
Who's your little friend?
Did you come here alone?
This is my $item:61000005$. We're traveling together. Say hello, $item:61000005$.
Hello, Duckling.

No, it's just me and my $item:61000005$ on the open road! Though I did bump into my childhood friend $npcName:11003506[gender:1]$. Small world, isn't it?
I guess my little $item:61000005$ is feeling shy.
$item:61000005$ and I are training. I'm going to be a great pet master someday!

Tamed monsters are called 'combat pets.' Don't forget that, 'cause it might be on the test!

Ah... Hello...?

Ducky!

We pushed and pushed to master ever more powerful magic as our enemy, the darkness, grew stronger. But we grew too greedy. Our effort to put the darkness to sleep before the power of the goddess of light ran out... wasted!
Though we failed, we watch over this world still, ever mindful of our pledge to drive out the darkness.

"That man is the root of all evil!"
"He appeared out of the blue, pale as a ghost. Even my cows were scared of him."

"But I couldn't kick him out. He seemed injured, and I was raised a gentleman. But letting him rest in my fields was a mistake. He pulled out a black bottle, grinned this sick little grin, then poured it all on the ground."
"Everything happened quickly after that. The dark shadow that blossomed out of the liquid..."
"My livestock were engulfed by darkness. They cried out as they transformed into monsters. The fields and streams turned black as ink. Even the people living on the farm became twisted."
"I tried to outrun the darkness, but I sense my time is short. I can feel the corruption of this forsaken ground crawling up my legs, slowly transforming me..."
"If you can read this, flee! Flee at once! This land is cursed. If you stay, in the end, you'll become... like me... IT IS TOO LATE!"

$MyPCName$, what is it?
Another day, another incident...
...And this knucklehead, where in the world is he?
What is it?
My son is a bit... no, he's very hard-headed. I lost my patience with him, and well... He stormed out of the house and hasn't returned yet.
Sigh... People are right when they say parenting is the world's hardest job.
It's a beautiful day today. Hopefully it'll stay that way...

As the elder of this village, I'm doing my best to keep its residents safe. But there's little I could do about the seal of the Land of Darkness breaking, and now something terrible seems to happen every day.
The only wish I have now is for peace. $MyPCName$, I'm relying on you for that.
What's the matter, dear?
Now that the court's been canceled, everyone has been clearing out of here. I used to pray for this day to come, but now the city feels so empty.
Welcome, $MyPCName$. I was just about done with this batch of cookies. Would you like to wait for them? My fresh-baked cookies are famous here in $map:02000001$, you know.
That $npc:11000055[gender:0]$, where did he go this time?
What should I make for dinner tonight?
What?
Did you really think you could hide that? Hmph!
Nothing is going my way.
I don't care why the court was canceled anymore. I've heard every rumor under the sun, and now they're saying it was an earthquake? Ridiculous! All I want now is to kick back.
Bah, everyone acts like they're the busiest person in the world. Everyone here in $map:02000001$ spends their day rushing around like fools. Seriously!
Let's see... So, this book goes...
Ahh, it's going to take forever to organize these books!
What a mess!
Please, try not to step on the books on the floor.
$npcName:11000055[gender:0]$ has a bad habit of returning books late.
What's wrong?
I hope everything's okay in $map:02000076$.
I wonder how Captain $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ is doing...
Platoon leader of the Green Hoods, at your service. $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ sent me here to watch over $map:02000146$.
There's one person whom I admire more than $npc:11000015[gender:1]$, and it's my father. He died of illness when I was young, but the bow he carved for me was my inspiration to join this militia.
I'll do my best to become a good militia member, so I can believe my father would be proud of me.
What's wrong?
We'll follow Captain $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ to the end!
For our hometown!
We must train harder in trying times.
If you want to join the Green Hoods, then head to $npc:11000045[gender:0]$.
Welcome to $map:02000076$. How may I help you?
Sell me on this $map:02000076$ business.
What happened to the empress's celebration?
Hey there. I'm new in town.
$map:02000076$ used to be the home of archers and craftsmen, all living in a collective. They produced many great works and great hunters, generation after generation.
The Green Hoods formed to protect the village from outside threats to their peace. Their current leader is their fifth, $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$.

Is $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ the chief of this village? Ha ha, no. Henesys's chief is $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$. $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$'s father and $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$ have been best friends since they were young.

That's why $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$ takes care of $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ like his own. You know, $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ doesn't like people talking about her. So, maybe don't tell her about this conversation?

I've heard a great earthquake occurred near $map:02000001$, and the empress's court was canceled as a result. I hope the damage isn't too serious. That disaster might also keep $npcName:11000045[gender:0]$ from returning anytime soon.
$npcName:11000045[gender:0]$ won't tolerate anyone trying to take advantage of a chaotic situation. I hope he'll be back soon. We need him more than ever.

You've probably noticed that the Green Hoods are all archers. We're renowned throughout Victoria Island for our marksmanship, and even $npcName:11000045[gender:0]$, the master archer of $map:02000001$, is a Green Hood.
In fact, she taught me everything I know about loosing a bow. If you're interested in archery yourself, I'd suggest paying her a visit next time you're in the capital.
Everyone in Maple World dreams of having a house of their own. $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$ is doing what he can to manage the housing lots around the village, but there's only so much land.

If you don't have a house yet, you could settle down in $map:02000076$. $map:02000105$ is also quite nice, and is famous for its beautiful maple trees. There might be some empty lots still available in $map:02000104$ or $map:02000143$ as well. If you're looking for more affordable options, then you can check out the apartments in $map:02000105$ or $map:02000104$.

There are many advantages to owning a house, you know. These days, every home comes with a device that will let you teleport there at anytime from almost anywhere. Let me tell you, it's saved my butt plenty of times after a long day of patrolling the ant tunnels.

And the merchants in $map:02000036$, west of $map:02000023$, have all kinds of interesting furnishings for sale. Decorate your floors, walls, furniture, and yard to create a house that's unique to you. Some merchants will even sell buildings you can place on your lot! When you're ready to buy, go to $map:02000036$ to shop for your house.

If you already have a house, hiring a maid is a good next step. $npcName:11000700[gender:1]$ in $map:02000001$ is an expert on assistants and can definitely help you out. Maybe you should look for a house around $map:02000076$ first.
What brings you here?
So, the time has come for me to intervene.
So intense...
Have you heard of $map:02000051$? The cliffs there are so treacherous that most people wouldn't dare climb it.
If you have the chance, you should visit $map:02000051$ and visit my dad. Tell him you're $npcName:11000009[gender:0]$'s friend and you'll be like one of the family.
Who is your father?
Oh, don't worry. You'll know him when you see him.
What seems to be the problem?
The open court is canceled, but I'm still as busy as ever.
I deliver every package that comes to $map:02000001$.
I'm busy, so busy!

If I keep working like this, exhaustion's going to get me. And what's worse is that $npcName:11000252[gender:0]$ still won't appreciate all my hard work! You know, it's so hard to take care of $map:02000001$ by myself.
What is it?
Maybe I'll find something valuable if I search hard enough...
W-who are you? You better not be here to steal anything. This is my spot!
That's right.
No.
Hey, no! Get out! If we take too much stuff, they'll notice for sure!
Oh, okay. Good. You'd better get out of here then, before someone sees you. And don't tell anyone you saw me in here!
How may I help you?
Don't let your guard down, even for a second.
I'm worried about the elder's health.
What brings you to this place?
I came to see you.
I came to $map:02000076$ to see the elder.
I have business here.
That's none of your business.
Do you have a reason for coming to see me?
I just thought I'd say hi.
Nope.
Oh. Well. Hi.
Well, you're just being ridiculous. I've no time for that. Excuse me.
$npcName:11000001[gender:0]$'s house is on the hill behind the clock tower in the center of the village. He's always there, keeping an eye on everyone.
I see. All I'll say then is that if you need help, the militia is always here.
I hope I didn't upset you. You certainly don't have to explain yourself. But if you do, the rest of the militia and I may be able to help.
Hm hm hmmm, hm! Those marching songs always get stuck in my head.
If there isn't a path, I'll carve one out myself!
If only there were a safer way to $map:02000001$...
Hey there. First time in $map:02000062$?
Yep!
Well, if you're trying to get to $map:02000001$, I've got some bad news for you.. We just had a big earthquake that split the road there in half. No one can make the journey now.
As if that weren't bad enough, rough seas are preventing ships from entering or leaving the harbor. We're all stuck here!
Is there no other way to get to $map:02000001$?
What about by air?
I've heard there's a wilderness path that connects $map:02000115$ and $map:02000116$, but no one's been taking it. Supposedly it's a bit... dangerous.
Uhh... Lith isn't that kind of port, buddy.
How may I help you?
The road has been cut off. I wonder if the porters are safe.
By the way, what caused that earthquake all of a sudden?
I still can't believe that the road to $map:02000001$ is out. All the supplies for the empress's court have been sent along that road. Do you think anyone fell in when the ground opened up? Yeesh.

The open court of the empress is just around the corner, and yet bad things are happening constantly around here. First the supply carriage was robbed, and then the earthquake happened. All I wanted was for all this to go smoothly.
How may I help you?
My grandson is so rebellious that he's going to give me a heart attack. I miss the days when he would just listen.
The whole world is excited about the empress finally holding court again.
I don't know what to do to get through to $npcName:11000054[gender:0]$.
$npcName:11000054[gender:0]$ is as stubborn as a mule. Please find him before he leaves $map:63000001$.
What is it?
Argh, this is too much!
Why do people keep coming to the harbor? Don't they know the routes are blocked?
Are you heading to $map:02000001$. You know that the way is blocked, right?
Yeah, I heard.
No, I didn't. Really?
Good, I don't have to explain it to you. So... if you can't get to $map:02000001$, what are you going to do?
I'll find another way!
Beats me.
What are you gonna do, fly? The road is gone! It has ceased to be! You need to be realistic about this.
Seriously, have a look at $map:02000115$. Let me know what you think of the terrible, yawning chasm of doom in your way. I'll wait.
That's understandable. $map:02000001$ has it all, and all we've got is... fish. Might as well head home once you've got your fill of fish, huh?
It sure is. The Royal Road is the main route from this harbor to $map:02000001$, and it was cracked open by the earthquake that happened the other day. Now no one can get to $map:02000001$.
If you don't believe me, go to $map:02000115$ and see for yourself.
What's up?

Are you also trying to attend the court? I was on my way there... stopping to sample some delicious food along the way, of course... and had my plans dashed by this wretched rift! I suppose I could try the forest, but it's fairly frightening.
Wait, can you get around the rift through the forest?
That's what I heard! Follow the path between the trees over there to $map:02000116$, and then keep on until you get to $map:02000001$.
I wouldn't try it if I were you, though. A few folks have faced the forest... but none have returned from $map:02000116$.
Welp, so much for my plans!
I bet the food at the court festival is so good...
Ah, it's time to eat! Mom must be looking for me.
How may I help you?
Now we're having earthquakes out of the blue?
I can't believe we're reopening this road...
Have you seen the Royal Road? Or rather, what's left of it? A huge earthquake tore right through it! Everyone who wants to get to $map:02000001$ is stuck here now.

$map:02000001$ is so close, and yet so far. Those who came by ship to attend the court are beyond disappointed. That's why we've decided to open the mountain path. To those who are authorized to use it, of course.
What brings you here?
You don't look like you're from around here. Did you come to see the court?
Yep!
That's none of your business.
Oh, cool! I was planning on attending myself.

I asked my brother to see the court with me, but he was more interested in catching some kind of fish while they were in season. I suppose it's good that he didn't come, now that the road to $map:02000001$ is out.
What happened to the road?
How could you not have heard? The Royal Road leading to $map:02000001$ was torn up by the earthquake the other day. Can't be good for holding court, y'know?
Hey, now. No need to be like that. I was just making conversation.
That $npc:11000023[gender:0]$, where in the world is he?
Why is this happening when the court is set to open in just a few days?
I've got fresh fish!
I've got halibut, rockfish, turbot, mackerel, stingray, you name it!
What's wrong?
We'll follow Captain $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ to the end!
I hope this peace will last forever.
I'll protect the citizens of $map:02000076$.
We must preserve the order of Maple World.

I hope I'll make lots of new allies.
Yes? Yes? What do you need? How can I help?
This is my fault. All my fault!
I messed up. I messed it all up. Woe is meee!
Can I help you?
There's no package the teeth can't carry!
Bullies are the worst. How can anyone pick on someone weaker than themselves?
How may I help you?
The power of the Green Lapenta is especially strong here in $map:02000023$. That vital force protects this place from darkness.
How may I help you?
We should let $npcName:11000031[gender:0]$ know his identity and ask for advice. Meet me in $map:02000035$.
What brings you here?
I've got plenty of books I want to read, but not enough time to do it.
I'll never get tired of this book, no matter how many times I read it.
Ancient tomes containing stories of this world must be handled with care. They can teach us many important lessons.
Can I help you?
I want to go home.
Nothing's more important than peace of mind. I find mine snuggled up safe in bed.
How may I help you?
What kind of fun should I have today?
I can't wait to see Mom!
The world is so scary sometimes. Be careful, $MyPCName$!
What is it?
Don't forget to appreciate the little things.
The flowers and trees seem so lively today!
Love the flowers and trees as you love yourself. Without them, you wouldn't exist.
Can I help you?
Why are humans so kind?
Ahh, I'm so lonely...
One day, I'm going to go out and explore the world! You'll join me when I do, right $MyPCName$?
Who will protect $map:02000051$?
Nothing in this world lasts forever.
May the ancestors keep you safe.
Everything changes.
Sometimes you get what you want. Sometimes you must settle.
Let's get to business.
I've gotten a little too lenient...
It's time to restore discipline.

I'll admit, not everyone in Dark Wind was happy when I took over. Many were loyal to Captain Winn, not the organization. After he passed away, $npcName:11000006[gender:0]$ took some of our best agents and left.
But I have my own principles to follow and I intend to lead Dark Wind in my own way. Winn Stilton was a great man, but we won't live in his shadow.
The others may not be on board yet, but they'll come around. Eventually.
Can I help you?
Another lovely day.
Hm... What should I cook for dinner tonight?
I used to love hearing the sound of bow craftsmen carving wood. The most talented of them all was Freeman.
He was $npcName:11000007[gender:1]$'s father. It's a shame an illness took him so early, but he would surely approve of the woman his daughter grew to be.
How may I help you?
I'm going to let the rest of the world know what a great place $map:63000001$ is!
$MyPCName$, do you know what the pride of $map:63000001$ is?
The lovely scenery?
The good-natured people?

That's right. The air is clean, the water is pure, and there are plenty of unique plants and animals to see. It's a wonderful place to live, and I want the rest of the world to know that. That's why I'm sending a special envoy to $map:02000001$ for the court.

That's right. The people of this place take care of each other like their own family. It's a wonderful place to live, and I want the rest of the world to know that. That's why I'm sending a special envoy to $map:02000001$ for the court.
What is it?
There's much more delicious food to be had on the mainland, right?
$item:20000013$ looks delicious...
$MyPCName$! Are you here to make some money? The court festival must be great for business. Everywhere I look, folks are out doing something for it.
The priciest thing to come out of all this is $itemPlural:20000013$, and you can only get them from Turtle Hill, where $npcName:22300149$ is.
What?
Hmph. I hate my gramps.
I want to go see the court too!
Bah! $npcName:11000062[gender:1]$ said she would go attend the court with her dad. Why isn't my gramps saying anything? I want to go to see the empress too!
$npcName:11000056[gender:0]$ knows about a lot of things. If you have questions, you should ask him!
How may I help you?
Mm, something smells delicious...
I wonder if Mom finished baking the cookies...
$MyPCName$, if you're hungry you should come inside. This is my house right here, and my mom is baking cookies.
What is it?
$npcName:11000441[gender:0]$, wake up! Let's play!
Treasure chests are hidden all over the place.
Hmph, the oarsman at $map:63000002$ is so greedy. He charges a huge fee just to take you to $map:02000062$. Isn't that crazy?
It really is.
I don't know.
Seriously! Some people stay in $map:63000002$ for ages just to make enough money to get on his boat!
What do people do to make money?
Oh, they hunt monsters or pick up junk that washes up on the shore. Some of it is pretty valuable.
But I'll never go there. I don't want to be trampled by $npcName:22300149$ before I get to the mainland.
Really? Well, I guess the fare would be nothing if I could win $npcName:11000441[gender:0]$'s prize money.
Wait, what's this about $npc:11000441[gender:0]$'s prize money?
I told you. Enter $map:61000005$ behind me and survive until the end, and $npc:11000441[gender:0]$ will shower you with money.
What brings you here?
What is it?
Bella... You...
If I could turn back time...
If I had stayed with Bella that day...
I used to live here with my family, but... I'm the only one living in this house now. I miss them so much...
Sometimes I sit by the window, watching the stars fade away one by one, reminiscing about the good old days. I try not to recall the sad memories, but only the good, happy ones.
How may I help you?
Good grief! Are all cities this big?
This place is so crowded.
Do you live here?
Yep!
Nope!
I knew it! I can tell you're from the city by your looks. How much money do you have to make to live in a neighborhood like this?

Oh, no. You look so pale, I-I thought you lived here. I've never been to such a big place before, and everything is so amazing here. And I think I've seen more people today than I've ever seen in my hometown.
What is it?
The island hasn't been this crowded for a long time.
The mainland must be busy preparing for the empress's court right now.
$MyPCName$, are you also going to the mainland?
That's right.
I don't know.
You've made a good decision. I've stayed on this small island my whole life, but I want you to go see more of the this world.
While you're there at the court, you might as well explore the rest of the mainland. I'd love for you to come back with tales of the things you saw.
Cross the sea to the mainland to experience more of what this world can offer.Go on, don't be afraid.
What is it?
Oh geez, why is this place so dirty?
It'll take forever to clean this place up.
If you came to see $npcName:11000016[gender:0]$, you can find him in $map:63000003$. The chief called him to talk about the ship for the court.
How may I help you?
Yippee! I'm going to $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$'s court!
I can finally meet $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ in person... Oh, I'm so nervous!
$MyPCName$, did you hear that? Ordinary people can attend the empress's court this time! I'll be able to meet the $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ in person. Oh, I'm so nervous!
$MyPCName$, you're also coming to the court, right? Come on, come with us! Dad said he'd take me with him.
Where will the court be held?
Why are you so interested in the court?
In $map:02000001$! It's the biggest city on the mainland, far across the ocean. We'll have to take a ship to $map:02000062$ first, though.
Where can I board the ship?
Because it's a once-in-a-lifetime chance to see $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$! Oarsman $npcName:11000016[gender:0]$ said that just seeing her would bring honor to my family.
Go to the dock and talk to the oarsman. Come to think of it, I haven't seen him lately. I wonder where he is...
How may I help you?
I wanna be a great Heavy Gunner like $npc:11000046[gender:1]$ when I grow up!
What was that big gun she's carrying called?
KABOOM! KRAKA-BOOM!
I want to become a great Heavy Gunner like $npcName:11000046[gender:1]$ when I grow up! Pew pew!
Why's that?
Well, yesterday I was out playing by the castle and I tripped on a stone. It really hurt and I cried a whole lot! Then $npcName:11000046[gender:1]$ saw me crying and asked why, because she's a HERO.
I told her all about tripping over the stone, and how I hate stones now! So $npcName:11000046[gender:1]$ took her giant gun... and BLEW UP the stone! Ka-BOOOOSH!
$npcName:11000046[gender:1]$ said that if something hurts her, she'll hurt it ten times worse! Now those are words to live by, right? Right?
Yes.
No.

How may I help you?

How may I help you?

She said that Maple World needs something to bring people together. Since then, we've held all sorts of games on a regular basis for the benefit of the people.

And even if you're feeling lazy and not up for traveling, there's no need to worry! You can teleport to mini-games from anywhere in the universe! When the Event Notification window appears, just press Enter next to the event you want to join!
Well, what are you standing around here for? Go play some mini-games!

We were shocked, as you might imagine. And before we could question him further, a dagger flew in from a nearby window and took his life. There, before our very eyes...

Everyone rushed to find the assailant, but we could find nothing. Our conclusion was that there must be a spy in the palace. The servants of the demon king were plotting something in time for the court. We had to cancel it.

My son... I hope he's doing well.
If only I could see...
My son is doing very important work at $map:02000001$ Palace. I couldn't provide for him when he was young, but he still grew into such a great man. I'm so proud of him.
How may I help you?
$npcName:11000492[gender:0]$ certainly has a way with people.
Mm... I don't know if I have enough time...
$MyPCName$, huh? You have a very... fitting name.
Ah, we meet again. Thank you for taking care of things last time. I was able to score the contract thanks to you!
What?
I've been churning rusty water all day. My skin looks terrible...
Who threw away all these brand new weapons?
That stuff you're carrying don't look like junk. Are you going to toss it? People nowadays throw out just any old thing. New, old, doesn't matter. I found boxes of stuff like that.
What kinds of things did you find?
Ha! Everything, my friend. Sometimes little baubles, sometimes official palace weapons. Found a lot of those lately, ever since the empress's court was canceled.
A lot of time and effort went into making those weapons. Why not stockpile them? They'd be more useful than melting them down, surely.
What?
Geez, he sure has a lot of guts.
I can't believe he sold off what he stole from the palace.
Why would the palace sell off items like this to a junkyard?
I've been working at this junkyard for over a decade, and this must be the strangest thing that has ever happened.
What is it?

A while back, a carriage full of junk came in with some Royal Guard weapons. I figured it must have been a mistake, so I checked with $npcName:11000171[gender:0]$. He said they were to be melted down, now that the court was canceled.
If that were the case, the palace should've sent them to the forge instead of a junkyard. Right?
Yeah.
Nah.
Right on. And I even saw $npcName:11000171[gender:0]$ sell the iron from the palace weapons to some dealer. How crazy do you have to be to steal from the palace?
Really? Huh. Maybe it's just me.
What?
One man sows and another reaps. Bah!
Do fences trade junk these days?
Why are there so many things to melt? The furnace can't keep up.
Are all the royal weapons melted yet?
Scram, I got work to do.
What izzz it?
Curze that bear! Bzz bzz!
It took uzz forever to collect all that honey! Bzz!
Honey izz very preciouz to uzz honeybeezz! We won't let anyone take it away!
<font color="#909090">(She's already dead.)</font>
Can I help you?
It's not nice to ask a lady her age.
This is a good market to trade up in.
Be extra careful when you're signing real estate contracts.
I don't take questions that have nothing to do with my work.
$map:2000123$. How may I help you?
What's been happening lately?
I was wondering how you're doing.
You mean the news? If I had good information, do you think I'd share it with you?
Well, I would. Instead of seeking immediate gains, I invest for the future. That's my philosophy.
Money or trust... which do you think is better for me in the long run? Heh, I'm still weighing my options.
What is this? Are you hitting on me? I'm sorry, but I don't answer questions that have nothing to do with my work.
I'm aware of the rumors about me. One of them says I'm divorced. Another says I'm a widow.
Some even say I'm the only daughter of Chairman Goldus. Ha, geez...
I refuse to be gossip fodder. Don't these people have anything better to do with their lives?
I'm sorry... I got carried away for a moment. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have developments to inspect.
How may I help you?
I wonder what my parents are like...
I wish I could live with my parents.

I live with my grandma. She said that when I was young, my parents were taken away by demons. Also, my sister was frozen solid alongside the rest of the villagers. You could say my family's had a rough go of it.
She also said the empire's forces are no better than those demons. They brought ice elementals to fight the demons, but tons of innocent people were frozen during the fight.
See those red maple trees there? When Grandma planted them, they were seeds as big as your thumbnail. She says they grew twice as fast as I did.
I've heard only the warmth of $itemPlural:30000028$ can thaw the people frozen below.
That's because red maple trees are born from the energy of the fire elementals that fell in that terrible battle. I don't know if that's true.
What is it?
I wonder where my son and his wife are...
I want nothing to do with the empress or her army. They were supposed to protect us! Instead everyone was frozen by ice elementals.
My granddaughter was one of the victims. If... if the empire had just done something about the shadow gate the moment it opened, my son and his wife would still be here, safe and happy with me.
What's the story with the shadow gate?
The Shadow Gate is the entrance to a world of demons who serve the darkness. The empire is trying to keep their evil contained.
But I don't know... Closing the Shadow Gate at the cost of innocent lives... Is that really the right way to protect the world?
My son and his wife could be still alive somewhere on the other side of the Shadow Gate. If it is closed, I'll never see them again.
Cough, cough... Yes?
Cough, cough...
I'm still cold... But I have to get better soon. My grandma is worried about me... Cough, cough...
I wonder what happened to my parents... Cough... I hope they're still out there...
Can I help you?
Are you growing well, my little friends?
Please grow strong and healthy.
I was sickly and weak as a child. Moving to $map:02000076$ improved my health tremendously.
Where did you live before?
Oh, near $map:02000100$. Have you been there? It's always kinda... overcast. Not sure why.
$MyPCName$, if you haven't bought a house, you should consider one in $map:02000076$.
What brings you here?
It seems like there are more $itemPlural:30000233$ here than anywhere the world.
Honestly, I like this place better than my own house.
Do you know what's good about these black pine mushrooms?
Nope.
I don't really care.
Of course you don't. I'm sure you haven't seen them before, either. They're that rare. They're good for... Good for...
Ah... Mm... I can't remember all of a sudden. I've been so forgetful lately. I don't know what's wrong with me.
Is... that so? Well, I guess young folks like you usually don't take much interest in herbs, but... This is embarrassing. Ha ha ha.
Do you have a house?
Yes.
No.
Are you comfortable in your home?
Yeah.
No.
I see. Good for you. I've got a house, too. And a wife and children. But I'm not comfortable in my own home.
My sons never listen. They run wild all the time, screaming and fighting. And my wife nags at me all day long. At home, I can't rest for even a moment.
I see. You're just like me then. I'm not comfortable in my own home either.
My sons never listen. They run wild all the time, screaming and fighting. And my wife nags at me all day long. At home, I can't rest for even a moment.
I see. I've got a house. And a wife and children. But I'm not comfortable in my own home.
My sons never listen. They run wild all the time, screaming and fighting. And my wife nags at me all day long. At home, I can't rest for even a moment.
What is it?
Is he ever going to come home?
Boys, don't go too far.
I think my husband should've married his job instead of me. He's never home.
I used to love the aroma of herbs that followed my husband, but that was before we married. He's so obsessed with them now that he never has time to help around the house.
Sometimes I wonder... I wonder if I should take the kids to $map:02000002$ for a fresh start. There's more to being a good husband than just putting food on the table.
How may I help you?
There used to be so many trees around here.
When I was young this place was a lush forest, but now it's nothing more than a sea of stumps and cabins.
Thus, "$map:02000059$." Just look around and you'll see all the empty cabins that were once occupied by loggers.
Let's check the secret book.
What is it?
What would be fun to do today?
I took care of $npcName:11000202[gender:0]$. What now?
$npcName:11000202[gender:0]$ is really dumb. Did you see him standing there? He's punishing himself!
$npcName:11000201[gender:0]$ is my friend from $map:02000023$. He's an elf. Isn't that awesome?
Hello.
What's your favorite thing to do?
This place is really huge!
Hey $male:mister,female:lady$, do you want to play with us too? I have to play while I can. My mom will be here soon to pick me up.
I can't believe how big this field is! The sunlight stings a little bit, but Mom said a little sun is good for you.
$map:02000023$ is nice and shady. Neal's going to come over to my house later. $male:Mister,female:Lady$, do you want to come?
What is it?
Sheesh...
Aww... My arms...
My arms are killing me! Why is it always me who gets punished?
What is it?
People are right when they say "One man sows and another reaps."

Why do I even bother cutting down trees and chopping firewood? Those sneaky $npcPlural:21090023$ come crawling out of the $map:02000082$ and steal it all, leaving me with nothing to show for my work but sore arms.
This place used to be a dense forest, and many lumberjacks lived in the cabins here. But then the darkness seeped into Maple World through the shadow gate, rotting the trees from their roots.

The loggers left, one after another, and this place became a wasteland. After the closing of the Shadow Gate, the last remaining loggers dug out the rotting tree roots and planted new saplings. Now this land is recovering, all thanks to them.
What is it?
It figures I'd hurt myself carrying so many crates.
Big cargo ships come through here all the time. Sometimes I think the Barrota Trading Company is more successful than Goldus.
What is it?
The law must be obeyed.

There's been plenty of talk about Captain $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$'s leadership in Dark Wind, but I like his style. He said he'd evaluate every member based on their skill and performance. That's fair and reasonable.
Those who have problems with it clearly just aren't good enough.
Follow this road southward to find the Barrota Trading Company's warehouse at the end. Start your search there, and you should find $item:20000046$.
What do you want?
Maybe it's time I move out of this neighborhood.
What? Stop bothering me. Don't you have anything better to do?
What is it?
Why is business so bad lately? Where did all my customers go?
You look like you're still wet behind the ears. Stay out of trouble until you learn the ropes.

When you get out of here, move ten cells southeast, and then ten more cells northeast. You'll arrive at a small iron gate. That gate leads to $map:02000156$, where the godfather of Blackstar, $npcName:11000251[gender:0]$, resides.
Wh-what? What do you want?
Have you got any spare change?
Begging isn't as easy as it looks.
Leave me alone! I-I don't know anything!
Uh, what?
O-oh, you... I thought you were going to ask me something. Nevermind, then.
Check $npcName:11000214$.
What seems to be the problem?
I'm the best agent Dark Wind's got. Or I will be. Someday.
Mm? What is it? Are you having a problem posting $item:30000038$?
Actually, I kinda lost my $item:30000038$...
Where am I supposed to post $item:30000038$ again?
Oh, I see. Here's another one. Try not to lose it this time.
I remember giving you one, though. Why don't you check your bag one more time?
Your bag looks really heavy. Why don't you lighten it first?
There's a Dark Wind Bounty Bulletin Board in $map:02000138$. Take it there.

I remember giving you one, though. Why don't you check your bag one more time?

Oh, I see. Here's another one. Try not to lose it this time.
I remember giving you one, though. Why don't you check your bag one more time?
Your bag looks really heavy. Why don't you lighten it first?
There's a Dark Wind Bounty Bulletin Board in $map:02000146$. Take it there.

There's been a rift within Dark Wind ever since $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$ became captain. The members are split between supporting the former captain, Winn Stilton, and supporting the new captain, $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$.
I haven't decided which side I'm on, but honestly, supporting $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$ makes the most sense at this point.
Captain $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$ was behind all of this! I can't believe I trusted him.
What is it?
Shame on $npcName:11000065[gender:0]$!

Money, money, money! That's always the problem. $npcName:11000252[gender:0]$ is obsessed with money, and $npcName:11000065[gender:0]$ only cares about development. If they really got together to fool the citizens, we'll make them pay for it!
What is it?
Sigh... I thought this job would be easy...
I grew up in $map:02000084$, that's where my family lives. I heard about a job that paid well, so I moved all the way here.
All I had to do was look after some rich guy's son. Man was that a mistake. This kid I'm looking after treats me worse than his cat.
What is it?
What goes around, comes around.
You reap what you sow.
I hope he's learned his lesson.
People should be good to each other. You reap what you sow, as they say...
Wah! Geez!
Ugh... My arms...
How long do we have to do this?
Argh, what?
What are you doing?
Sheesh, I don't know. I can't talk. Doing this is tough as it is. My limbs are so numb I can't feel them anymore.
How may I help you?
I'm going to complete Fellowstone Tower, no matter the cost!
Fellowstone Tower will be the greatest building in all of Maple World when it's finished. The blueprints alone took years to perfect.
When it's complete, people will flock from all over to see Fellowstone Tower. It'll be the crown jewel of Victoria Island!
How may I help you?
Dad... He must be hungry...
I think I'll make rabbit-shaped rice balls today.
I love my dad more than anything else in the world. I just want to stay with him.
May I help you?
$npcName:11000221[gender:1]$ must be waiting for me...
I've got a daughter. She's the apple of my eye. Her name is $npcName:11000221[gender:1]$. She was the last gift my wife gave me before she passed away.
Are you here to talk to me? But why?
Argh, I'll never understand women.
I don't understand women. It feels like they're always changing their minds.
What is it?
Hmph, all men are the same.
My boyfriend and I came here for a picnic, and we ended up fighting because he kept looking at other girls. The nerve!
How may I help you?
I miss her...
It was somewhere over there...
Love isn't just about being with someone. Sometimes it's about their memory, too...
How may I help you?
Not even Dark Wind can be trusted now.
Dark Wind has changed since $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$ took charge. Now its members are more interested in getting ahead than protecting $map:02000100$ like they used to.
And the people of $map:02000100$ are walking on eggshells around them.
Can I help you?
Ah, will I ever be able to escape this neighborhood?
Excuse me, what did you say?
Have you seen $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$?
I don't know. I don't think so. This place is small enough that newcomers should be easy to spot, and the last person who settled here was $npcName:11000006[gender:0]$.
As you can see, $map:02000100$ suffers from a huge gap between the rich and the poor. It's all because of $npcName:11000065[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11000252[gender:0]$.
How may I help you?
I wish I could go to the rich neighborhood too...
Did you come from the rich neighborhood? What are you doing here?
Do you know $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$?
$npcName:11000064[gender:0]$? Who's that? Is he famous?
The people living in the rich neighborhood think we're smelly and dirty. But Mr. $npcName:11000006[gender:0]$ said they're smellier and dirtier on the inside for thinking that.
Mr. $npcName:11000006[gender:0]$ said he'd change the world, so everyone could be equal and happy together.
Sigh...
Didn't those men leave yet?
Can we take a break?
My arms are really hurting...
Mm? You're not the person I saw.
What are you doing?
I don't know. I don't know why I'm doing this, so please stop talking to me.
What?
What if they come back?
I'm exhausted...
Don't say anything. Just go.
What are you doing?
I said go. Geez, this is such a mess!
Argh, this is awful!
We messed up.
I don't know...
Hm? Why did you call me?
What are you doing?
I don't know. Don't ask!
Welcome.
Have you been on a cable car before?

Are you heading to $map:02000135$? It's famous for its beautiful scenery. At the very top you'll find the Cloud Cafe, famous among young couples. You can take the cable car all the way up to the top if you want to see it.
Our cable cars are made to last. They won't break, no matter how hard you jump! Please note that we won't be liable for injuries if you jump yourself right out of the car.
Welcome! Ho, ho, ho.
Take a seat wherever you want.
There are plenty of seats upstairs and out on the patio.
Did you come alone? Our guests usually arrive as couples. Ho, ho, ho.
Have a seat. I hope you don't feel out of place. We do get singles up here once in awhile. Sometimes they even find someone to leave with!
Oh, can I help you?
Is he interested in me?
Oh, what do I do?
I don't know what to do... I think he's interested in me!
I'm not really interested in you, sorry.
Who are you talking about?
Well... good! I'm not interested in you either, $MyPCName$.
That guy over there, the tired one... Do you know that feeling you get when you make eye contact with someone special?
Eeeee! What do I do?
Can I help you?
Oh, what a weirdo!
What are you looking at?
Go bother someone else.
Why are you talking to me? What do you want?
People say that the richer you get, the pickier you get. Makes sense, since you can have whatever you want with enough money.
How may I help you?
Hmm...
Safety is the primary concern for folks who work in places like this.
What is it?
I want to move somewhere new...
My dream is to live in a bigger and nicer house with $npcName:11000401[gender:0]$.
What brings you here?
Betrayal is the quickest path to death.
My organization is using $map:02000216$ as a foothold to expand its business to other areas. You didn't think we'd stay in the shadows forever, did you? Don't be ridiculous.
...Get lost.
What do you want?
Successful leaders always look to the future.
Goldus never stops moving toward the future. There's nothing we can't make or sell.
How may I help you?
Is there a specific hairstyle you want?
When in doubt, let $npcName:11000255[gender:1]$ take care of you! She's the salon director.
$npcName:11000255[gender:1]$ is the boss for a reason! She's the best!
Hey, there! If you've got a style in mind, we can make it happen. If you don't, maybe a magazine will inspire you. Want one?
Yep.
I'd like some advice.
Sure thing. This has all the latest styles. Have a seat and check them out.
Err... I'm afraid you already have the only magazine we have. Sorry about that.
Oh, friend... I'm afraid your bag is too heavy. Why don't you lighten it first?
Sure! I love nothing more than helping match people with the hair of their dreams. Let's chat and find something that's totally you!
What seems to be the problem?
Please keep your voice down. I'm not supposed to be talking with anyone right now.
What seems to be the problem?
I'd keep a low profile if I were you.
It's going to be tough, but we have to comb through the records for clues. We can't let them catch us off guard again.
What seems to be the problem?
Is this war ever going to end?
I hope we nab $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$. He's caused so many people so much pain.
Can I help you?
Can I help you?
Need something?
What's on your mind?
Some of us are trying to work.

After the Blue Lapenta broke, top scholars from across the world descended on the $map:02000026$. Ultimately, I am confident that it will be an alchemist to uncover the secrets of the Land of Darkness and the Shadow World.
Can't you see I'm trying to focus?
What brings you here?
I think I know this... Er, maybe not. Hmm...
The secrets of the Land of Darkness and Shadow Word cannot be explained by logic. Nature was not created by mathematics or science. They have a life all their own, which must be understood.
What brings you here?
If only Captain Stilton were still alive...

Captain $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$ commands Dark Wind now, but before the Blue Lapenta broke we were led by Winn Stilton. Every member of Dark Wind, myself included, considered Captain Stilton a true hero.
That's why we can never forgive $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$! He not only destroyed the Blue Lapenta, but he also killed Captain Stilton!
I can't believe $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$ ended Captain Stilton's life. That brazen coward fooled us all!
What seems to be the problem?
Sigh... You and your stupid books!
What in the world is going on?
A castle once stood on this very spot, the ancestral home of the Andreas. They were a noble family with close ties to the royals dating back generations. Then one day... the castle simply vanished.
That guy does nothing but read books all day. He's supposed to be investigating the scene.
How may I help you?
I must find a solution...
You see that guard over there? I'm telling you, no respect for scholars or history. He keeps harassing me for researching instead of sticking to his own tasks. He has no idea...
What brings you here?
Nothing in this world is free.
There's a key for every lock.
If you want something, then you'll have to pay the price.That's the way of the world.
What are you curious about now?
Don't you know it's foolish to fight your own destiny? Tsk, tsk...
See if you're lucky today! I can read your fortune!
Let me introduce myself. I am a great prophet. I can tell you of future events with unerring accuracy. Ignorant people call me a mere fortune teller or a con artist. It's their loss, really.
Why, you ask? Because even people like them need something to believe in. When everything else fails them, they'll come to me. They always do. Now, how'd you like to know your fortune?
Want to know your destiny? Want to see your future? Then ask me! I can tell you anything you want. For a price, of course.
No one can tell the future as accurately as I can!
How may I help you?
There are so many humans in $map:02000023$ now...
$npcName:11000031[gender:0]$... He's not a bad person, but...
Getting along with humans is difficult. They're just so different!
I know there are many good humans out there... but it's not easy to find them.
What brings you here?
Is anyone there?
Please... cherish the flowers.
Is there someone you love?
Yes.
No.
Good for you. Cherish them while you can. Have you ever lost someone you love?
Yes.
No.
I see. Sometimes love begets tragedy, but it's worth more than the pain.
I see. I daresay I understand your pain.
I see. Let me give you some advice. Never take the ones you love for granted.
Check the bulletin board.
Check the altar.
This altar is covered in layers of dust, the result of ages of neglect.
Lu, lu, lu, lu!
What is it?
Toh! Hah!
Only training can make one strong.
Hey, hey! I'm in the middle of practice. Get out of the way!
What are you doing?
Sell me on this $map:2000217$ business.
How can I join the Maple Arena?
How can I crush my opponents?
Do you not see? I'm practicing my art. I cannot lose to $npcName:11000018[gender:0]$ again... He beat me once in the $map:65000001$ and he never shuts up about it!
I'm never going to lose again! I'll show him what a mighty Murpagoth can do, and earn the praise of the Great Chief!
Are you interested in competing against others? Er, that means you're a competitor! I have to practice. Please don't interrupt!
Hah! Toh! Huh? You look lost. This is an old arena that has existed for generations.

Since ancient times, this $map:2000051$ has been home to us Murpagoths and the other tribes... Pigming, Kaka, Kolopupu, and T'oomba. The tribes were always at odds over their different beliefs and habits.

Every time a conflict arose, the tribes would settle it at $map:2000217$. Fight it out fair and square, that was the rule of the day. But as time passed, a lot of things happened, and... Anyway, now the arena is open to all who wish to test their might.
There are two types of arenas: Maple Arena and Event PvP. To access the Maple Arena, open the Arena menu and register. Event PvP is accessed through the Event Notifications menu when it's available.

You want to join the Maple Arena? No problem. See the Arena menu at the bottom right side of the screen? Open the menu and select Register. The arena managers will let you know when they find an opponent for you, and they search every 5 minutes.
When you select an opponent, you will get a notification asking if you're ready to enter the Arena. Press Enter Now to move instantly to the Arena. Easy, isn't it?
Keep this in mind, though... If you get matched up but refuse to enter, you'll get a loss and be locked out of the arena for a short time.
That means that if you register for the arena, you must enter it when you find an opponent. Cowards are not welcome in the arena!

Looking to make a name for yourself in the arena? Hmmm... I had a feeling about you. If you can score some victories, perhaps you'll get the attention of $npcName:11000134[gender:0]$. It's the greatest honor the warriors of my tribe can strive for.

That's not all, either. $npcName:11000134[gender:0]$ has ordered that warriors who prove their skill and valor be rewarded with $itemPlural:90000006$. With $itemPlural:90000006$, you can buy a variety of items at the Arena Shop.

The Arena Shop sells equipment that will make you more powerful in the arena. If you're trying the arena for the first time, then the arena equipment sold for mesos is pretty useful, too. If you want the good stuff, though, you'll need $itemPlural:90000006$.
What?
$itemPlural:30000157$! Leave them to me!
$itemPlural:13200026$ are useful, too.
I need more practice.
I'll do it for you, free of charge.
What?
I've learned something today!
I've got an idea!
$item:13200026$ is pretty useful, too.
Of course, I fail and get nothing more times than I succeed...
What seems to be the problem?
Sigh...
I wonder what she's doing by now...
If only she loved me... I would do anything for her...
What brings you to me?
Dirt. Yuck!
Look at my sleek, lustrous hair!
Want to know how I keep my fur so shiny?
May I help you?
Croak, croak.
Croak.
Croak croak croak.
Croak, croak, croak. Croaaaaakkk...
May I help you?
What is it?
Ah! The air smells fresh!
I can't catch $item:30000072$...
Oh! I's so happy to see another human being here!
How may I help you?
It's getting late.
When is my brother going to come back?
I like $map:02000023$. All the trees and fairies are so pretty.
What brings you here?
Aww...
What are you doing here? Traveling? I wish I could go on adventures too.
What is it?
I never suspected farming would be so hard...
Things around here have never been THIS bad. Maybe it's time for a change of career.
What brings you here?
Aww... I'm scared...
Do you know what's living down below? $npcNamePlural:22000005$! They're so big and dreadful... Just looking at them leaves me petrified. How could I possibly get one of their tails?
What brings you?
We have to finish building this quickly.
This place is dangerous. Be careful, especially if you want to use skills while on the Bone Bridge. Things can get scary there pretty quickly.
What brings you here?
Shush! Lower your voice.
How did you find this secluded place?

Don't you lie to me!

I-I'm not lying! I mean it!

An adventurer is someone who embarks on adventures around the world! I've even been to $map:02000023$, you know. My next destination is $map:02000051$!

It's slow today...
Gosh, I need some action.
Why are you looking at me? Do you have business with me?
How should I enjoy today?
Hey, you! I've never seen you before.
I don't recognize you. What do you want?
I need directions.
Nothing in particular.
You must be new to $map:02000001$, huh? Boy, I'd love to prank you, but you look like you're here to shop. Okay, I'll let you off... THIS time!
Follow that big road straight ahead.

Can't you feel the energy in the air?

It's a secret. Ho, ho!

Sigh...
Life is meaningless...
Ashes to ashes...
Everyone thinks they're special, but the world keeps turning without them.

Nothing. I just understand the way of the world.
Dust thou art, and to dust shalt thou return. Come empty, return empty. In the end, there's nothing in this world that is truly yours.

Who is $npcName:11000174[gender:1]$?

Mm, I don't know exactly. $MyPCName$, do you think you could find it? I'd give anything to see it!

Mom's going to give me an earful if I go home.

Luxurious sports cars.

Oh dear, you don't seem to have enough room in your bag for this brochure. It must be completely stuffed! Make some room if you'd like it, please.
I knew it! You had that look that says "I've got a need... for speed".

The Tuning Motors Enpilar series features a high-performance engine slotted into a low-riding, stable chassis to minimize air resistance and give more power to the speed-sensitive steering and brakes. $MyPCName$, it won't disappoint you!
Ooh, we're kindred spirits! With a bike, you can fly through narrow alleyways and congested freeways at high speed. And don't forget the sense of freedom that you don't get in a car!

The Tuning Motors Chopper series is the king of Maple World touring bikes, and it's been the most popular bike on the market for years. It has a much larger displacement than street bikes, and its engine makes a throaty roar that you can't help but love!
Ooh, you've got excellent taste! 4-wheel-drive vehicles are designed to handle a wider variety of terrain, including fields, swamps, sand, slopes, and so on.
Good, you already have our 4-wheel-drive model brochure. Read through it, and let me know if you have any questions. And it wouldn't hurt to have a look at our other models, too.

How may I help you?
Some things get better with age.
People nowadays tend to throw their things away the moment they're done with them. It's a shame, really.
Antique items are precious relics of the past. You can trade antiques, but you can't bring the past back.
What is it?
Can I help you?
Can I help you?
Where in the world is she?
Hm... Have you ever felt like you're being watched? You get this itchy feeling on the back of your neck when that happens. I've been feeling it a lot lately. Why do you think that is?
Excuse me, have you seen a girl around here who looks like me? She has blond hair and blue eyes, just like I do. I don't remember what she was wearing, though.
She's my sister. She went to do her hair and never came back. Does it take women a long time to do their hair? Huh... maybe she was getting it dyed.
Can I help you?
What is it?
What is it?
What is it?
Help me... Shut down the power...
Please... Nnghh... Pull the lever... Turn off the power..
My robots... have been corrupted by shadow energy... Ugh...

Help me... Shut down the power...

$npcName:11000340[gender:0]$ had been the butler for my family as long as I could remember. When my family fell, he stayed behind when everyone else left. Now he's the hotelier of my hotel. I owe him so much.
May I... help you?
I can't believe I'm homeless now.
I can't believe this is happening to me...

For years, I saved as much money as I could so that I could one day build a house of my own. And the day my dream finally becomes a reality, a giant mushroom comes and chases me away!
Curse that $npcName:22000321$... What does a mushroom need with a house, anyway?

This fire can purge evil and reveal the true nature of something.

Hey there. I'm new in town.
$map:02000001$ is the biggest city in all of Maple World and the seat of $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$'s power.
$map:02000025$ watches over the city from the north. It's off-limits to the public, I'm afraid. Her majesty's safety takes priority over the curiosity of tourists.

The $map:02000188$, the Banners of Glory, and a taxi stop are all conveniently located in the center of the city. For a reasonable fee, you can hire a taxi to take you to any other taxi stop you've visited, you know. Oh, and the job instructors from all over are gathered in the $map:02000188$.

The Banners of Glory in front of the palace mark the victories of certain powerful guilds and individuals. We update the banners all the time, so you can stop by whenever you like to see who has the most trophies and victories.

In the northern parts of the city, you'll find the royal office and library. $map:02000031$ is a must-see for any book lover, of course. It's not the biggest library in Maple World, but I like to think that it's the best. When I'm off-duty, I love to wander the stacks.
Behind the library is a shopping district where you can find special items, anything from home decor to mounts.

To the southwest, you'll find shops that sell equipment and other supplies. $npcName:11000004[gender:0]$ is one of the best smiths in the land, and $npcName:11000010[gender:1]$ sells all the latest herbs and potions. Never pick a fight without a stack of potions, I always say.

Head southeast and you'll find the residential district and hospital. Kick your feet up and relax after a long journey at $map:02000033$. Have your ailments treated by Tria's finest physician at $map:02000125$. And there's nothing $npcName:11000038[gender:0]$ can't cure.
And that's $map:02000001$ in a nutshell. A long, wordy nutshell. If I told you everything about the city, you'd be here all night. Is there anything else you want to know?

I know that you probably came from very far away to see the empress, but these things can't be helped. Thank you for understanding that we had to cancel the open court in the face of unexpected disaster.

$map:02000001$ is the political, economic, and cultural heart of Maple World, so it's always crowded. But in preparation for open court, there must have been ten times the normal number of people here.
Of course, when you have so many people in one place, problems are certain to crop up. Thieves, con artists, and the incident at the celebra—Oops. Maybe I shouldn't have said that.
Anyway, Captain $npcName:11000119[gender:0]$ is determined to keep the peace. Enjoy your stay here, and stay out of trouble. For your own sake.
If you're looking to take up a job, you should make a stop at the $map:02000188$ in the center of $map:02000001$. Job masters from all over the world are gathered there.
The timing is pretty lucky for you. If it weren't for the empress's court, they wouldn't be here. Of course, if you aren't at least level 10, they won't even talk to you.
Gosh, you're a Knight! I may be a humble guard now, but someday I want to be just like you.
You know, an old friend of mine left town to become a Berserker. I wonder how he's doing...
If you're a Wizard, then you'll want to visit $map:02000031$. Even the fairies of $map:02000023$ say our library is the best.
It is an honor to serve you, Priest. How is the empress doing?

We're watching you, Thief. You are a guest of the kingdom, but we won't abide any criminal activity.
Know this, Assassin. $map:02000001$ is a city of light.

Everyone in Maple World dreams of having a home to call their own. The empress and her court work tirelessly to open up new plots of land, but there's only so much space, so not many people can have the luxury of owning a magnicifent villa.

If you don't have a house yet, you should consider $map:02000001$. Property in the city proper is expensive, but the outlying suburb of $map:02000002$ is partially subsidized by the empress. And there's always $map:02000119$... And $map:02000064$...

There are many advantages to owning a house, you know. These days, every home comes with a device that will let you teleport there at anytime from almost anywhere. Let me tell you, it's saved my butt plenty of times after a long day of patrolling $map:02000092$.

And the merchants in $map:02000036$, west of $map:02000023$, have all kinds of interesting furnishings for sale. Decorate your floors, walls, furniture, and yard to create a house that's unique to you. Some merchants will even sell buildings you can place on your lot! When you're ready to buy, go to $map:02000036$ to shop for your house.

If you already have a house, you could always hire an assistant or two to keep you company. $npcName:11000700[gender:1]$ in the northwestern district of $map:02000001$ hires them out. But first thing's first. You have to buy a house before you can get an assistant!

I've been traveling all my life, and the greatest lesson I've learned is to never waste anything. $npcName:21000029$, for example, has hundreds of practical uses. It's amazing stuff!
Can I help you?
Please, don't destroy the park!
Nature is precious!
You can't step on flowers like that! Don't lie to me, I saw you!
How may I help you?
Being able to work is a blessing.
People shouldn't waste their lives being idle. Work is its own reward.
Our fuel needs are growing by the day. I think more excavation sites will be needed soon.
We're pumping oil every day. It's still kind of surprising how much we need to get by.
Grr...
Grr... Those villains!
If only I could get out of here...!
Ah, I'm finally safe! You're my savior.
I thought I was going to die. I used to think I was untouchable. But after they took me so easily...
I can't believe you came to save me... Thank you. I'll live an honest life from now on. I'll donate to charities, pay all my taxes, and volunteer at the soup kitchens.
What is it?
Woof! Something's happening here!
Woof! One day, a meteor fell from the sky. Be careful, it might have friends.
What is it?
Get me out of here, woof!
I'm hurt, woof...
Help, woof...
What is it?
Can I help you?
I'm tired of doing bad things.
I'm a new man. From now on, I'm going to live an honest life. I'm leaving my days of being a thug behind.
May I help you?
I hope my son is doing well.
Are you traveling? You look like you're about my son's age.
$npcName:11000360[gender:0]$ is my only child. He left home recently, wanting to strike out on his own. If only he knew how much that hurt his mother.
The day before yesterday I got a letter from $npcName:11000360[gender:0]$. He must've written it somewhere around here... even the edges are singed. So I bought an ice pack to keep him cool.
My son, $npcName:11000360[gender:0]$ is on the other side of all that lava. I wanted to visit him, but I'm just too scared to cross it myself.
My son, $npcName:11000360[gender:0]$ is on the other side of all that lava. I wanted to visit him, but I'm just too scared to cross it myself.

It seems even the heat can't faze the twins.
Whew, it sure is hot here! I told my mom that I could make it on my own. Maybe I should've taken $npcName:11000420[gender:1]$'s advice and settled down in $map:02000111$ instead...
How may I help you today?
Welcome to $map:02000157$!
$npc:11000065[gender:0]$ is really amazing. When he sets his mind on something, nothing can stop him!
Can I help you?
Fresh ingredients are the best ingredients!
People don't know how delicious $npcName:21000059$ can be.
Not many people know this, but cooked $npcName:21000059$ can be incredible. I'm getting ready to sell $npcName:21000059$ dishes made from my own secret recipe.
Look around.
Read the journal.
Shush! What is it?
Shush! Please leave quietly. I'm done for if they find out I'm here.

$npcName:11000367$! $npcName:11000367$! Where are you?
Do you know what makes cats so appealing? It's how independent they are! Though... it's possible for them to be too independent. Like $npcName:11000367$, for example.
What is it, meow?
There's nothing like love, meow!
Do you believe in love at first sight, meow? I do! Look at the cat next to me. Isn't she beautiful? Me-ow!
What is it?
Humans, leave the forest be!
$MyPCName$, you of all people should help protect the forest!
Beep!
Beep! Unauthorized access.
Beep!
Beep! Unauthorized access.
Beep!
Beep! Unauthorized access.

This is the power of science!
All research serves a vital purpose!

As scientists, we must always look toward the future. We must not abandon our research because we aren't happy with the immediate results, or out of fear of perceived consequences. Science requires persistence and dedication!
What is it?
Why are you looking at me like that? Ha ha ha!
I saw you watching me earlier. You're barking up the wrong tree.
Don't you believe me? I have nothing to hide. Have you always been this nosey?
What?
I don't think I can hunt in peace anymore.
Not everyone can be a wolf handler.
What?
So uh... are you a dude or a lady?
Think what you like!
There are treasure chests hidden all over the world. How did they get there? Who knows and who cares! Just remember the golden rule: finders keepers!
What seems to be the problem?
When will I ever pass through this valley again?
Enoki mushrooms grow here. They require clean, undisturbed areas to flourish. I suppose no one ever comes to this valley, then.
How may I help you?
Ohm... Ohm... Dear aliens...
One day, I'm going to soar!
Do you believe in aliens? I do! There has to be loads of intelligent creatures out there, the universe is huge! You should stop by some night and watch the stars with me.
Can I help you?
Can I help you?
What's up?
Ahh, such a nice breeze! And the scenery is beautiful!

What's up?
I feel like a king surveying my domain!

Well hey. My name's $npcName:11000380[gender:0]$, and I'm a member of the Wall Climbers. We're a group of free-climbing enthusiasts who support each other on our quest to surmount the greatest of heights. Anyone with a passion for climbing is welcome.
