This world wouldn't have existed if it weren't for the sages and the Lapenta. Which story do you want to hear first?
Let's hear about the sages.
I'm interested in the Lapenta.
How about a different old story?
Originally, each of the three sages was responsible for one aspect of the world. They governed life, space, and time to ensure the world remained in balance. Then one day...

The Demon King emerged, intent on destroying the balance between the three fundamental powers. He wanted to overtake the world with his own dark powers, turning it to a realm of endless chaos and despair.

The Demon King was strong enough to match the combined powers of the sages. To defeat him, the sages were forced to sacrifice themselves to banish the Demon King. Their legacy lives on in the Lapentas which contain what's left of their powers. Now do you understand why the sages were so important?
Yep!
The Lapentas were created by the sages to protect this world from the Demon King. They gave their lives to grant us these powerful gifts.
The Green Lapenta keeps the balance of life, the Blue Lapenta governs space, and the Red Lapenta maintains time.
These three Lapentas have formed a protective ward around this world, keeping the formidable Demon King and his dark power at bay. Hopefully that explains why the Lapentas are so important.
Yep!
$npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ and the Four Heroes helped the sages protect this world against the Demon King. Whose story do you want to hear first?
Let's start with $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$.
The Four Heroes sound important.
How about a different old story?
There has been an empress born to each generation of humans, destined to deliver the will of the divine as their messenger.
The empresses are selected by the will of the divine. The $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ was chosen a long time ago and inherited the title from her predecessor.

After the three sages perished and left behind the Lapentas, the $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ became the spiritual leader of Maple World. She was instrumental in rebuilding society after the Demon King nearly destroyed everything.
In the early stages of Maple World's reconstruction, the $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ would hold open courts to allow the people to speak to her. In time, however, she ceased this practice.
There has been much speculation over why she stopped holding court. Some said the $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ was struck down by illness. Others said she was abducted by the reawakened Demon King.

Whatever the case may be, the empress never lost the love and respect of her people. These rumors only show how concerned they are for her well-being. Do you understand the importance of $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ now?
Yep!
The Four Heroes are gone now, but their legend will live on. It is rare to find someone who does not know their names.

There was the mysterious mage Lewit from Ellin Forest, hot-headed warrior Ten from the holy Vayar Mountains, righteous archer Haster from the Green Meadows, and carefree thief Catarva from Kerningdom.
The warrior Ten fell in battle against the Demon King himself. The other three heroes were asked by the $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ to protect the Lapentas, rather than sacrifice themselves.
The mage Lewit was entrusted with the Green Lapenta of Life. He hid it in the depths of the Ellin Forest for safekeeping.
Archer Haster was entrusted with the Red Lapenta of Time. He hid it somewhere in the Green Meadows.
Thief Catarva was entrusted with the Blue Lapenta of Space. He hid it in a secret alcove within Kerningdom.
The three surviving heroes became the first guardians of the Lapentas and dedicated themselves to the task for the rest of their lives. And now you know the story of the Four Heroes, yes?
Yep!
Not much is known about the Demon King. He was powerful enough to bring Maple World to its knees, and no one who challenged him lived to tell about it.
No one knows where he came from, how he came to be, or what made him so powerful.
What everyone DOES know is that the Demon King hails from a world of death, despair, and fear, permeated by the power of darkness that he wields so brutally.
People named this dark world the Shadow World, and despaired when they found that even the Lapentas themselves could not purge the darkness.
So long as the protective ward of the Lapentas lasts, Maple World will be safe. But there is always the fear that the Shadow World will find new ways into our world, and destroy it.
So, somewhere beyond the reaches of our peaceful, idyllic Maple World lies a realm of pure darkness and terror that seeks to destroy us all. Does that answer your question?
Yep!
About the present, eh? All right, what do you want to know?
Tell me all about Maple World.
Tell me of the Shadow World.
I don't feel like stories about the present right now.
Maple World is a collection of continents floating in a vast, endless ocean. The biggest continent of all is Victoria Island.

Victoria Island consists of the capital city of $map:02000001$, where $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$</font>'s palace stands, $map:02000076$, $map:02000023$, $map:02000051$, and $map:02000100$. Each of these areas has developed its own unique culture.

Among them, $map:02000001$ is a metropolis built around the $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$'s palace and protected by massive castle walls. It's the political, economic, and cultural center of Maple World.

$map:02000076$ was once a quiet hamlet on an empty prairie. Then a group of bow craftsmen joined it and made it thrive among hunters and adventurers. Its elder is called... $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$, I think. I've heard he's a respectable fellow.
$map:02000023$ started out as a village of fairies in the depths of the Ellin Forest. After ages of hiding from the greater world, they have consented to allowing humans to visit them.

$map:02000051$ is situated on the far side of the treacherous Vayar Mountains. Rugged descendants of powerful tribes live on those rocky cliffs, and only the hardiest travelers can make it up there to pay them a visit.

$map:02000100$ was created by the Kerning workers who stay cooped up inside their bunkers, inventing things and studying crafting skills. Even I haven't been down there yet, but I've heard their technology is astonishing.

In my time, a great many young people left their homes on Maple Island and traveled across the vast oceans, dreaming of adventures and new challenges that awaited them on Victoria Island. I don't know if that's still the popular thing to do... Come to think of it, I haven't left this cabin for a long time.
Perhaps, instead of listening to this old man prattle on, you should venture forth and learn about this world for yourself. But for now, is there another story you want to hear?
Yep!

The Shadow World is a world of death, despair, and fear, created by the Demon King. The only thing keeping him and his darkness from spilling into Maple World is the Lapentas, the legacy of the sages.
After the sages perished, their Lapentas formed a protective ward around this world which keeps the Shadow World at bay.
However, some ten years ago, the Blue Lapenta of Space broke. That lifted the seal on the Land of Darkness, and allowed a gateway to the Shadow World to open.
It is believe that this tragedy occurred because a servant of the Demon King tricked a protector of the Lapenta.
Fortunately, we still have the other two Lapentas hidden away somewhere in Maple World. So long as they persist, the ward will keep us safe from evil.
The army is doing everything they can to prevent the darkness infecting the Land of Darkness and Shadow World from spreading, but...
Perhaps what the $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ needs are great heroes who can preserve what peace we have.

I don't know if there are people strong enough to protect the $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$, the Lapentas, and this world against the Demon King and his darkness, though. Anyway, is there another story do you want to hear?
Yep!

$map:02000076$ used to be the home of archers and craftsmen, all living in a collective. They produced many great works and great hunters, generation after generation.
The Green Hoods formed to protect the village from outside threats to their peace. Their current leader is their fifth, $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$.

Is $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ the chief of this village? Ha ha, no. The chief of $map:02000076$ is $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$. $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$'s father and $npc:11000001[gender:0]$ have been best friends since they were young.

That's why $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$ takes care of $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ like his own. You know, $npcName:11000015[gender:1]$ doesn't like people talking about her. So, maybe don't tell her about this conversation?

I've heard a great earthquake occurred near $map:02000001$, and the empress's court was canceled as a result. I hope the damage isn't too serious. That disaster might also keep $npcName:11000045[gender:0]$ from returning anytime soon.
$npcName:11000045[gender:0]$ won't tolerate anyone trying to take advantage of a chaotic situation. I hope he'll be back soon. We need him more than ever.

You've probably noticed that the Green Hoods are all archers. We're renowned throughout Victoria Island for our marksmanship, and even $npcName:11000045[gender:0]$, the master archer of $map:02000001$, is a Green Hood.
In fact, she taught me everything I know about loosing a bow. If you're interested in archery yourself, I'd suggest paying her a visit next time you're in the capital.
Everyone in Maple World dreams of having a house of their own. $npcName:11000001[gender:0]$ is doing what he can to manage the housing lots around the village, but there's only so much land.

If you don't have a house yet, you could settle down in $map:02000076$. $map:02000105$ is also quite nice, and is famous for its beautiful maple trees. There might be some empty lots still available in $map:02000104$ or $map:02000143$ as well. If you're looking for more affordable options, then you can check out the apartments in $map:02000105$ or $map:02000104$.

There are many advantages to owning a house, you know. These days, every home comes with a device that will let you teleport there at anytime from almost anywhere. Let me tell you, it's saved my butt plenty of times after a long day of patrolling the ant tunnels.

And the merchants in $map:02000036$, west of $map:02000023$, have all kinds of interesting furnishings for sale. Decorate your floors, walls, furniture, and yard to create a house that's unique to you. Some merchants will even sell buildings you can place on your lot! When you're ready to buy, go to $map:02000036$ to shop for your house.

If you already have a house, hiring a maid is a good next step. $npcName:11000700[gender:1]$ in $map:02000001$ is an expert on assistants and can definitely help you out. Maybe you should look for a house around $map:02000076$ first.
What brings you here?
Do you need help?
You'd better not cause any trouble here, or you'll be sorry.
Don't write us off as government goons.
Protestors sure are noisy today...
What brings you here?
Tell me about Kerning City.
What happened to the empress's celebration?
Hey there. I'm new in town.
$map:02000100$ used to be a village of inventors and engineers who worked out of bunkers. It was a center of research and discovery.
Their achievements gave rise to the modern, high-tech metropolis that is $map:02000100$. But where are those engineers and inventors now? That question keeps me up at night.

Anyway, security in $map:02000100$ is handled by us Dark Wind scouts. Losing Winn Stilton was a big blow to the group, but we were able to reunite under the great leadership of our current captain, $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$.

The current mayor of $map:02000100$ is Mr. $npcName:11000065[gender:0]$. Word is that $npcName:11000252[gender:0]$, the wealthiest man in the city, has the mayor in his pocket. Of course, there are always going to be rumors like that floating around.

I've heard the court was canceled because of the great earthquake that hit $map:02000001$. It might be a good thing, honestly. The poor people in $map:02000100$ have been upset about the widening gap between them and the rich. Not having the money to attend the court was like salting the wound.

But it also worries me. What if the people decide to rise in rebellion, now that the highly-anticipated court was canceled and their beloved $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ is nowhere to be seen? As part of Dark Wind, I feel more responsible for this city now than ever.

You ever visit $map:02000001$? Major players from the backstreets of $map:02000100$ have decided to meet there and recruit new members. Assassin Master $npcName:11000051[gender:1]$ should be there too.
The timing is pretty lucky for you. If it weren't for the empress's court, they wouldn't be there. Of course, if you aren't at least level 10, they won't even talk to you.

Everyone in Maple World dreams of a house of their own. There are many houses in this city, and plenty of people who want them. If you don't have a house yet, how'd you like to settle down in $map:02000100$?

North of $map:02000100$ is $map:02000166$, the site of some booming new developments. Recently renovated, $map:02000165$ and $map:02000167$ are often mentioned as hot properties. There are also low-priced apartment complexes in $map:02000164$, west of $map:02000100$.

There are many advantages to owning a house, you know. These days, every home comes with a device that will let you teleport there at anytime from almost anywhere. Let me tell you, it's saved my butt plenty of times after a long day of patrolling $map:02000146$.

And the merchants in $map:02000036$, west of $map:02000023$, have all kinds of interesting furnishings for sale. Decorate your floors, walls, furniture, and yard to create a house that's unique to you. Some merchants will even sell buildings you can place on your lot! When you're ready to buy, go to $map:02000036$ to shop for your house.

If you already have a house, hiring a maid is a good next step. $npcName:11000700[gender:1]$ in $map:02000001$ is an expert on assistants and can definitely help you out. Maybe you should look for a house around $map:02000100$ first.
Captain $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$... No, he's not my captain anymore. This is all too much. What's going to happen to Dark Wind now?

If we don't get that money back, it's coming out of my paycheck...

Welcome to $map:02000001$. How may I help you?

Hey there. I'm new in town.
$map:02000001$ is the biggest city in all of Maple World and the seat of $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$'s power.
$map:02000025$ watches over the city from the north. It's off-limits to the public, I'm afraid. Her majesty's safety takes priority over the curiosity of tourists.

The $map:02000188$, the Banners of Glory, and a taxi stop are all conveniently located in the center of the city. For a reasonable fee, you can hire a taxi to take you to any other taxi stop you've visited, you know. Oh, and the job instructors from all over are gathered in the $map:02000188$.

The Banners of Glory in front of the palace mark the victories of certain powerful guilds and individuals. We update the banners all the time, so you can stop by whenever you like to see who has the most trophies and victories.

In the northern parts of the city, you'll find the royal office and library. $map:02000031$ is a must-see for any book lover, of course. It's not the biggest library in Maple World, but I like to think that it's the best. When I'm off-duty, I love to wander the stacks.
Behind the library is a shopping district where you can find special items, anything from home decor to mounts.

To the southwest, you'll find shops that sell equipment and other supplies. $npcName:11000004[gender:0]$ is one of the best smiths in the land, and $npcName:11000010[gender:1]$ sells all the latest herbs and potions. Never pick a fight without a stack of potions, I always say.

Head southeast and you'll find the residential district and hospital. Kick your feet up and relax after a long journey at $map:02000033$. Have your ailments treated by Tria's finest physician at $map:02000125$. And there's nothing $npcName:11000038[gender:0]$ can't cure.
And that's $map:02000001$ in a nutshell. A long, wordy nutshell. If I told you everything about the city, you'd be here all night. Is there anything else you want to know?

I know that you probably came from very far away to see the empress, but these things can't be helped. Thank you for understanding that we had to cancel the open court in the face of unexpected disaster.

$map:02000001$ is the political, economic, and cultural heart of Maple World, so it's always crowded. But in preparation for open court, there must have been ten times the normal number of people here.
Of course, when you have so many people in one place, problems are certain to crop up. Thieves, con artists, and the incident at the celebra—Oops. Maybe I shouldn't have said that.
Anyway, Captain $npcName:11000119[gender:0]$ is determined to keep the peace. Enjoy your stay here, and stay out of trouble. For your own sake.
If you're looking to take up a job, you should make a stop at the $map:02000188$ in the center of $map:02000001$. Job masters from all over the world are gathered there.
The timing is pretty lucky for you. If it weren't for the empress's court, they wouldn't be here. Of course, if you aren't at least level 10, they won't even talk to you.
Gosh, you're a Knight! I may be a humble guard now, but someday I want to be just like you.
You know, an old friend of mine left town to become a Berserker. I wonder how he's doing...
If you're a Wizard, then you'll want to visit $map:02000031$. Even the fairies of $map:02000023$ say our library is the best.
It is an honor to serve you, Priest. How is the empress doing?
You're a Green Hood, aren't you? That's great. We guard could use the support of people like you during these crazy times.
You're a Heavy Gunner, aren't you? I've always wanted to visit $map:2000270$.
We're watching you, Thief. You are a guest of the kingdom, but we won't abide any criminal activity.
Know this, Assassin. $map:02000001$ is a city of light.

Everyone in Maple World dreams of having a home to call their own. The empress and her court work tirelessly to open up new plots of land, but there's only so much space, so not many people can have the luxury of owning a magnicifent villa.

If you don't have a house yet, you should consider $map:02000001$. Property in the city proper is expensive, but the outlying suburb of $map:02000002$ is partially subsidized by the empress. And there's always $map:02000119$... And $map:02000064$...

There are many advantages to owning a house, you know. These days, every home comes with a device that will let you teleport there at anytime from almost anywhere. Let me tell you, it's saved my butt plenty of times after a long day of patrolling $map:02000092$.

And the merchants in $map:02000036$, west of $map:02000023$, have all kinds of interesting furnishings for sale. Decorate your floors, walls, furniture, and yard to create a house that's unique to you. Some merchants will even sell buildings you can place on your lot! When you're ready to buy, go to $map:02000036$ to shop for your house.

If you already have a house, you could always hire an assistant or two to keep you company. $npcName:11000700[gender:1]$ in the northwestern district of $map:02000001$ hires them out. But first thing's first. You have to buy a house before you can get an assistant!
How may I help you?
May Ereve bless you!
Let peace reign in $map:02000001$!
Never let your guard down!
All hail the empress!
Welcome to $map:02000001$. How may I help you?
Sell me on this $map:02000001$ business.
What happened to the empress's celebration?
Hey there. I'm new in town.
$map:02000001$ is the biggest city in all of Maple World and the seat of $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$'s power.
$map:02000025$ watches over the city from the north. It's off-limits to the public, I'm afraid. Her majesty's safety takes priority over the curiosity of tourists.

The $map:02000188$, the Banners of Glory, and a taxi stop are all conveniently located in the center of the city. For a reasonable fee, you can hire a taxi to take you to any other taxi stop you've visited, you know. Oh, and the job instructors from all over are gathered in the $map:02000188$.

The Banners of Glory in front of the palace mark the victories of certain powerful guilds and individuals. We update the banners all the time, so you can stop by whenever you like to see who has the most trophies and victories.

In the northern parts of the city, you'll find the royal office and library. $map:02000031$ is a must-see for any book lover, of course. It's not the biggest library in Maple World, but I like to think that it's the best. When I'm off-duty, I love to wander the stacks.
Behind the library is a shopping district where you can find special items, anything from home decor to mounts.

To the southwest, you'll find shops that sell equipment and other supplies. $npcName:11000004[gender:0]$ is one of the best smiths in the land, and $npcName:11000010[gender:1]$ sells all the latest herbs and potions. Never pick a fight without a stack of potions, I always say.

Head southeast and you'll find the residential district and hospital. Kick your feet up and relax after a long journey at $map:02000033$. Have your ailments treated by Tria's finest physician at $map:02000125$. And there's nothing $npcName:11000038[gender:0]$ can't cure.
And that's $map:02000001$ in a nutshell. A long, wordy nutshell. If I told you everything about the city, you'd be here all night. Is there anything else you want to know?

I know that you probably came from very far away to see the empress, but these things can't be helped. Thank you for understanding that we had to cancel the open court in the face of unexpected disaster.

$map:02000001$ is the political, economic, and cultural heart of Maple World, so it's always crowded. But in preparation for open court, there must have been ten times the normal number of people here.
Of course, when you have so many people in one place, problems are certain to crop up. Thieves, con artists, and the incident at the celebra—Oops. Maybe I shouldn't have said that.
Anyway, Captain $npcName:11000119[gender:0]$ is determined to keep the peace. Enjoy your stay here, and stay out of trouble. For your own sake.
If you're looking to take up a job, you should make a stop at the $map:02000188$ in the center of $map:02000001$. Job masters from all over the world are gathered there.
The timing is pretty lucky for you. If it weren't for the empress's court, they wouldn't be here. Of course, if you aren't at least level 10, they won't even talk to you.
Gosh, you're a Knight! I may be a humble guard now, but someday I want to be just like you.
You know, an old friend of mine left town to become a Berserker. I wonder how he's doing...
If you're a Wizard, then you'll want to visit $map:02000031$. Even the fairies of $map:02000023$ say our library is the best.
It is an honor to serve you, Priest. How is the empress doing?
You're a Green Hood, aren't you? That's great. We guard could use the support of people like you during these crazy times.
You're a Heavy Gunner, aren't you? I've always wanted to visit $map:2000270$.

Welcome!
When will the ships return?
Sailors are rugged on the outside, but soft on the inside.
Can't believe the storms blew my customers away...
You're not from around here, are you?
Why is the harbor so empty?
What's on the menu?

Ugh, don't let me get started. Not too long ago, there was a big storm that rolled in with a tsunami, and all the regular ships we used to get here stopped coming in. Let me tell you, before the storm this place was packed with ships.
If it's seafood you want, I'm your woman. Sushi plates, crab cakes, calamari, I make it all! Freshest catches you'll find anywhere without catching 'em yourself!
...And if you can wait an hour or three, I can make some for you. The storms have fouled up the fishermen, so I'm still waiting on today's catch. What a life, huh?
I'm a seasoned sailor!
Maybe tomorrow, I'll find that whale...
I haven't shaved for months, and my chin is itching something fierce!
Ahoy there! Have you ever seen a whale?
Yes.
Nope.
Bah, nonsense! I've been a fisherman my whole life, and only seen a whale once. And it was a teeny one at that! Me dream is to see the great blue whale just once before the sea takes me.
Aye, they're an elusive catch. I've always wanted to see a blue whale myself.
How may I help you?
Why's everyone so spooked? It was just an earthquake.
Ahhhh, I'm so bored. Aren't you?
Everyone's all freaked out about the storm and the earthquake, but so what? We need some excitement around here!
I love staying around the house.
There's nothing like rolling around in bed all day.
I don't want to go outside. I don't want a tan!
My girlfriend keeps bugging me to go out, even though it's a great day to relax inside. You get that, right? Make her see reason. If she always insists on doing... things, I worry about our future.
What? Is there something you want to ask me?
It's so beautiful today. Come on, let's go outside.
Stop being such a troll and let's go out, please? Honey...

It's such a nice day to go for a walk or get some juice, but my dumb lump of a boyfriend wants to stay inside. Look at him, he's not even doing anything! Can you convince him to do something with his life?
Ugh...
Ugh...
The pain...
H-help me...
Empress... I've failed...
Ugh...
What is it?
Uh-oh. Please don't say you're in love with me.
I look incredible, don't I?

Hey, I know what you're thinking, and that's not why I'm here at $map:02000107$. I'm all natural! No cosmetic surgery here! I just came to get some fresh air, and check out the latest beauty... trends. While I'm at it.
Can I help you?
I want to become beautiful...
Will I look better if I change my style?
Others say Chief Hairdresser $npcName:11000255[gender:1]$ is the best, but I like $npcName:11000253[gender:0]$'s style.
How may I help you?
Who doesn't want to look pretty?
Oh wow, look at her!
Should I put on some cosmetics? Or should I try a new skin tone?
What brings you to $map:02000107$? Since you're here, I was thinking about changing up my skin tone again. Do you think I should do it?
What is it?
What is it?
What is it?
What is it?
What is it?
Ah, what is it?
Why am I not growing?
I know height isn't everything, but I really don't like being shorter than most people...
Hmph. WHAT?
I'm not afraid of spiders!
Real men aren't scared of spiders! They squash them flat as soon as they see them!
This place behind me is loaded with spiders. If you're in a hurry, you can squash them yourself.
What is it?
Yoo-hoo! Come play with me!
Good luck!
I hope you hit the jackpot!
I don't recognize you. Is this your first time here?
You've been staring at me. Interested?
May I help you?
Welcome to Goldus!
$map:02000100$ would never have been developed without the help of $npcName:11000252[gender:0]$!
There's a name on it: $npcName:11000477$.
The Goldus way! Put your back into it! Pinch a penny, make a penny!
Can I help you?
My friend, I miss you...
How are you?
$MyPCName$, do you have a friend that you miss? Someone you always think of?
I love how high this place is. The view is so beautiful.
I have a friend not far from here, but being away from him is agony. I wonder how he's doing...
Who is he?
I'm sure he's fine.
That's... Um... Sheesh, $MyPCName$! You wouldn't know even if I told you! Don't you miss someone like that?
Do you think so? I think so, too...
I know he's doing well. He's strong enough to get through anything.
But sometimes bad things happen, and that's why I'm worried about him. $MyPCName$, could you pray for his well-being?
Of course.
It's not my business.
You're very kind! I consider you a good friend, $MyPCName$. I'll be praying for you, too.
Oh, $MyPCName$... You must not have many friends...
Do, mi, so, do! How may I help you?
Hm, this is not the sound I want...
Music imitates nature.
As a musician, I want to make music from the most beautiful tones of nature. That's my dream.
How may I help you?
Remember people, put any Vayar stone fragments you find on the work cart.
$npcName:11000328[gender:0]$ has asked us to gather $itemPlural:30000055$ from the quarry in this work cart. I have no idea why he wants useless junk like this.
I'm busy. Why are you bothering me?
Argh, I'm so busy!
I really could use some help.
I can't get anything done because of those monsters!
If only those monsters weren't here...
I'm busy. If you're not going to help, then at least don't get in my way.
Judging by the rough handwriting, I think $npcName:11000441[gender:0]$ wrote this note.
Judging by the rough handwriting, I think $npcName:11000441[gender:0]$ wrote this note.
Check the note about the starting time.
Check the note about how to play the game.
Check the note about earning rewards.
I know these folks aren't just here to see $npcName:11000441[gender:0]$. Don't worry, I'll start the game when we've got enough people.
Step on the red tile to jump to the center of the cave. Once there, you can step on the blue tile there when you want to leave.
When the game begins, the tiles you're standing on will start disappearing. Last as long as you can without falling, and if you're the last one standing, you win! Easy, right?
In addition to mesos, the winners will get a special reward: $npcName:11000441[gender:0]$'s Blessing, which increases their Movement Speed for 15 seconds.
Do you want a reward? Then join up and complete the game!
Welcome, $MyPCName$!
Yoo-hoo! Congrats!
You're the best!
You're so awesome!
I was rooting for you, $MyPCName$!
You're amazing!
You did it! Good job!
What's wrong?
This place is still packed.
Yeesh, I don't know if they'll have room for me. I've been out all day. I really need to put my feet up.
What's up?
Tee hee! I want to become $npcName:22000321$ as soon as I can!
My house! Your house! $map:2000202$! Mm?
Down below, $npcName:22000321$ has claimed all of the $map:2000202$ for herself!
She's bad, but... so cool! I want to be a monster mushroom like her!
What is it?
Kyaaahh!
Marry me!
Ah... Doesn't $npcName:11000406[gender:0]$ look handsome? As for you? Not so much.
What is it?
Notice me!
$npcName:11000406[gender:0]$!
Rumor has it $npcName:11000406[gender:0]$ likes bad girls. I'd better become one, and quick!
Can I help you?
Oof... I think I'm going to faint...
I wish he would hold me in his arms, just once...
He's so hot, and his voice is amaaazing. When I hear him sing, I can hardly control myself!
What is it?
$npcName:11000406[gender:0]$! I'm here! Right here!
Over here! Look at me!
Eww, you're ugly! Get out of the way!
Can I help you?
I don't care what others say.
Heh! Just watch me. This is only the beginning.
Right now, Goldus Group is the biggest company in $map:02000100$, but that'll soon change. I'll be crushing $npcName:11000252[gender:0]$ under my heel before you know it.
What? You want to know if I'm single?
Hah! I don't need a man. All men are narcissistic, chauvinist pigs. I hate them!
Can't you see I'm busy? If it's not urgent, then scram.
I don't sell anything on credit. I trust money more than I trust people.
Can I help you?
Man, I never seem to have time to rest.
I wonder how Mother is doing. I haven't seen her for a while.
I've spoken with many people who are frustrated that the court will not be held.
It must be difficult to explain it to every single person.
It certainly is, but I understand their frustration. They came all the way here to attend the court, only to have their plans ruined. They're upset and disappointed.
Whatever the reason, I still feel personally responsible since I was the one charged with the preparations.

My job is to make sure $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ and the other members of the royal family have everything they need for their day. I'm always busy, but I take pride in my position and my service to $map:02000025$.
Have you been to $map:02000076$? My mother lives there. I really should visit her, but I've been so busy that I haven't had the time since preparations began.
Once my work here is done and I've sorted out all the issues, I'll go and visit her first thing! I've been sending her letters, it's just... she can't see. A disease took her eyesight. Sigh...
Meow.
Can I help you?
Can I help you?
Can I help you?
Did... Did you come to see me?
My best facial feature is... my philtrum...
I want to live in peace, like I used to...
I thought that if we went deeper into the forest, we could keep $npcName:11000751[gender:1]$ safer...
Others pointed their fingers and called us cowards, but we didn't care. We just wanted to keep our charge safe...
Not just anyone can sit on me.
You kick me, and I'm not going to be the one in pain.
How may I help you?
Even time can't help it...
As long as you know who you are and what you believe, what others think of you doesn't matter. That's the way we Boroboros live.
Why did you call me?
I want to go home...
What is it?
Ah, $MyPCName$! Good to see you again. I made it home safely, all thanks to you. I thought Dad would be mad, but he let me in without saying a word.
I've decided to stay out of trouble and be good. Come back and visit, will you?
Can I help you?
What brings you here?
Scram, punk.
Who are you? Stop bothering me.
What brings you here?
Who are you? I don't recognize you.
What brings you here?
What seems to be the problem?
What brings you here?
You must pay for what you did!
If you do something you shouldn't, then you must pay the price.
Pull some weeds and show me how sorry you are. I'll consider reducing your sentence.
Maybe you don't realize this, but I'm the warden of this prison. I don't take walk-ins.
I'm here to make amends for my deeds.
I'm just a tourist!
All misdeeds must be punished. The punishment must fit the crime, or else we risk the criminal committing their crimes again.
How can I reduce my sentence?
How bold! You realize I don't issue pardons...
I'll do anything. ANYTHING.

Will you, now? Hmm... I like the sound of that. In some cases, hard labor can substitute for time served. How about you pull the weeds in the prison yard? Do a good job, and I'll consider reducing your sentence.
See the prisoners in here? Remember that you can always end up the same if you fail to heed the law.
And that's the reason I have a tourist program here. You could learn a thing or two.
Can I help you?
If you're looking for the $map:2000216$, you came to the right place.
What's the $map:02000216$?
I'm curious about Blackstar.
I'm not surprised you haven't heard of it. This is a place that services people with extraordinary taste.
Looking for items to invest in? Have rare items to sell? This is the place to do it.
Whatever your business, you'll find that the goods we broker here are a far cry from those you find in $map:2000100$.
Talk to one of my brokers below to browse or sell items.
Note that epic and above items can only be brokered through the $map:2000216$. We'll know if you try to move them without us, and trust me, we will not be pleased.
Now, if you'll excuse me...
Well, aren't you the joker. If you're smart, you won't repeat that question to anyone else.
For the record, we aren't doing anything illegal here.
The $map:2000216$ attracts adventurers and tourists from all over Maple World, and that's advantageous to $map:2000100$.
In fact, the majority of $map:2000100$'s residents support us. The polls all say so.
Can I help you?
Can I help you?
Can I help you?
What seems to be the problem?
If you're not here for the job, please leave.
Ugh, I'm tired of this rotting smell.
Industrialization, urban development... I don't know who'll really benefit from all that.
What brings you here?
What brings you here?
Ugh...
Ugh...
Welcome.
$npcName:11000064[gender:0]$... Being with you like this...
Dad... $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$ is back...
After my father passed away, I found his journal among his things. My father was the guardian of the Blue Lapenta, and he wanted $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$ to be his successor. So I knew.
I knew there was no way $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$ did what the others said he did.
I'm glad the truth finally came out and everything is back to normal, even though $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$ hasn't paid for his crimes.
Being with $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$ reminds me of the gorilla pie that we used to bake together when we were young.
What could gorilla pie possibly be...?

It's one of those pies topped with walnuts, almonds, and blueberries. When $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$ and I first made it, it was so bumpy and ugly that it looked like a gorilla. Why? What did you think it was?
What is it?
Another win for me.
Don't sweat it. Crime is pretty bad around here. That's just how it is.
What brings you here?
What brings you here?
I can't trust just anyone.
Once I get out of here...
I need to find a better place to hide. The Dark Wind would have no trouble finding me here.
Welcome. It's nice to meet you.
Hm...
I can't believe this happened...
$MyPCName$, I can't believe we're meeting again like this. I can see in your eyes how much you've grown since last we met. Do you remember what I told you then? That the world would need a hero?
Looking at you now, I believe that you're the one.
Ha ha ha, you look like you have many questions for me. What do you want to know?
How did you end up on Victoria Island?
Why did you save $npcName:11000064[gender:0]$?
This $map:02000051$ is where I was born and raised. The last time I left, I swore I'd never return... I thought that was best for everyone here.
But something happened, and it made me wonder if I made the right decision. I came back to finish what I couldn't finish then.
What is it?
That's... I'll tell you when I'm ready.
I couldn't ignore the wish of a dying man. Even if he was a prisoner...
And when he awoke after his brush with death, I could see in his eyes that he was innocent. I didn't ask any questions, but I knew I had to help him.
Stay true to yourself, and you can overcome anything. No matter how difficult it is, you can do it.
How may I help you?
What brings you here?
They're up to something.
Sly devils...
Dark Wind has changed too much. Now it's crushing the citizens under authoritarian rule instead of protecting them like they used to. I can't let this continue.
$MyPCName$, do the people in this city look happy to you?
Yep!
Beats me.
Then you're a fool. There's no point in discussing this further. Leave.
Try to see through their deceptions. It's not hard to find the rotting heart of this city.
Can I help you?
I mostly paint portraits. Would you like to know why?
Because the most beautiful thing in the world is people! That's why I like painting them.
Would you like to know when I started painting?
Well, that's... I don't know. Do you remember when you started eating food on your own? Or when you spoke your first word?
Picking up a brush was as natural to me as picking up a spoon. I was born to paint. I don't need to know exactly when I started doing it.
When I have a brush in my hand, I feel like the world makes sense.
Whom should I paint?
How may I help you?
Kids these days... they don't even read books!

I've never seen such a massive, terrifying creature in my whole life. And it was fast. I couldn't believe it was a turtle.

Anyway, the news of the legendary turtle king surfacing quickly spread, and great warriors came from all over Maple World to battle back the deadliest turtle in history. Ahhh, just recalling that day makes my nonexistent hair stand on end.

A single strike from that turtle's leg sent dozens of warriors flying. Some of them were terrified into running. But enough brave souls stuck it out to tire the turtle out. For awhile, it looked like we might come out on top.
It must have been an hour into the battle, when suddenly a loud roar came up from the sea. The next thing I remember is someone screaming about a tsunami coming.
In an instant, a wave tall enough to block out the sun rose up. The warriors had to finish the fight and warn everyone else to escape before all was lost.
Acting as a team, the warriors came together and pressed back against $npcName:23000017$ twice as hard. It was the most intense battle I've ever seen.
I'll never forget the moment they finally flipped $npcName:23000017$ over. It was an incredible victory, cut short by the massive tsunami crashing down on us!

I don't know how long I was out. When I woke up, the sky was clear and the sea was quiet, as if the terror of the previous night was but a dream. It might as well be for those warriors... for they and $npcName:23000017$ were all swept out to sea.
What was perhaps the most frenzied battle in history was lost to the tides, with only myself and a few other survivors to retell the story.
$npcName:23000017$ has never returned to bother us since that day. I don't know if the tsunami swept it away, or if our heroes taught it a lesson.

While nothing particularly interesting occurred today, I try to appreciate every single day that passes. Once it's gone, you can never get it back.

When you take time to be grateful, the world around you changes. The flowers you see, the sky above your head, even the bus that stops by the house at the same time each day, all of those become special. In the end, you realize that no two days are ever the same.
For example, today, right now, I'm talking to you, $OwnerName$, and that makes this moment special. Every moment we share is special.

I was gardening today, when a grubby little dog showed up and started running around.
He came up to me, wagging his tail as if he wanted to play. I was elbows deep in weeds, so I wasn't sure what to do.
You let a filthy dog into my garden?!
Awww, did you play with him? And feed him?
Ah, I sent him away, as gently as I could, and wiped away all his paw prints. That's all.
I didn't "let" him, he jumped the fence. It was no big deal. He didn't mess up your flowers or anything.
He was such a cute little thing. I couldn't scold him. He was so cute, you wouldn't have been able to either, $OwnerName$.
I did. In fact, I probably should've asked permission before I did this, but...
I also gave him a much-needed bath. He was such a cute little guy. I hope he comes back.
I knew you'd say that, $OwnerName$. You're just like me.
I not only fed him and played with him, I also gave him a bath and brushed his fur. Then he settled down for a nice long nap at my side while I finished with the garden.
I had a terrible day, $OwnerName$. Are you ready to hear my horrific story?
I was ironing your clothes, and for some reason, I just couldn't get the seams perfect! I tried over and over and over. Seams are one of my specialties, you know.
I was so frustrated! I tried ironing my own clothes, starting with the one I'm wearing now.
And wouldn't you know, it turned out perfectly! So I went back to ironing yours, and I just couldn't do it. Ugh...

Hey, at least your shirt looks good.
Wait, so I don't have any ironed clothes to wear tomorrow?
That's correct. I'm so, so sorry. I feel absolutely horrible.
I have no excuse. I will stay up all through the night to attempt to get at least one outfit wrinkle-free for you to wear tomorrow.

I feel inspired and motivated now. I will collect my ironing kit and try ironing your clothes again. Thank you for the compliment.

<font color="#909090">(He takes back the paper and daintily places it in his inner pocket.)</font> I told you it was nothing.

An old scholar once said man's purpose is to make meaningless things meaningful. I'd better live whatever life I have left to the fullest, so I can die without regrets.

Then I realized living in the past was doing me more harm than good.
So I decided to let the past go, enjoy the present, and wait for whatever the future brings.
I started writing a while ago. But I'm not writing a novel.
I'm not writing something to show others. It's just for myself.
Someone once told me that writing helps you deal with difficult emotions and find happiness again.

He wore goggles around his head and a red cape on his shoulders. He seemed anxious. Couldn't stop peering around as he ate. Whatever his story is, it can't be a good one.
I asked him his name, but he refused to say. He was blond and had a scar on his face.

I wanted to grill some eels for dinner, but I couldn't get the fire going and didn't want to use the stove. Fire-grilled eels taste best, you know. A passing mage offered to help, so I gladly accepted.

But then he hollered, "I'll burn you all!" and shot a giant fireball at the eels! He would've burned down the whole house, but then he shouted "I'll freeze you all!" and put out the fire with an ice bolt.
Nothing much happened. Oh, where did time go? I'm not even halfway done with my cooking.

What's my specialty, you ask? Hee hee, grilled eels, with a delicious sauce!
$npcName:11000119[gender:0]$ loves them so much that sometimes he stops by my house just to eat them.
People always tell me I should open a grilled eel restaurant, but I want to keep cooking a hobby, not a job.
Hmm, a young lady has stopped by a lot recently to visit me. She wants to learn how to cook for her boyfriend. She's a cute girl with glasses... I can't remember her name.

Good ingredients make good food. Speaking of which, did you know $map:2000076$ is stocked with amazing ingredients?

Don't you think this house is too big for just two of us?

I went to $map:02000100$ and saw a masked man. He was tall, had red eyes, and was clad in black from head to toe. $npcName:11000233[gender:1]$ said he might be the famous $npcName:11000529[gender:0]$.
$OwnerName$, have you heard of $npcName:11000529[gender:0]$? No? Well, he just looked so different from everyone else. I want to know if the rumors about him are true!
Huh? You haven't heard the rumors? If you're so curious, then why don't you go to $map:02000100$ and find out yourself?
Have you been to $map:02000153$? It's the stronghold of Dark Wind, an organization led by $npcName:11000044[gender:0]$.
The organizations claims to protect the peace of $map:02000100$, but not everyone seems to agree.
$npcName:11000233[gender:1]$ said things were much better when Dark Wind was led by its former captain. Mm, what was his name? Winn Stilton, I think?
What happened to him? I don't know exactly. I heard he died in an accident.
You'd know if you visited $map:02000100$ how rotten the whole city is.
And that's not going to change until Goldus Group stops being so greedy. I have no faith in Dark Wind or the mayor.
Have you been to $map:02000092$? The water there is no longer drinkable because of $map:02000084$.
That's not the only problem. $map:02000111$ is infested with angry giant turtles who have been forced from their homes due to the contamination.
Worse still, $map:02000138$ is a slum now. What's the mayor doing? He says he's making the city better, but why are people becoming poorer?
Ugh! This guy named $npcName:11000362[gender:0]$ set up a stall right next to Mom's shop!
He sells $itemPlural:30000140$, and it's totally affecting Mom's business!
He could've bought some fish from Mom to put in his corn dogs, but nooooo. He doesn't care about anyone but himself!
I wonder how Mrs. $npc:11000424[gender:1]$ is doing. If you go to $map:02000100$, could you send her my regards?
Her only granddaughter is missing. I can't imagine how devastating it must be to her.
Her name is Maggie, and she's a friend of mine. She was being treated in $map:02000071$ when she suddenly disappeared.
Some time ago, I heard a strange rumor. Maggie had a doll that she loved, and a monster that looks just like her doll has shown up.
A monster that resembles her doll... What do you think happened to Maggie?
Right now, Mom and I are living in $map:02000111$. It was less than two years ago when we moved to where we are now, near $map:02000100$.
We used to live in $map:02000062$. Mom said she decided to move to the big city for her business, but I know the truth: it was for my future.

But I can't seem to get used to the dreary city life. The rich get richer and the poor get poorer. Everyone's too busy with their lives to care about anyone else. Sometimes, I miss the days when I lived in $map:02000062$.
...Gosh, wh-why am I even telling you this? Forget I said anything.
This is embarrassing, but I haven't found my passion. I don't know what I want to do for the rest of my life.

$npcName:11000788[gender:0]$ may be a big mouth, but he has a dream and that's to become an adventurer. $npc:11000406[gender:0]$ seems to have achieved his dream, which I guess is to become every girl's dream.
As for me, I still don't know what I want to do or what I'm good at.
I like helping my mom, but it doesn't fill the void inside me. And sometimes I envy others my age when I look at them.
$OwnerName$, I never thought I'd talk to you like this. I feel better now that I got that off my chest.

Didn't you see my ad in Kerning City? I'm transforming this into a bed and breakfast! I hope you'll come stay here when it's ready.
I'm thinking about launching a bed and breakfast business. Of course, I'll have to talk to get permission first. Teehee!

According to my database, people exchange gifts as a way of thanking each other. <font color="#ffd200">$OwnerName$</font>, you can just give me oil.

Do you like it? To help it go down smoothly, I've added a few drops of sesame seed oil, my favorite lubricant.
It may not smell enticing, but I assure you, that does not affect the potion's efficacy.
I read that cooking is about love. I pulled up an image of you the entire time I cooked this, $OwnerName$.
Please let me know how you enjoy it. I will factor that into my future cooking operations.
It tastes strange.
It's delicious!

The suctioning power of the vacuum in my right arm dropped to 27% today. I dismantled it and found this inside.
It must have been sucked into the machine while I was cleaning. $OwnerName$, is it yours?
You should be more careful when you vacuum!
Yup, it's mine.
$OwnerName$, your blood pressure is rising too quickly. Have you tried aromatherapy? I highly recommend sesame seed oil.
Beep! Beep! Beep! I apologize, $OwnerName$. There was an error with my auditory sensor, so I missed what you said.
Leaving items on the floor is not a good habit, $OwnerName$. Also, please think of my vacuum.
Glad to be of help, $OwnerName$.
$OwnerName$, I received a package while you were away.
Is this for you?
Yup, it's mine.
Nope.
Very well. Beep, beep, beep. Deleting record of receiving the package... Beep!
I don't understand. My scan revealed your name printed on the package. Searching database...
Beep beep beep! Unable to local scanned label image. Beep.
Understood. I was unable to locate a record receiving the package. I do recall someone entered the house, but all other records have been erased.
You purchased something? It is difficult to clean when there are too many items in the house. Might I suggest limiting your purchases to oil?
While you were away, I cleaned the bathroom, and I couldn't get rid of the grime in certain areas.
According to my database, I need a special cleaner to get rid of it, but we don't have any in the house.

Dr. Kartronic once said that grime cannot be removed with water for the same reason oil and water cannot be mixed. So I used the sesame seed oil we had in the kitchen to clean every nook and cranny of the bathroom.
$OwnerName$, not long after you left the house, I detected a small creature with a body temperature of 102 degrees inside the house.

I approached it. It ran. After two minutes and forty-eight seconds, I caught it. It promptly shook free and ran out of the house. It took me thirty-six minutes and twenty-three seconds to remove all the hair it left behind.
This incident has taught me that I must keep the door and windows closed, so no creatures other than you can sneak into the house.

I excel at vacuuming. The vacuum equipped in my right hand is so strong that it can lift up to 22 pounds.
I can sense even the tiniest particle of dust because Dr. Kartronic programmed cleaning as my highest priority.
I infer from this that he hates dust. So, $OwnerName$, I hope you understand if I leave in the middle of a conversation to eliminate dust.

Some teenager barged into the house today.
He was pale and his eyes were a bit crazed. He started yelling for a doctor.
I told him I was a doctor and that he didn't have to yell. He told me to treat him. He acted like he was going to die if I didn't.
But I'm the ruthless $MaidName$!
I told him he had to pay me first. He begged me on his hands and knees, then left when he realized he couldn't change my mind. He didn't even apologize when he left!
Young folks these days are so spoiled. They think they can get everything for free. I really hope he's not dead out there somewhere, though.
Today was a productive day. I treated so many patients. My wallet is bursting with mesos.
Some of them were attacked by monsters. Some fell from high places. One tripped into lava.
When you're hurt, you have no choice but to find the closest doctor you can, no matter how much he charges, heh heh heh heh.
That's why I like staying here with you. Our relationship is mutually beneficial, you know.
A bunch of angry militia members barged in here today. They said this was my last warning. Next time they would arrest me.
My crimes? Overcharging my patients and... having ketchup stains on my clothes, which supposely distresses our neighbors!
It's nonsense. I charge my patients what I think I'm worth, and I'm worth more than most doctors.

The idiocy of this world boggles my mind. Well! They can threaten me all they want, I'm not budging.

The Bunnies are the most famous troupe in all of Maple World!
We travel all around, and thousands of people come to our shows. I feel so lucky to be a part of them!

I knew I wanted to be a Bunny since I was little. They just bring so much joy everywhere they go, and I wanted to be a part of that! It wasn't easy, but I found a way to make my dream come true, heehee.
It's not easy to join the Bunnies. We're really exclusive.
Hundreds of girls line up at our management offices each day, begging for the chance to participate in our trainee program.
If they're accepted, they have to train hard to prove themselves, and if they pass all the tests, they finally become official Bunnies. Ah, I remember those days. I was the first in my program!
Remember how I said I'd always wanted to be a Bunny? Well, I had to jump through a lot of hurdles to get to where I am today.
You see, when I was little, I was sick a lot. I could barely stay in school because I was so fatigued, and I was severely underweight.
The other kids used to make fun of me. They called me "grasshopper ghost" because my arms were so gangly and I was so pale. They would run away when they saw me, shrieking about how I was contagious.

I was nowhere near strong enough to become a Bunny. It takes a lot of stamina to perform those dances, you know. But I never gave up. I talked to a trainer to learn how to build muscle strength and to a nutritionist to learn how to eat to make my body strong. I practiced every single day.
I will never have a "perfect" body, but I have a strong body, and I've worked hard to get here. I've learned how to take of myself.

Whenever I see kids making fun of each other for being too skinny or fat or tall or short, I tell them that nobody has the perfect body and that anyone can succeed if they set their mind to it. They listen to me, because I'm a Bunny.
There's something about my past that I haven't shared with you yet. Something that happened a long time ago...
Remember how I told you I was sickly when I was younger? I found out that it wasn't natural. I had been cursed by a witch.
To this day, I still don't know why. I almost died from that curse!
But curse or no curse, I worked hard and overcame it! I'm so proud of myself for that! I heard later that maybe some hero had lifted the curse, but...
Hero or no hero, I would've broke the curse myself eventually out of sheer determination. Still, I wouldn't mind meeting that hero someday.

To her surprise, instead of throwing her in jail, the man made a joke, admired her cleverness, then took her to his home, where he gave her clean clothes, a delicious meal, and a safe place to sleep, away from the vultures at the $map:02000100$
She was so grateful for his kindness, she became determined to pay him back in any way she could. He had changed her life.
For the next few decades, she worked tirelessly for that man. But then, one day, she learned that was he was doing was... morally abhorrent.

Since then, she's been torn, unsure whether to follow her moral inclinations or remain loyal to the man who had saved her from a life on the streets. What would you do, if you were her? Remember, I'm asking for a friend.

And I get to pretend they're guests on my show! A great host knows how to respond to unexpected situations with poise.
I end up interviewing them as I would if they were guests on the show. Sure, most of them try to sneak out in the middle of the interview, but I don't let them move an inch until I'm done with them.
Ahh, I wish I could host the event in $map:02000064$. I'm positive I could make it so much more exciting.
I've offered my services to the palace several times and get the same response every time:
"Thank you for your interest. That event does not require a host." I just don't get it!
Think about it! If you were in the $map:61000001$ audience, wouldn't you have fun trying to guess the winner?
But according to the palace, that's too close to gambling, which is prohibited.
Hmph. The palace is a rather old-fashioned, if you ask me.
In my younger days, I worked at a juice bar. My joy in life was listening to the customers and making their tasty drinks.
One day, one of the regulars came looking sad. He has broken up with his girlfriend a week ago and just couldn't get over it. I knew he needed a good laugh.
So I went all out. I listened to him, then I told him jokes and funny stories.
He left that night with a smile on his face, and it made me realize what I really want to do with my life.
My dream is to become Maple World's greatest show host! I have a long way to go, but I'll get there one day.

Since you asked, I did see some guy clad head to toe in armor deep within the Ant Tunnel. He was all solemn and asked how I'd gotten that far. I had to stop myself from laughing. He was so pretentious!
Then he said there was a legendary $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$ in the back of the cave!
Now, I'm from $map:2000062$, so I've heard all sorts of adventure stories, but that was one of the biggest lies I've ever heard.
Who knows? It could be true!
Pssh, that guy was definitely a liar.
I know, right? He's worse than I am. Uh... I mean... Ah hah hah hah!
Totally. $npcName:23090005[gender:0]$? Pssh! If such a thing really existed, don't you think it would've destroyed the world already? Hahaha.
Do you really think so? Does that mean the guy I talked to... is the knight from all the fables?
Come to think of it, there's no explanation for the quakes, either. Hm... Is there really something going on?
I've been thinking a lot lately.
I've always wanted to be an adventurer, but I've never actually tried.
Mom says I should just take over the store. Do you think I should give up on becoming an adventurer and join the family business?
Mothers know best.
You'd give up, just like that?
They do, don't they? Ah, maybe I should just give up on my dreams...
I thought, of all people, you would encourage me to pursue my dreams! But I was wrong...
What? N-no! I haven't given up. I swear!
What am I saying? Of course I'm going to be the world's greatest adventurer!
I went to $map:02000031$ this afternoon to see if I could find books that contain clues to hidden treasure.
But... it's pointless. I can't read a book for two minutes without falling right asleep.
Every time I try, I fall asleep and wake up two hours later, totally disoriented.
At this rate, I might waste away my life sleeping before I have the chance to go on an adventure! What's wrong with me?
I was dusting the bookshelf today when I found this piece of paper. See that strange picture? Doesn't it look like a treasure map?
See? Right here. That curvy, strange-looking pattern. It's almost like it was a quick sketch, right?
Judging by the grime, it looks like a pretty old treasure map. And the shape of the picture resembles the northwest part of Victoria Island.
...Huh? This paper was just a doodle, and then used to wipe someone's nose? N-no way! You're wrong! Eek, take a closer look!
Today I tried a new recipe, and I think I just made the best food I've ever tasted in my life.
It smells good and tastes perfect. I'm thinking maybe I've discovered a new gift.
This doesn't mean I'm no longer going to be an adventurer. It's the opposite, actually. Practicing cooking is part of my plan.
You can't eat at restaurants when you're out at sea. I'm honing my cooking so I can survive any situation.
Haven't you heard? The great adventurer $npcName:11000444[gender:0]$ is also known for his cooking skills! They say it rivals that of a royal chef!
Everyone's trying to keep this hush hush, but I over heard. There's another world besides Maple World!
Personally, I think it's related to the Shadow Doors scattered around the world. There's got to be a new world beyond those doors.
Have I been through those doors? W-well... That's... Oh, right—the stove! I had a chance, but I couldn't because of the stove!
I was just about to walk through one of those doors when I remembered I forgot to turn off the stove before I left the house. My forgetfulness stopped me from exploring a new world. What a shame!
I heard something from sailors in $map:02000062$. They said if you travel south, you'll run into a dreadful sea monster.
It's not a giant squid, like you'd think. Oh no.
It's a creature with the head of a gorilla, wearing a skull mask. It has horns and flies around on giant bat wings.
I can't even picture it. But here's the thing: everyone who says they saw the monster remembers it differently. So who can say if they're telling the truth or not.
It sounds dangerous, but I'd love to see this creature with my own eyes one day. Hah hah!
There are so many different types of adventures, but I grew up in a port village, so the type that calls to me are sea adventures!
But that requires a ship and a crew, and ships are not cheap. I've been saving up for a long time, but I don't have enough to even buy the smallest boat! However, I've come up with an answer...

I'm going to form a party! $npcName:11000116[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11000024[gender:1]$ have already agreed to join me! And, between you and me, I can't stop thinking about $npcName:11000019[gender:0]$...

I just so happened to overhear some folks in $map:02000069$ mention that $npcName:11000019[gender:0]$ wants to buy a ship and set sail for adventure, too! He acts like he's soooo high above me because he works at $map:02000068$, but... he can be pretty charismatic and determined when he puts his mind to it.
I can't decide if I want to ask him to join me or not. But you can't breathe a word of this to $npcName:11000019[gender:0]$, all right? You promise??
$OwnerName$, have you ever visited $map:02000068$ in $map:02000062$? Every wannabe adventurer has their heart set on joining that association.
About a month ago, I went there to apply, and the guy who worked there said I had to pass an entrance exam.
The exam is simple: just discover something no one else ever has. I built a raft right away and set sail from $map:02000062$.
I must have been on the sea for two days. I was so hungry and exhausted that I was about to give up, when lo and behold, I saw a patch of land, just off the horizon.

My heart raced! I thought I'd discovered a new land no one had ever set foot on before! But as I sailed closer, I realized... it was just $map:02000124$, which is really not all that far from $map:02000062$.

The warden intercepted my ship and held me there for a week before finally letting me return to $map:02000062$. Gosh, that's embarrassing. You're the first person I've ever told that story to, $OwnerName$.
I heard a story the other day about a kid in some village who wanted to become a pirate.
He ate some strange berries that gave him the power to stretch his body.
And he used that ability to conquer the sea and become a pirate king! Hah hah!
It's too crazy to be real, but you'd better believe I'll be poppin' every berry I see into my mouth for the rest of my life!
$npcName:11000019[gender:0]$ thinks he's better than me because he works at $map:02000068$, but hello, sitting at a desk stamping docking permits is hardly the same thing as sailing for adventure.
I don't need help from some stupid association to go on an adventure. Not when I have friends who think like I do!
Already $npcName:11000116[gender:0]$ and $npcName:11000024[gender:1]$ have agreed to join me. $OwnerName$, what about you? I should probably also mention there's a 300,000 meso membership fee.
The yearning to set sail for adventure eats away at my very core!! My ultimate dream is to be the very first to set foot on a brand new continent!
I've already named my ship. Now, I just need to acquire her! Hah hah!
I can tell you the name, if you're curious, but you can't tell a soul. Okay... I'm going to name her... the Nautilus!
So until the day I meet my Nautilus, I'll work hard as your servant! Hah hah!
I must have been around eight. We had a big ol' bookshelf at home, and one of the books on the bottom shelf changed my life forever.
It was written by a great explorer, and his every word enraptured me. My heart fluttered, my eyes glazed over... I felt like I was exploring the world at his side!
I knew then and there I had to become an adventurer. Ahhh. Such a great book. It was written by $npcName:11000444[gender:0]$. Have you read it?
What?! You ran into $npcName:11000444[gender:0]$ in $map:02000062$?! Why didn't you tell me? I could've gone and gotten his autograph!
Maybe it's not too late. I'm going to go look for him! Hey, I'm busy. Stop bothering me, will you?
I'm pretty passionate about adventuring, but not as passionate as the guy in the Ant Tunnel.
I think his name is $npcName:11000145[gender:0]$. He wears really weird clothes and says he's from the future.
He did a good job with his costume... but I think he really truly believes he's from the future.
Poor guy. I feel sorry for him. He's clearly not well.
Hello. It's a perfect day to go on an adventure, isn't it?
Yep!
I don't know...

Argh, what I wouldn't give to be out on the sea right now!!

I can't help it. I just don't trust humans.
I know you're not like the others, $OwnerName$. But... we're just so different.
I know we should all just accept one another, but I can't get used to your kind's disregard for nature or penchant for violence. Am I wrong to feel this way?
Nah.
Yeah.
No matter how hard I try, there's just some things I can't do. I don't know if a human could really understand...
I thought of all people you'd understand me. Just forget I said anything.
Thank you for understanding. All I want is for your kind to stop fighting and to live wisely!
$OwnerName$, I knew you'd understand. You're different from the rest.
$OwnerName$, I want to ask you something.
I've mentioned a few times that fairies aren't fond of humans.
But what's your opinion, $OwnerName$? Do you like fairies?
Of course.
I want to learn more about your species, honestly.
I've heard of humans who said the same thing, then brutally betrayed us. I'm not saying you're like that, but...
Just like that? It sounded a little insincere, if you ask me...
Ah! You and I are kindred spirits in that regard, $OwnerName$. I'm so happy we met!
Yes, I want to learn more about humans, too!
I made this pendant with a stone I found in my forest. Pretty, isn't it?
Heh heh, surprised? My mom taught me when I was young. She's a famous craftswoman in $map:02000023$.
But I don't think this is just some ordinary stone. It gives off a strange vibe, like... magic.
I want to know more! I'm going to show it to $npcName:11000031[gender:0]$ tomorrow.
Yesterday $npcName:11000034[gender:0]$ stopped by. He must have been worried that I'm staying with a human.
He kept urging me to return to the forest, but I told him I can better relate to you than I can to other humans. And it's true. Hehe.
$npcName:11000034[gender:0]$ would agree if he met you. If you ever have business in $map:02000023$, would you give my regards to $npcName:11000034[gender:0]$?
I prepare food for you every day, but do you really have to eat animals and plants?
Fairies only need one glass of honey milk in the morning and one in the afternoon. Animals and plants are my friends, and I shouldn't eat my friends, right?
You don't need to look so guilty. I know you can't live on just milk like I can.
"Nature makes us what we are." That's what $npcName:11000031[gender:0]$ says. Eat up!
Humans have long coveted the ancient knowledge of the fairies. They spy on us and try to steal it when we aren't looking.
Those who do are usually driven to ruin by their own greed!
With the current situation, we've had no choice but to join forces with humans, but that doesn't mean we like you. I've seen some pretty great humans but only a few of you are wise.
The wise humans know their place in the grand scheme of the universe. Then again... I doubt even $npcName:11000075[gender:1]$ is completely free of selfish desires...
Do all humans allow strangers into their homes? Today, three strangers barged in, but ran off when they saw I was here.
They were surprised, stating that they didn't hear my footsteps. Well, that's because fairies glide instead of stomp.
We don't want to hurt even a single blade of grass. Eeek! There are ants crawling all around your feet! Be careful not to step on them!!
Have you ever wondered why I don't have wings?
It's because there are all different types of fairies... Tree tree fairies, flower fairies, river fairies, and all sorts of others.
Some have wings, some don't... and some just have one wing...
Never mind that. My point is, if you ever visit $map:02000023$, make sure you don't ask such a silly question or everyone will laugh at you.
$npcName:11000284[gender:1]$... She's lost her shoes again. How disgraceful!
I've told her so many times! If she truly loves her shoes, then don't wear them outside of the forest!
Unbelievable! I hope no one helps her this time, so she learns her lesson.
...But that's wishful thinking. Humans can't resist helping her when she cries, and she knows that.
Yesterday, the wind told me that trees and flowers are disappearing on the west side of Victoria Island.
I'm guessing it must the area around $map:02000100$. I've never been there, and I'm glad! I couldn't survive even a single day in such a sad place.
Why do humans love to dig? Why do you love tall buildings so much?
You're building homes for yourselves but destroying ours.
I don't hate all humans. I have great respect for $npc:11000075[gender:1]$ and for $npcName:11000039[gender:1]$.
I have many things I can learn from $npcName:11000042[gender:1]$. I think there are only a handful of fairies who possess more ancient knowledge than he does.
Humans and fairies are so different. I'm having a hard time getting used to you. We haven't interacted with each other for a long time. You can't expect for us to become friends overnight.
Soon it'll be my birthday. Let's celebrate together. And don't even think to ask how many candles we'll need...
Oh, fine, since you're my friend, I'll give you a hint.

Why is the sea such a pretty blue? Are you looking for the scientific answer or the poetic one? I can't speak to why you think blue is pretty, so I'll answer the scientific question instead.

When light hits the sea, all light waves except the one that our eye interpret as the color blue is absorbed into the water. Do you understand? Similarly, red roses only reflect the red ray, which is why they look red.
Do you really believe that? Truly?
I disagree with you.

Interesting. It's a pretty simple and well-known scientific fact, but you disagree. Well, what's your theory, $OwnerName$?
You don't know? But how can you disagree if you don't have your own idea of what the answer is? This conversation is nonsense.
What I just explained is the most well-accepted theory, but explaining nature with science can be harsh on your spirit and soul. Truth be told, I have a different idea.

In my heart, I believe that the sea is blue because it saw that the sky was beautiful and wanted to emulate it. Or because it's a mirror to the sky's own beauty. Or maybe, the sky touched the sea once, staining it forever...
I know that such theories aren't science. But still, they bring me joy. I hope you'll remember that, $OwnerName$.
Scientific facts are not based on belief. They're facts. Absolute. But I like that you asked that question. It shows you don't want to see the world through the lens of pure fact.
That type of mental flexibility will help you grow as a person, $OwnerName$. Trust me. I have an eye for that kind of stuff.
