Is the air conditioner even on?
I came here to expand my business, but my partner is being completely impossible. And on top of that, the weather's too hot here and the people are too stubborn. What a terrible day...

The desert... is too hot...
My eyes have dried up.
Why would Mademoiselle Rue want to go into business with Cathy Catalina? They're polar opposites of each other. There's no way this partnership will last!
Good. Right. Perfect!
Mm-hmm. Paradise on earth!
Fan faster. Faster!
Yeeees? It's rude to barge in on someone's summer home, you know. Please remove yourself from the premises.
Sigh...
Hoo-haa! Hoo-haa!
M-my arms...
What brings you here?
This place isn't too bad.
Hm. Been too long since I really took some me time. This joint doesn't seem so bad.
Heh. This place isn't as big a dump as I thought it'd be.
State your business!
This place ain't too hot... Er, you know what I mean.
The food's bad and the music's worse.
I'm bored. May as well get out and see the sights...
Who's this?
Buncha hayseeds out here in the desert... Can't say I mind it.
Heck, it beats Kerning City.
Time to let off some steam.
Wah! You startled me!
Another beautiful day!
Maybe I'll throw another barbecue party tonight.
Uh-oh. Sandstorm!
You've been on the road a long time. I can tell. Come in and have a glass of water. It's on the house!
Sigh...
He must be waiting for me...
Madares...
I have to go back...
P-please don't talk to me. I d-don't know anything!
Let's see, what else can I do for fun around here?
How may I help you?

Please check the schedule on the monorail platform.

What seems to be the problem?

Hm...
This isn't good.
It's so loud and... dirty here.
I don't care why this place is in shambles. I care that these noisy hooligans are preventing me from doing my job!

What to do, what to do...
Welcome! L-look, just ignore them and keep your eyes on me, okay? Eheheh...
Eager to get out of here? Try the latest model sports car from Tuning Motors. Just start the engine and leave this dump in the dust!
You called?
This is my shot!
This is it! My big break!

Mwahaha! This scene is... perfect! The height of drama, eclipsing any movie or show I've ever seen! And I'm the guy who gets to film it. This is probably going to be the greatest film of my entire career!
Hm...
No... This can't be...
Something's going on here...
What, you think a woman can't be a fight manager? Just watch. I'm going to turn Boh and every other one of my clients into world champions.
Ugh... Who's there?
Heh heh...
I'm... dizzy...
My head is spinning like a top... Or is it the world that's spinning? I feel like... I'm gonna die...
You called?
What is going on here?!
Where did they come from?
Where in the world did they come from? Of course they chose today to cause a mess. When the dust clears, it'll be us security guards who take the fall for this.
Mm? What?
Argh! The match was almost over!
What's this?
Who are these guys? Get them out of here! The match would already be over by now if they didn't ruin everything!
Hello, $MyPCName$!
You must be here about this fancy chest, yes? It's enchanted to provide you with the materials you need to upgrade your gemstones.
Go ahead and give it a try. You'll need the proper reagents to open it, of course.
What reagents do I need?
I'm curious about the science behind this.
You'll want some $itemPlural:30001187$, which you can get by hunting monsters. That's the raw material that you will turn into gemstones.
To trigger the reaction, just use some $item:30001188$, and viola!

Fortunately for you, I just so happen to sell them! I should warn you, though, that my supply is pretty limited. It's not easy to make, you know.

$npc:11000601[gender:1]$ discovered this chest while taking inventory of the royal reliquary. We think it was a gift to the empress from a faraway place. Anyway, it seems to turn the energy of monsters into something useful.

To her surprise, the chest was even able to take the $item:30001187$ taken from monsters and turn it into gem dust. We agreed that it would be in everyone's best interest to make this device freely available to adventurer's like you!

This is bad! The stream that runs through our village is drying out.
I can't help but sigh...
Our village relies on this cool ground water.
We built the village around the stream. It keeps us alive in the inhospitable desert.
I hope everything will be okay...
I just want a good night's sleep...
Everything will work itself out.
You're not from around here, are you?

These bugs are ruining my business.

I'm so bored!
If you know of anything fun to do, for goodness' sake please tell me.

Don't take any unnecessary risks.

Artifacts from the past are so fascinating, aren't they?
I get excited thinking about the story behind all these old objects.
How can I help you?
Analyze my $item:30001025$, please.
There's something I need to tell you.
Absolutely! Hand it over, and I'll take a look at your $item:30001025$! Since you're paying, you can rest assured that the key will be useful.
Sure! I provide 10 free analyses per day, out of the goodness of my heart. Even if the key is too old to be useful, you'll still get a little something.
What brings you here?
Want to catch a prize fish?
Nothing's quite as exciting as catching a prize fish!
Use bait. That'll help.
Need fishing supplies?
How may I help you?
Hello.
Another lovely sunny day—just like every day!
I love being surrounded by so much natural beauty.
On $map:02010022$, hard work is considered a sin. Got nothing to do? Then soak in the majesty that surrounds us!
We just moved here.
Can you believe it? My darling child, bitten by a snake!
I thought this place would be paradise, but it's actually a den of snakes...
We haven't even finished unpacking, and my baby is already hurt. How dreadful!
Nice to meet you.
Oh! Who could have imagined I'd find a stone like this here, of all places?
I'm glad I moved here!
Coming here for my research is probably one of the best decisions I've ever made. I bet my wife and kid are happy, too.
What is it?
Grr... This can't be!
The Blackstars can't... lose...!
We aren't some fly-by-night operation. We're the Blackstars!
Ugh... It hurts...
Betrayal is the quickest path to death.
We're the cream of the crop!
The three of us make an amazing team!
We're the best!
Go away! We're on a mission!!
You're awfully excited for someone on a mission.
We aren't playing, if that's what you're trying to say! We don't get to play all day like you! We're on a very, very important training mission!!
Meh heh heh...
Prr!
Mee hee hee!
For the Meerkat Patrol!
We are as one!
Meerkats are strong!
We don't usually let our clients in here. Seeing us train and tend to our wounded makes them realize that we, too, are mortal. It's bad for the brand, see?
We like humans, of course, but we know better than to count them as friends. We once relied on our humans for happiness. That... didn't end well for us.
Anyway, now that you've seen our base, you have to promise never to tell anyone about it. Only you and your closest friends are welcome here.
One, two! One, two!
Strong body! Pree!
Strong mind! Pree pree!
You want to be strong, like the Meerkat Patrol? Then join our training!
That sounds adorable. Sign me up!
Don't underestimate us. If you cry and give up halfway through, you'll never live it down!
I can handle anything you throw at me!
Heh... I'll see to it that you run away with your tail between your legs!
We've got 53 jobs today!
Team 235, go!
Team 24, stand by!
We all trust and rely on each other in the Meerkat Patrol. You could say we're a big happy family.
What's the secret to your camaraderie?
It's all thanks to our hardworking captain. We all look up to good old Captain $npcName:11001408[gender:0]$!
Since you're here, you should say hi to him. I bet he'll have some good advice for you.
Ugh... This pain...
It hurts so much...
I feel weak...
C-can't... talk... Too... busy... pain...
Where does it hurt?
Leave me alone... you dummy... I need to rest...
Hey, I'm just trying to help!
G-go away... I don't want... your help...
I want to save you.
Maybe you've tamed me...
I can tell I'm becoming more sensitive.
It's so close, but I can't reach it. It comes to me in the night and vanishes at dawn.
The more I lean into the sunlight, the more I hide in the moonlight. But then, it all drifts apart. I can't continue this way...
What on earth are you talking about?
Huh...? Shoo! You wouldn't understand.
Sigh...
Hmm...
Strange...
I heard you talk!

An active volcano said to have formed during the great Maple World earthquake 1,500 years ago. Its constant lava flows destroyed the surrounding forests, but also created many hot springs and rare lava creatures.

A mountain where basaltic lava flows. It is said to have greatly influenced the development of weapons and tableware in prehistoric times. Its lava contains many elements beyond simple metals, making it a subject of study for many explorers.
No one saw <font color="#ffd200">Round-Eyes</font> for a long time. The other Lava Eyes eventually realized what had happened and regretted their cruelty, but only sorrow remained in $map:02000039$.
The hot mountain is home to $npcName:22000005$$pp:가,이$. Stories about his birth have been passed down, though no one knows how much of them is true.

Worn down by their laughter, <font color="#ffd200">Round-Eyes</font>$pp:는,은$ stopped struggling and closed his eyes. “No one accepts me.” “If I vanished, no one would worry about me. Maybe it would be better that way...”

A gigantic $npcName:22000005$$pp:가,이$ appeared before the startled Lava Eyes. Despite his imposing size, his face seemed strangely familiar. Amazingly, he was the missing <font color="#ffd200">Round-Eyes</font>.
As the lava carried him away, he prayed that in his next life he would be a great and mighty Lava Eye, someone everyone could admire.

Then one day, just as the number of white flowers left in memory of <font color="#ffd200">Round-Eyes</font>$pp:를,을$ passed one thousand, a column of lava erupted from the mountain and a roar shook the earth and sky.
Long ago, there lived a Lava Eye named <font color="#ffd200">Round-Eyes</font>, the smallest of his kind. The other Lava Eyes mocked him every day because of his size.

One summer day, he jumped into the lava of Scorching Mountain to prove how tough he was. But his leg cramped and the current swept him away. The other Lava Eyes watched <font color="#ffd200">Round-Eyes</font>$pp:를,을$ struggle and call for help. They only laughed, not realizing the danger.

No one has discovered how the lava circulates, but it is now believed that something more important than expected lies here. There must be a <font color="#00a2ed">special space</font> inside the Molten Hourglass.
Yet lava constantly circulates around the Molten Hourglass. Puzzled by this, the Perion explorer <font color="#ffd200">Silver Wolf of the Plains</font> discovered an artificial lava channel.

Hello, $MyPCName$! I am <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11001002[gender:1]$</font>~ I have fun e-vent information for you~ What would you like to know?

The God of Light wanted that final world to be as perfect as possible. He shared his power to create the transcendent beings called Sages and showed a special affection for Maple World by keeping it peaceful.

The <font color="#ffd200">Unknown Crystals</font>, made from crystallized particles of light, held mysterious power. But they were so unstable that even a small mishandling could cause great harm, so people initially regarded them only as dangerous gemstones.

Though the God of Light won the war, the darkness that seeped into the land filled exposed creatures with the wrath of the God of Darkness and drove them feral. Powerful monsters arose and threatened the lives of Maple World.

After creating the Empress to protect Maple World, the God of Light vanished into radiant particles of light. Some of those particles crystallized and were known for a time as <font color="#ffd200">Unknown Crystals</font>.

Long ago, the two gods of light and darkness created countless worlds and the living things that inhabited them. Maple World was the last of those worlds to be created. Is it not wonderful to live in the very last world the gods made?

Before he vanished, the God of Light used his remaining power to create a being who would protect Maple World from the remnants of the God of Darkness. That being was <font color="#ffd200">Empress $npcName:11001969[gender:1]$</font>.

Neither god would yield, and war broke out. The struggle was so evenly matched that either might have won. With the help of the Sages and the living beings of Maple World, the God of Light prevailed. The defeated God of Darkness was scattered across the earth and vanished.

The God of Darkness, however, saw Maple World filling with light and judged it a failed world that had lost the balance of light and dark. He decided to destroy it, and the God of Light could not stand by.
The origins of Lumistones are deeply tied to the history of Maple World. We must go back to the time when the God of Light and the God of Darkness coexisted.

Seeing this, the God of Light felt deep sorrow and responsibility. He chose to sacrifice himself to breathe life into Maple World once more. He dissolved himself and scattered particles of light across the world.

In fact, <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font> was never in great demand. After the <font color="#ffd200">Sages</font> vanished, nobody knew how to use it, so it was treated as a mysterious stone. Then, during an experiment to upgrade a Lumistone beyond Tier 4, we used <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font> by mistake and made a great discovery!

Even <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000032[gender:0]$</font> only knows how to make it and does not fully understand what power <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font> holds. There is still so much to study! Perhaps one day we will find another use for it besides upgrading Lumistones… Just thinking about it makes my heart race!

When a Lumistone has reached a certain level of power, using <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font> lets you upgrade it to Tier 5! Can you not feel the God of Light urging us to discover the endless appeal of Lumistones?
Was it not? I am so glad more people appreciate Lumistones! Ask me whenever you have another question~

As their research continued, <font color="#ffd200">Amil</font> discovered a precise cutting method that stabilized the light energy within the crystals. The great wizard <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11001573[gender:0]$</font> then supported Amil and Arkel in their research and lectures on the <font color="#ffd200">Unknown Crystals</font> at <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000101$</font>.

<font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font> is vital for upgrading Lumistones, but little is known of its history. The vanished <font color="#ffd200">Sages</font> apparently created it, making information hard to find.
A precious Gemstone deserves to be understood and used properly! Ask me anything about using Lumistones. I am an expert.

In time, several magical scholars led by <font color="#ffd200">Amil</font> became interested in the <font color="#ffd200">Unknown Crystals</font>. They formed a group called <font color="#ffd200">Arkel</font> and began studying them in earnest.

After we learned this use, demand for <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font> exploded. Luckily, the ancient <font color="#ffd200">Innocents</font> knew how to make <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font>. My teacher, <font color="#ffd200">$npcName:11000032[gender:0]$</font>, passed that knowledge to the people, making it as common as it is today.

With the full support of <font color="#ffd200">$npc:11000031[gender:0]$</font>, years of research led Amil to create a small, orb-shaped Gemstone named a <font color="#ffd200">Lumistone</font>. The Lumistone as we know it was born of the tireless work and study of the scholars at <font color="#ffd200">$map:52000101$</font>. Now you see how it came to be!

<font color="#00a2ed">$item:40500001$, $item:40500002$</font>$pp:는,은$ can be obtained from places such as <font color="#ffd200">Adventure and Raid Bonus Boxes</font>. You remember that dismantling Lumistones also yields Dust, right?

Many people ask about this. The binding on Dust obtained by dismantling <font color="#ffd200">matches the Lumistone dismantled.</font> So dismantling a character-bound Lumistone gives character-bound Dust.

You can obtain <font color="#00a2ed">Lumistones</font> from the Maple Guide rewards <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300849$ and $item:20300850$</font>. You can also craft $item:20300846$ through <font color="#ffd200">master Life Skills</font>, starting at mastery level 5.

You can dismantle Lumistones at dismantlers found throughout town. Do not forget that you can also open one with the button in your inventory. Dismantling Lumistones yields <font color="#ffd200">$item:40500001$, $item:40500002$</font>$pp:를,을$ as materials for upgrading.

Maple World has both <font color="#ffd200">character-bound</font> and <font color="#ffd200">account-transferable</font> versions of <font color="#ffd200">$item:40500001$, $item:40500002$, $item:40100027$</font>. You can use them together regardless of their binding. Character-bound materials will be consumed first.

To upgrade to Tier 5, use <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font> instead of <font color="#ffd200">$item:40100027$</font>. Do not ask why… We still need to research that part… Just remember that Tier 5 requires <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font>!
All Lumistone-related materials <font color="#ffd200">can be found throughout Maple World.</font> It may sound complicated, but please listen closely. Ready?

Lumistones can be upgraded to Tier 5. You know you can press the <font color="#ffd200">Gemstone</font> button in your inventory to upgrade them, right? Upgrading requires <font color="#ffd200">$item:40500001$, $item:40500002$, $item:40100027$</font>. Higher tiers naturally need more materials.

Was there anything else I forgot to mention…? Ah! The higher the tier of the Lumistone you dismantle, the more <font color="#ffd200">$item:40500001$, $item:40500002$</font> you receive. You understand dismantling now, right?

You can obtain <font color="#00a2ed">$item:40100027$</font> by dismantling <font color="#ffd200">cosmetics found in Maple World, received from events, or purchased in the Premium Shop</font>. I hear the Premium Shop now sells it directly too.
<font size='50'>Whaaat? $MyPCName$, what are you saying?</font> Please do not say anything so ignorant in public… If you do not know much about Lumistones, ask me and I will gladly teach you!

I think I have always preferred studying the history of Maple World to researching magic. Sometimes I miss the friends and teachers I knew at Ellinel, but I love spending my days among all these old books.

Upgrading a Lumistone to Tier 5 requires 9,000 <font color="#ffd200">$item:20300828$</font>. That is a lot of a rare material, is it not? It is not easy to gather, but the Tier 5 Lumistone effect is worth the effort.

Here, at <font color="#ffd200">$map:63000062$</font>$pp:는,은$, the ends of the night meet. The loving hearts of people gather here and become light. <font color="#ffd200">Once every seven days</font>, the moon carries that light around the world and illuminates the dark night. That miraculous night when <font color="#ffd200">the moon fills with light</font> is the <font color="#ffd200">seventh moonlit night</font>.

The more love there is in the world, and the brighter the light gathered here, the brighter the moon will shine. Then a bridge opens to the <font color="#ffd200">Island of Love</font>.
